rnam thar/༄7/ /rje drung sku phreng bzhi pa garma sgrub brgyud nges don snying po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa mo bya'i 1909lo yab stag brag rdo rje bsam grub dang / yum zhe lud gnyis kyi sras su/ mtsho rgyal zhal lung las/ skyes mchog tshul bzung shar lho shel gyi phug /tsā ri gnyis pa gangs kyi ri bo'i zhol/ /sbas pa'i skyes bu rdo rje rigs bzang du/ /yum zher lha sman rol pa'i ḍāk+ki ma'i/ /sgyu ma'i lhums zhugs sa sprel bya zla la/ /legs zhugs bya yi lo la yongs su thon/ /spre'u dgu la 'jig rten snang bar mngon/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par sku zhabrungs/ garma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje dang byems mgon tā yi si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po sogs zhal mthun par rje drung sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / shing mo yos kyi lor dgung grangs bdun gyi skabs su gser khrir mnga' gsol/ yongs 'dzin sogs kyi mdun nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs la sbyangs pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ rtsa ba'i 1

rnam thar/bla ma si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rin po che'i mdun nas so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa mtha' dag bzhes/ rje 'di'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor las/ drin can bla ma rje btsun byams mgon gyi thugs sras/ /so thar khrims ldan sgrub brgyud nges don gyi snying po/ /gzhan phan byang sems blo gros ye shes kyi mtha' yas/ /sngags kyi rig 'dzin dzñā na badz+ra yi mtshan can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po dper na/ garma sgrub brgyud ngesadon snying po/ gzhan phan byang sems blo gros mtha' yas/ rig 'dzin dzñā na badz+ra bcas so byang sngags gsum gyi mtshan dang / gzhan yang gsang mtshan 'jigs med rdo rje/nus ldan rdo rje/ khrag 'thung khro bo dzñā na badz+ra/ ye shes rdo rje sogs du ma mnga' la/ dpal spungs dgon gyi bshad grwar bzhugs te mdo sngags rigs gzhung bcas la thos bsam slob gnyer gnang nas rigs pa'i rnam dpyod che ba'i grags pa thob/ de nas sgrub khang du bzhugs te lam rim par sbyangs ba'i tshul mdzad/ sgrub khang grol ba dang rang dgon du phebs te gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs dang sgrub khang gsar 'dzug mdzad/ gzu ru dgon du rin chen gter 2

rnam thar/mdzod kyi dbang chos cha tshang gnang ste gdul bya bgrang ba las 'das pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ rje 'dis gter las bzhes pa'i rdzogs chen gyi chos skor dang / gro lod rtsa gsum gtor zlog las mtha' dang bcas pa/ mgon po'i chos skor dang par bu'i phyag len man ngag zab mo/ gnas mchog gangs rgyal lha rtse nas khrom gter du bzhes pa'i phur pa'i chos skor/ lung bstan gyi skor sogs mang po dang / gzhan yang gzi yi gter sgrom dang shog ser mang po yod 'dug 'on kyang da skabs 'phro lus lung bstan skor dang chos tshan thor bu 'ga' re bcas deb chung 'dir bkod pa tsam las thams cad dpe rgyun nub zin pa 'dra/ yin na'ang rgya ches gzigs pa po rnams la dpe rgyun 'dra yod na g.yar gnang mdzad rogs zhu rgyu yin/de nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i dga' ba zhes pa chu pho 'brug gi lor 1952zla 3tshes 15nyin gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul mdzad do/ /zhes pa 'di gzu grwa rkarma bde chen du 'bod pas2010la'i 2pa'i 3nyin spos ngad ldan pa'i grong khyer nas/3

dkar chagadakar chagag) yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub thabs rgyal ba kun 'dus las pad+ma'i bka' tshig rdo rje'i phreng ba yi lung bstan (7kha) yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub thabs rgyal ba kun 'dus las gang zag dgos kyi lung bstan nyi zla'i 'khor lo glu (1ga) yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub thabs rgyal ba kun 'dus las pad+ma'i zhal lung gter ston rang gi yang byang lung bstan (29rngo/ tshe sgrub 'chi med lcags rdzong las ma 'ongs lung bstan gsal byed shel gyi me long ske (39ca) zab chos zhi khro sku gsum don gyi snying po las kha byang snying gi me long dang :lung bstan gsal ba'i sgron me (45chen gsang bdag dregs pa 'jom byed las ma 'ongs lung bstan don gsal snying gi me long — ske tso — (5rje/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i las mtha' las dmag bzlog le'u dang po lung bstan gyi skor don gsal sgron me (871

dkar chaganya rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje'i ming can la ye shes dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki dzña na rak+ṣi ta'i dus kyi lung rim (119te/gter ston 'jigs med rdo rje'i nyams snang du lha chen rdo rje 'bar bas 'phrin bskur gyi lung bstan (25tha) thugs kyi klong sde man ngag kun gzhi'i mtsho gter las bla ma drag po ki la ya hūṃ gi kha byang shel gyi me long (nyi29de/ yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag las snying thig tshe yang phur gsum gyi lung bstan gsal byed nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor — glu (55ma 'ongs dus kyi 'gyur ldog gi lung bstan 'khrul bral me long dwangs ma zab gsang bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs — 993gsol 'debs byin rlabs char rgyun — (201dus ngan snyigs ma'i nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal ngan rgud pa zhi ba'i gsol 'debs rdo rje'i go cha ske ske ske ske glu glu ske ske — ske (203gangs ljongs mkhas pa'i rgyan bzhi la gsol ba 'debs — (205na mo gu ru gnas ka dag spros bral ske ske (206gzugs med nad bdag kun la spring ba'i yi ge ske — — (209rdo rje gro lod bka' tham ske ske ske — ske (211

pad+ma'i bka' tshig rkanalko11(yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub thabs rgyal ba kun 'dus las:pad+ma'i bka' tshig rdo rje'i phreng ba yi lung bstan bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so:thel (44dus gsum mkhyen pa'i kun 'dus rje la bstod cing 'dud: gnubs kyi brnye nam mkha'i snying po dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang ཿ ḍāk+ki mtshan ldan rdo rje mtsho gsum gyisaḥ dar zab khri gdan brtsegs pa'i steng du gu ru gdan drangs bzhugs su gsol nas: 'bras dang rgun 'brum chang skyems su drangs: dar zab gser dngul sogs 'jig rten gyi longs spyod ri ltar spungs nas:dbyangs gcig gis bdag cag gsum gyis zhus pa kyi hor+sha gson dang drin can gu ru rje: bdag cag rnams kyis phyi rabs don byed dus: 'dul ba'i skal ba sa phyogs gang der mchis/ /phyi rabs dus ngan 'gro ba ji ltar 'dul: blo gtad re sa skyabs gnas su la byed: zab chos gter 'di nga sprul su yis thon dus tshod 1

pad+ma'i bka' tshig gnas skabs gang gis dus 'dir slebs: nga bdag sprul pa'i ming la ji ltar yod: gzugs can gzugs med bar chad ji tsam mchis:skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsgrub pa gang ltar byed/ /chos dang chos min mchis na gang ltar dbye: bka' drin can gyi thugs kyis stsal du gsol: zhes bdag cag gsum gyis phyag dang smre sngags kyis zhus pas gu rus bka' stsal pa: kyi hoḥ gson dang dad ldan nam mkha'i snying : ma yengs nyon dang rig ldan gzungs ma gnyisaḥ da lta'i thugs sras nam mkha'i snying po khyod: gcig tu ma nges sprul pa lnga ru 'gyed: sku yi sprul pa dbus kyi phyogs su 'byung : kha ga/ཿming can mdo sngags zung 'brel skyong : 'gro don gdul bya khams kyi phyogs su 'byung : 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du khridaḥ khams phyogs bde skyid nga nyid yod dang mtshungs: gsung gi sprul pa hārarmyaphyogs su 'byung : bud+dha'i ming can sngags kyi chos la spyod: gdul bya 'gro don rang gi yul der 'byung : thugs kyi sprul pa shar gyi phyogs su 'byung : zigamathalal ming can zab mo'i gter la spyod:grub rtags rdzu 'phrul nam snying rang dang mtshungs gsang sngags 2

pad+ma'i bka' tshig 'bras bu rdzogs chen 'od kyis gsal gdul bya 'gro don rgya bod mtshams su 'byung : yon tan sprul pa khams kyi phyogs su 'byung :'jigs med ming can zab gter 'di la dbang rten 'brel ma nyams zab pa'i gter thon na: gdul bya 'gro don bod yul khams der mchis: phrin las sprul pa lho yi phyogs nas 'byung : )lhaming can brtul zhugs rnal 'byor pa: rlung sems dbang thob 'gro la phan thog che: de bzhin khyod kyi sprul pas don chen 'grub: sngon byon sangs rgyas rig 'dzin thams cad kyang : 'khor ba'i gnaya su bde skyid ma yod kyang : 'gro ba 'dul phyir mi'i gzugs su sprul: ma 'ongs dus tshod 'di yi snyigs ma la sum cu kha ral zhes pa'i dus gcig mchis nyi zla'i mdangs shor sa chu gso mi thub gza' klu zhabrugs pasachar chu dusami 'bab: sabacud nyamasapasalo tog bungs mi skye: lha srin 'khrugs pas mi nad nor nad mang : rgyal bstan nyams pas dam chos dad med btsong : dud 'gro'i g.yang nyams zho sha rtsi bcud chung : mi chen da lta'i khye'u lo bcu tsam tshe tshad sum cu'i steng du phyin pa nyung : de phyir dus ngan sum cu kha ral 3

pad+ma'i bka' tshig thogs: snyigs ma'i sems can rnying ma'i chos kyis 'dul: de phyir 'dul ba'i skal ba bdag sogs babs: gsang ba'i gzungs ma shel dkar rdo rje mtsho las can bu yis zab gter 'don pa'i dus:khyed kyi sprul pas bar chad sel grogs byed: sku gsungs thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi re re la ni sprul pa lnga lnga ste: dbus dang khams sogs hor dang bal po'i yul: lho brag kong dwags nyang po me nyag rgyar: la la rab byung la la khyim thabs tshul: la la gsang ba'i sgo dbye gter gyi grogs: khyod kyi yon tan sprul pa'i gter ston kyang : sbas dang gab dang gsang ba'i tshul gyis gnas: de ltar sprul pa ci'i phyir zhe na: dam sri dam log 'gong po sathel dang : srog bdag rgyal po bsen mo nag phyogs kyis: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig dang brdzus pa ni: bshes gnyen brnye sngags pa rgyal po bon:mi nag bud med byis pa la gnas pa'iḥ zab chos 'di nyid 'don dus khams phyogs der: bcu phrag bcu dang brgya phrag gnyis tsam yod: sa cha nya ra ta na ka ha ma tha sha pha ya a ga ming la gras: log lta mtho non ldang shing dug mtshon gyisaḥ yang yang tho 'tshams gshe 4

pad+ma'i bka' tshig zhing bskur pa 'debs bdag gzhan sangs rgyas rnams kyis sprul pa'i bu sa le 'dam snyogs gnas kyang 'od kyis bkra chu chang mdog la 'dra yang ro nus ngar: sman dug skye sa gcig kyang lo 'dab gsal: lha dang 'dre gnyis bsres kyang ga la 'dra: ma 'ongs bu yis brtag shing dpyad dang mthong : gnasangan dam log brdzus pa'i bshes gnyen sngags: kha dang sems gnyis mi mthun rang rgyal che: zab chos snying nas smod cing kha yis dad: sangs rgyas kun bzang shāka thub pad+ma nga : bdag sprul bshes gnyen rig 'dzin skyes bu rnams: mdo sngags ji bzhin bstan pa spel ba la: khyod dang nga yin rtsod nas sems can la: gnod cing mi bde dug mtshon dmag dpung bskyed: gos zur bzhi bskyur khrab rmog go cha bsags bstan pa'i dben gnas bshigs nas 'thab ra brtsigs dge ba'i las la 'bad skad dmag 'khrug byed: sangs rgyas bstan pa spel skad mtha' nas stong : khams gsum 'gro ba skyobs skad mtha' nas phung : mngon shes rdzu 'phrul yod skad rang gzhan brlag ser sna'i dbang gis zang zing nor la dad dug lnga'i dbang gis bsrung 5

pad+ma'i bka' tshig ba'i dam tshig nyams: rang mtho 'dod pas bdag sprul rnams la gshe: chos brgyad dbang gis 'khor slob mal sa mtho bka' bab med pas mdo sngags dkrug cing spel: lung rgyun med pas rang bzo'i dbang bskur byed: rang sems dug la gzhan la smin byed mkhan: skal med slob mas dad cing bkur sti byed: dper na rdo ba dar gyis gtum nas su: yid bzhin nor bur rlom nas mchod dang mtshungs: bka' bab med pa'i dkrug chos bsgrub pa'i mi nus stobs med nas rdo la rjes bzhag 'dra: smin byed lung rgyun med pa'i dbang bskur de gro nas me yi bsreg pa'i sa bon 'dra: rang ma dul bas g.yin la chos bshad de: mun pa'i nang du yungs dkar 'bru bstan 'dra: bskyed rim ting 'dzin med pa'i 'pho ba de byis pa nam mkhar 'phur ba'i kha smon 'dra: rang bstod gzhan gyi mkhas grub smod pa de nam mkha'i bya grib khye'us rdo brdung 'dra: 'chi nas gzhan la skyabs gnas btsal gyur kyang : dam tshig nyams pas 'ja' la spar bzung 'dra: bdag gis sprul pa'i rig 'dzin rjes 'jug gis: de bzhin chos dang chos min dbye zhid brtags: khams 6

pad+ma'i bka' tshig gsum 'a11 ba pha mar ma gyur med: kun la phan sems bskyed cing snying rje gyis: rang mtho ma che dben sa zungs la sdod: ri sul phug par brten la bsgrub pa gyis: 'chi ba mi rtag chos kyi sna 'dren bsgom:nyin mtshan dus drug nga la gsol ba thob: lus lha bsgom na chos sku snang mtha' yin: ngag sngags bzlas na longs sku spyan ras gzigs: rang sems blta ba pad+ma nga nyid yin 'di gsum brtson na chos kyi gzhi ma yin: snying rje phan sems chos kyi rtsa ba yin: rang sems rdzogs chen chos kyi 'bras bu yin: sdig sgrib med na chos kyi lo 'dab yin dug lnga ye shes lngar bsgyur chos kyi sdong po yin:dug gsum sku gsum bsgyur na chos kyi me tog yin zol zog med na don gyi rnal 'byor yin: chos brgyad med na bya ba btang ba yin:bslab gadza/ma ldan na dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin: baji/ba pa brtags thon grub pa thob pa yin: ngos lkog med na dam tshig ldan pa yin:bka' bzhin sgrub na rdo rje'i slob ma yin: dad pa yod na chos kyi snod rung yin bdag dge gzhan bsngo rang gzhan sangs rgyas yin: phyi rabs snod du ma gyur slob ma yi: yun ring 'grogs na nga la'ang 7

pad+ma'i bka' tshig skyon du mthong : de bas rang nyid gcig pur dben sa bzung : rig ldan ḍāk+ki'i sprul pa ma gtogs pa'i dug lnga dbang che bud med brten mi rung : 'gro la phan pa'i zab gter ma gtogs par yo byad dgos pa'i nor gter len mi bya: rkyen ngan bar chad rigs ni cher mang bas: 'gro 'dug spyod lam zhib par byed cing brtags:rang rgyud smin nas gzhan rgyud 'dul ba la: zab snar+sha/bsgrub pa rtags mtshan thon par gyis: lasacan bu dang 'gro ba nyam thag don: tshes bcu'i dus su nged rnams bod 'dir 'ong : dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i bye brag gis bdag sogs rnams la bkres skom don gyis min: khyed rnams bsod nams tshogs chen thob bya'i phyir:dus kun nga nyid bsgom la sirnyi bgrongs: 'gro don bar chad sel dang sgrib sbyangs yin dus ngan 'gro la nga nyid drin chen ste:drin len ma yin khyed rnams rang don yin pad+ma bdag gis zab pa'i gter chos kyang : mi re'i lag tu re re ma yin kyang : sngon ma'i gter rnams byin rlabs tshan che yang : dper na sman mchog dri ngad che gyur kyang : lo mang song nas ro yal nad mi sos: de la gsar pa dri 8

pad+ma'i bka' tshig ldan btang sos bzhin: ma 'ongs skyes bu'i thugs la de bzhag 'tshal: bzang pos blo brtan ngan pa'i sems phog pa'i pad+ma'i bka' lung rdo rje'i gsang tshig 'di: gzhan la ma spel snying gi dkyil du 'chang : nam snying yon tan sprul pas rnyed gyur cig: ces bka' stsal nas: bdag mi brjed gzungs thob mtsho rgyal gyis smras te:shel dkar bza' rdo rje mtshos yi ger btab pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin 'jigs med rdo rje rtsal gyis mdo stod kyi brag rin chen spung 'dra nas gdan drangs pa'o: sarba maṅga lo: :

gang zag dgosalung /(kha)〉(1(yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub thabs rgyal ba kun 'dus las gang zag dgos kyi lung bstan nyi zla'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba zab gnad can shin tu gsang bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so: sa mā ya rgya rgya rgya ga/ ka/gomam/na na mo gu ru pad+ma sirnyi lha gnas kyi mchog gyur brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas kyi khyad 'phags sgrub gnas mchims phu dpal gyi dge gong du slob dpon rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru thod phreng la: chos kyi rgyal po chen po khri srong lde'u btsan dang : ma gcig dbyangs can sprul pa ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : gnubs kyi dge slong chen po nam mkha'i snying po dang : rig ldan bu mo shel dkar dpal gyi rdo rje mtshoji li za dpal gyi sgrol ma la sogs las ldan tshogs: mang du 'dus nas 'jig rten srid tshad rin chen rigs:11

gang zag dgosalung /lus ngag yid gsum rang lus maṇ+ḍal phul nas su thams cad mgrin gcig ma hā gu rur 'di skad zhus: e ma: ma hā gu ru thams cad mkhyen pa lags da lta gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying por gnang ba'i chos dam chos khyad 'phags yang gsang rgyal ba kun 'dus dang : 'gro 'dul chen mo rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs dang : tshe'i sgrub thabs 'chi med rdo rje lcags rdzongs dang : yi dam khyad 'phags gsang bdag dregs pa 'joms byed dang : rdo rje phur pa gar khug gnam lcags spu gri dang : zab chos zhi khro sku gsum don gyi snying po dang : khyad du 'phags pa zab don phag mo'i chos skor 'di: ma 'ongs las ldan skyes bu gang dang 'phrad par 'gyur:'phrad nas chos skor 'di bdag skyes bu ji ltar 'byung : 'phrad nas legs ltas ma 'phrad ngan rtags gang 'byung rnams: bdag cag rnams la legs par rgya cher gsungs bar zhu: de nas ma hā gu ru pad+mas bka' stsal pa legs par bshad pas ma yengs nyon la yi ger thob da lta'i dam chos khyad 'phags yang gsang chos skor 'di:dbang ba'i las can skyes bu dam pa de nyid ni: nam snying khyod ni ma 12

gang zag dgos lung /'ongs dus ngan sum cu yi yang mtha' nyi shu kha ral nye ba'i dus kyi tshe: sprul pa zung gsum khams kyi phyogs su 'gyed pa'i dus yon tan sprul pa mdo khams rdza zhes bya ba'i yul: shar bltas grong khyer steng du skye ba len par 'gyur: glang ngam stag gi lo pa sbas tshul skyes bu 'byung : de nyid phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel legs 'grigs na: zab gnad khyad du 'phags pa'i gter sgo bcu la dbang : 'gro don gdul bya bod khams mtha' klas khyab par 'byung : 'on kyang bar chad bdud dbang rkyen gyis bsgyur gyur na gter sgo lnga 'byed 'gro don 'bring shes 'byung bar 'gyur: lo grangs drug cu rtsa gcig ma gyur bar du ni: mtha' dmag g.yul 'khrug la sogs ma lus bzlog pa dang : mdo sngags bstan pa nyi zla'i 'od ltar phyogasamathar khyab: de yang las can skyes bu dam pa de nyid ni: nyer gsum lo ru nga yis dngos nyams lung bstan 'ong : snodus bslab bya'i zhal gdams 'di dag yid la 'chang : zab chos gter rnams ma lus thams cad 'don pa'i dus: khyim nag ma 'grimasasdig sgrib can gyi zas gos spongs: rkang bzhi zang zing nor la 'dzin chags chung bar 13

gang zag dgos lung /gyis: mi ngo ma srungs nga yis 'chad pa'i gtam 'di nyon gdams ngag dpe yi ngos la ma bskyur blo la phob phyogs kyi ser skya mi nag kha la ma nyan par bdag gis lung bstan rten 'brel zhib la brtags shing gsang : dmus long lta bur sdod la gzhan la ltad mo skyur smra ba nyung la 'gro 'dug spyod lam gzab par bya: sdang dgra gar yod med pas sems la dpyad cing brtags: bar chad 'dod yon zas kyis bslu nyes yod pas gzob: pha rol byad mas mnan gtad 'ong bas byad bzlog 'bad: lo gsum song nas sdod pa'i gnas mal gzhan du spos: yun ring 'grogs na yul mi kun gyis gshe bskur 'ong : lung bstan sogs la gter sogs 'don pa'i dus byung kyang : gter gnas sba dgos rang min gzhan gyis thos mi rung : dus ngan mi rung lha 'dres klag lta tho 'tshams pas: ting 'dzin lha sngags srung ba'i 'khor lo dus kun sgoms: gzhan don rim gro 'dre bkar bzlog pa'i las mi bya: rtags ldan brag phug dben par sdod la chos 'di sgrubs yid gnyis the tshom blang dor le lo rab spangs nas: bsgrub la rtags dang mtshan ma bzang bar 14

gang zag dgos lung /ma byung bar gzhan la ma spel shin tu gsang bar dgos ched yod:grub rtags mngon shes che phra la sogs gang byung kyang : gzhan la ma smra mi shes pa bzhin gyis la sdod: de ltar smras rung zad par yod par ma gyur kyang : phung byed bdud sprul tshogs kyis thos na bar chad 'bebs: lung bstan rtags byung ldan pa'i skyes chen ma rtogs par: rang gzhan phung bar byed pa'i slob dpon skyabs ma btsal:nyer gsum lo ru brag ri rin chen spungs 'dra nas: yang gsang bla sgrub 'gro 'dul chen mo'i chos skor dang : go chen lha rtse'i brag nas yi dam sgrub skor thon: nyer lnga'i dus su sri'i mtsho nas rdor phur dang : nga yi sku tshab mthong ba don ldan phyag mtshan sogs:ngo mtshar ldan pa'i zab gter ma lus thon par 'gyur: ga nam mtsho nas tshe sgrub lcags kyi yang rdzong sogs: 'gro la phan pa'i zab gter khyad 'phags gdan drangs gyur nyer drug dus su tshe 'phrang bar chad 'bring bar slebs: de dus tshe sgrub phyi nang gsang ba'i bsgrub la brtson: de rgyab sum cu tham pa lo lon dus kyi tshe: tshe 'phrang bar chad shin tu che bar slebs pa'i dus: tshe'i sgrub pa mkha' 'gro'i 15

gang zag dgos lung /sun bzlog 'bad gyur na: de nas drug cu rtsa gcig lo yi bar du ni:bar chad mi mthun rkyen dbang dag tu 'gro mi 'gyur: de nas dge bsnyen gnyen chen ge 'dzo'i brag ri nas: yi dam khyad 'phags gsang bdag chos skor rnyed par 'gyur: de nyid bsgrub pa rtags mtshan ma thon bar du sgrubs: bar chad bdud dang lha srin gang gis glags mi rnyed: de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel legaba'i'agrigs nas: nyang stod yi ge drug pa rang 'byon brag ngos nas: zab chos zhi khro sku gsum don snying chos skor rnyed: zab chos de nyid 'brel pa thob tshad sems can kun: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la 'god par 'gyur: de nas shar phyogs gser gyi 'brong ri smug po dang : rdza rgyal gu ra rdo rje legs pa'i brag ri nas: gnam lcags rdo rje zil gnon me 'bar 'di nyid dang / /pad+ma bdag gis sgrub phur khyad 'phags rnam gnyis dang : 'gro kun dbul 'phongs sel byed ārla j-i lha'i sku: khyad par gter phran 'ga' re rnyed par 'gyur yang srid de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel rab 'grigs na nga yi 'khas kyis bcag pa'i khams kyi ru dam gyi pha 16

gang zag dgos lung /waṃ zhabs chung seṅge 'dra ba'i rdo ngos nas: dbang gi las rdzogs rdo rje phag mo'i chos rnyed 'gyur: de nyid gsang zhing rtags mtshan ldan par bsgrub gyur na lo grangasa'aga' rer tshe 'phrang bar chad bzlog pa dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro'i zhal mthong gsung thos dngos su 'byung :'ja' dang rol mo me tog char pa 'bebs pa dang : ya mtshan ldan pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma thams cad kun: rang gzhan kun gyis dngos su mthong bar 'gyur yang srid: 'on kyang ma 'ongs sems can las ngan sgrib g.yog gis: skal ldan las ldan de la 'dud mkhan mi nyung ngo : sngon nas tshogs bsags las can skyes bu re re yis: dbang lung zhu nas chos 'brel thob tshad thams cad ni pad+ma bdag dang skal ba ma lus mnyam par 'gyur: kha lag 'brel tshad tshe 'phos nga yi drung du khrid: de nyid nam zhig mi rtag 'da' ba'i tshul bstan tshe: 'ja' sprin 'khrigs shing me tog char pa 'bebs pa dang :nam mkha' g.ya' bral ngo mtshar rtags mtshan bcas nas su: lcang lo can dang rnga yab nga yi drung du skye: sprul pa yang sprul dpag med 'byed nas 'gro don byed zab gter chos kyis 'gro don smin grol 17

gang zag dgosalung /lam la 'god: de yi gdung 'bum shar phyogs smar zhes bya ba'i sar gnas mchog lcags ri 'od 'bar mdun du bzhugs gyur na:mtha' dmag g.yul 'khrug bzlog cing lo 'bras legs pa dang :yul khams bde skyid yun du gnas par 'gyur ba dang : phyag bskor byas tshad bar chad rkyen las thar ba dang : smar stod ki zi'i phyogs su bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs: ma 'ongs las can skyes bu de ltar 'byung bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: yang gcig 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis rje la 'di skad gsol: e ma: ma hā gu ru rje btsun rin po che:phyi rabs nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa gter ston des: zab gter rgya cher ma lus mtha' dag 'don pa'i tshe: chos bdag rig 'dzin brgyud 'dzin skyes bu ji ltar 'byung : bdag cag rnams la legs par rgya cher gsungs bar zhu: de nas ma hā gu ru pad+mas bka' stsal pa: nyon cig chos rgyal mtsho rgyal nam snying yid la zungs ma 'ongs las can dam pa de yi gdung 'dzin pa: gnubs ban ma/rgya ye shes yang sprul skyes bu ni: 276ming gis zab gter 'di yi brgyud pa 'dzin: de la 'brel tshad yang dag sa la 'dren par nus:18

gang zag dgos lung /sprul pa yang sprul 'gro don dpag med nus pa 'byung : gzhan yang las can chos bdag skyes bu 'di ltar 'byung ཿ mnga' bdag khyod kyi sprul pa mdo khams smad phyogs su: purkye'i ming can 'brug lugs bstan 'dzin skyes bu dang : yang gsang bla sgrub phyi nang gsang ba'i chos 'phrod na: 'gro don mtha' rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs kyang srid klu sgrub sprul pa ār+ya'i ming can lho zla'i rgyud: zla ngom 'dus mdor 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dang : 'phrad na mdo sngags bstan pa mkha' la nyi ltar shar: nam snying sku sprul khams kyi phyogs nas sprul pa'i sku: ngag dbang ming can mdo sngags zung gi bstan pa 'dzin pad+ma nga nyid bod khams dngos su 'ong dang mtshungs: khams phyogs bde skyid chos kyi nyi ma shar bar 'gyur: gnas mchog khro rgyal zil khram gangs ri'i g.yon zhol du bhi ma mi tra'i yang sprul gsang sngags rnal 'byor pa pad+ma'i mtshan gyis nga yi bstan pa spel bar byed: de yi skye brgyud rim bzhin 'gro don 'byon par 'gyur: mdo khams shar phyogs a zhes bya ba'i lung mda' phu 'om bhi he ru'i dngos sprul chos kyi ming can zhig: 'byung nas bka' brgyud bstan 19

gang zag dgos lung /pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs mthar tshugs: spyan ras gzigs dbang gsung gi sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pa: sa/lhanaming can phyogs med rgyal khams sprul bsgyur pa'i: thugs rje chen po'i 'gro don rlabs chen spyod par 'gyur: de la bskur 'debs gshe 'bar bar chad rlung ltar 'tshubs: yang cig spyan ras gzigs dbang phrin las sprul pa ni: rnal 'byor tshul bzung byang chub ming can skyes bu zhig:chu bo gser ldan can gyi 'gram du 'byung bar 'gyur: yig drug chos kyis 'gro kun thar lam 'khod par 'gyur 'bri rgyud sham zhes bya ba'i grong khyer nang phyogs su: gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dngosasprul skyesabu zhigaḥ saman+ta'i ming can mdo sngagasazung gi bstan pa skyong ཿ 'brel tshad don ldan shar phyogs 'gro ba thar lam 'godaḥkhams kyi na bun rdzong gi nye ba'i sa phyogs suḥ da lta'i sog po lha dpal gyi ni sprul pa ni: rgyal po'i ming can mdo sngags bstan pa 'dzin par byed: zab gter 'di rnams 'phrod na tshe'i 'phrang las sgrol: o rgyan nga nyid dmyal smad lha rjer sprul pa'i dus: rjes 'jug slob ma ma nges pa yi sprul pa zhig gter gnas rgyam rgyal rdo thi 20

gang zag dgos lung /gangs dkar byang ngos su: gnas mchog sgron ma brag gi nye phyogs sa cha n+da/ bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin nyi ma'i ming can skyes bu 'byung :de la tshe sgrub 'dus pa bskor gsum chos 'phrod na: 'gro don mthar phyin bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs kyang srid: dbus kyi phyogs nas dharma na tha'i mtshan 'dzin pa'i gsang bdag sprul pa 'brug lugs chos 'dzin skyes bu la: gsang bdag dregs pa 'joms byed chos 'di 'phrod gyur na: mdo sngags bstan pa yun ring dag tu gnas par 'gyur: spyan ras gzigs sprul rgyal ba mchog dbyangs nyid kyi ni: sprul pas 'gro ba ma lus thar lam 'god par nus: dngos sprul brgyad dang yang sprul lnga ru 'byung bar 'gyur 'bri brgyud bo dhi'i mtshan can chu lug lo pa dang : zab chos 'gro drug gsal byed 'phags pa'i chos 'phrad na: gdul bya 'gro don bod khams yongs la khyab par 'gyur: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa kirti'i ming can gyis skye ba bdun pa mdo khams smad phyogs 'byung bar 'gyur:skal bzang mtshan can skyes bu dam pa de nyid la: zab don khyad 'phags gter chos 'di rnams 'phrad gyur na: 'dul ba'i bstan 21

gang zag dgos lung /pa mkha' la rta bdun shar 'dra 'byung : byams pa'i sprul pa lcags mo lug gi lo pa zhig: don grub ming can bal po'i phyogs su 'ong bar 'gyur: de la yang gsang chos 'di 'phrod na 'gro don 'byung :kram zhes sa char nam mkha'i ming can skyes bu 'byung : de la zab chos 'phrod na 'gro don rgya cher 'ong : 'bri rgyud jo zhes bya bar dpa' bo'i mtshan can skyes bu la: zab don snying po rin chen phag mo'i chos 'phrod na bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yun ring tshugs par 'gyur: mdo khams a mṛ ta zhes bya ba'i sa cha n+da/ las ldan skyes bu zung gsum khyad 'phags 'byung bar 'gyur: de la tshe sgrub zhi khro'i chos 'di 'phrad gyur na: 'gro don mtha' rgyas bstan pa yun ring gnas par 'gyur: shar phyogs ge 'phen zhes byar mchog sprul skyes bu zhig: de la zab chos zhi khro 'di nyid 'phrod gyur na:'gro don mthar phyin bstan pa tshugs pa'i skal yod cing : 'on kyang bar chad bdud dbang rkyen gyis bsgyur yang srid: ka zhes bya bar gsang sngags bstan 'dzin skyes bu ni: gsang bdag sprul pa bstan pa'i bdag po 'byung bar 'gyur: de la zab chos 'di rnams ma lus 22

gang zag dgos lung /'phrod gyur na: mdo khams smad du gsang sngags bstan pa yun ring tshugs: da lta'i ldan ma rtse mang yang sprul 'bri rgyud du dkar po'i sa la tshul khrims ming can lo tsā yis: rgyal ba'i bka' la dag ther byed nus skyes bu 'byung : ngor gyi phyogs su spyan ras gzigs sprul mkhan chen ni: purje'i ming dang dpal ldan mtshan can skyes bu 'byung :de gnyis kyis ni zab chos nyams len bya'i gyur na: mdo sngags chos srid bstan pa yun ring gnas par 'gyur: chos blon sba mi khri bzher skye ba'i tha ma zhig: shar phyogs rdo zhes bya ba'i yul phyogs de nyid du: kirti'i ming can 'dul ba'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'byung :de la tshe sgrub phyi nang gsang ba'i chos 'di sprod bar chad 'dud kyi dbang du shor bar ma gyur na: rten 'brel rabs 'grigs gyur na gter sgo 'byed kyang srid: shar phyogs rgyal khams zab mo'i chos la 'god par nus: 'bri brgyud gnas mchog gnyen dong zhes pa'i nye phyogs su sbas pa'i tshul can las ldan skyes bu zhig 'byung nas:zab mo'i gter chos 'di rnams nyams su blang nas kyang : de la 'brel tshad yang dag sa la 'god par nus: thil khrom g.yon phyogs 23

gang zag dgos lung /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zhig 'byung nas yang gsang zab chos nyams su blang bar byed par 'gyur: de la 'brel tshad rnga yab nga yi drung khrid nus gling yul yi ge drug pa'i nub ngos nye phyogs su: bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin las can skyes bu zung zhig 'byung : rten 'brel ma log zab chos zhi khro 'di 'phrod na 'gro don mthar rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par 'gyur: 'on kyang bar chad bdud dbang rkyen gyis bsgyur yang srid smar yul phyogs nas phun tshogs ming can skyesabu 'byung :rdo yi phyogasasu mgon zhes bya ba'i sprul sku 'byung :ge sar gling yul na tha'i ming gi sbyin bdag 'byung : gzhan yang zab chos 'di skor rnamasakyi chosabadag ni: brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'dzam gling bod khams phyogs su gnas: de rnams kun gyis zab chos nyams len brtson gyur na: sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs mthar khyab cing yun ring gnas bdud sprul rgya hor sog dmag la sogasabazlog par nus bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyang yun ring sku tshe brtan:'gro ba sems can bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 'gyur gal srid bar chad dam sri bdud kyis dbang bsgyur nas: chos bdag rnams 24

gang zag dgos lung /dang zab gter ma 'phrad lus srid na: gsang sngagasabastan pa nyams zhing bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams: 'phral du sku gshegs rdo rje nang dme 'byung bar dang : skye 'gro bde ba'i skabs bral nad mtshon mu ge dang : lo nyes nor phyugs god cing mi rung sna dgu 'byung : de rnams dam sri bdud dbang che ba'i rtsal las byung : e ma dus ngan snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: chos bye da bla ma'i ngo so sa bas dma' bar 'gyur zog po bdud sprul rnams la bkur sti byed pa dang : chos byed tshe thung sdig can rlung rta dar bar 'gyur 'gro phan zab chos mi dar bslu chos dar bar 'gyur: bzang spyod yal cing ngan spyod ma lus dar ba dang : mtha' dmag dbusa'aphyur rgya mi dag gis bzung bar 'gyur: chos gzugs 'ga' yis zab chos rnams la bzo bcos byed: de yi rkyen gyis chos kyi byin rlabs sum cha yal:bsgrubs kyang rtags dang mtshan ma gang yang 'byung mi 'gyur: mi rnams shi tshad phal cher 'dre ru 'gyur ba dang : mi ma yin gyis nyin dkar ku co sgra 'byin 'byung : bran gyisadapon byed dpon gyisagayog po byed par 'gyur: mthu gtad mnan bsreg dug gis gsod res 25

gang zag dgos lung /byed pa dang : gnas dgon yul sde kun kyang nang 'khrug 'byung bar 'gyur bdud sprul ser gzugs 'ga' yis yang gsang zab chos dang : gsang sngags zab mo'i chos la than du blta bar 'gyur: de la kha lag 'brel tshad na raka nges par lhung : nam mkha' khrag mdog skar ma mjug ring yang yang 'char: sa yi bcud nyams lo thog 'bru rigs bungs mi skye: sad dang ser ba btsa' dang 'bu rigs byi char 'babs: mgo bskor mkhan gyi grub brdzu mang po 'byung ba dang :zhig po zhig mo the'u rang dam srir brdzus pa 'ong : gter min gter 'dra'i bslu chos 'ga' zhig 'byung nas su: zab gter 'di yi 'gro don lan gcig 'gogs kyang srid: ma 'ongs bskal pa de ltar ma lus 'byung bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: yang cig 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis rje la 'di skad zhus: ma 'ongs dus su ngan spyod de dag bzlog thabs dang : mdo sngags bstan pa mi nub yun ring tshugs thabs dang : sems can bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i thabs gsungs zhu: de nas ma hā gu ru pad+mas bka' stsal pa phyi rabs dus ngan de dag bzlog pa'i thabasayod kyang : bdud sprul ser gzugs 'ga' 26

gang zag dgos lung /yis dbang bsgyur byed nas kyang : yang gsang chos la than du lta ba'i dus 'byung bas : sems can bsod nams dman pas thabs dang bral bar 'gyur: 'on kyang las can skyes bu 'ga' yi sgrub nus na zab chos skor rnams rtags mtshan ma thon bar du sgrubs: las mtha' gtor bzlog mnan bsregs 'phang ba'i 'khrul 'khor bskor sde brgyad khengs mdos cha gsum chad tho'i tha tshig bsgrags bsang mchod brngan dang bdud rtsi gser skyems chu gtor bsngo: bum gter sba dang ri khrus yul lha'i rten mkhar dang : rgyal ba'i bka' klogs pad+ma'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus sgrogs: rdo la rigs gsum pad+ma'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang : ri brag kun la rigs gsum bsnyen pa sirnyi brko: ri rgya rlung rgya rlung rta dar lcog gang 'grub 'grugs: de ltar byas na mtha' dmag re zhig bzlog pa dang : mdo sngagasabastan pa yun ring ma lus gnas pa dang : der 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyang sku tshe brtan pa dang : yul gyi sa skyong rnams kyang bstan pa tshugs pa dang : yul mi kun kyang bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba dang : lo 'bras legs shing nor phyugs nad rnams zhi bar 'gyur char chu dus 27

gang zag dgos lung /'babasa'abyung ba'i g.yo 'khrugs kun zhi nas: 'gro kun lan gcig bde zhing skyid pa'i skal pa 'byung : ma hā gu rus de skad ma lus bka' stsal nas: 'dus 'khor kun kyang dga' zhing mgu nas bstod pa byas pad+ma'i bka' lung gang zag dgos kyi lung bstan pa nyi zla'i 'khor lo zhes pa'i zab gnad khyad 'phags pa'i g.yin la rlung phyogs tsam yang bstan par ma byed cig: gal srid slob ma khyad 'phags re tsam ma gtogs par: gcig brgyud ma gtogs g.yin la ma spel sa mā ya: dam nyams bdud sprul bskul 'debs mkhan gyis mthong gyur na: dpal mgon me dbal bstan srung 'bar ba spun gsum gyis myur du srog chod snying khrag thang la 'pho bar gyis:phyi ma mnar med rdo rje'i dmyal bar lhung bar nges: de phyir 'di nyid shin tu gsang bar bya ba gces: sa mā ya: rgya rgya rgya gter rgya:sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: 3ni: : rgya: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin 'jigs med rdo rje rtsal gyis mdor stod gyi brag rin chen spungs 'dra nas lcags pho byi ba'i lor gdan drangs ba'o: shog ser las brdar lung dpal gyi phug tu zhal bshus so: sarba maṅga lo: :28

pad+ma'i zhal lung /(ga)5yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub thabs rgyal ba kun 'dus las pad+ma'i zhal lung gter ston rang gi yang byang lung bstan bzhugs so:ga/yog/golen//lha 'dren mchog mgon po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo:bdag 'dra rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs skal ldan the tshom sel ba'i phyir:pha yis bu la zhal chems yi ger bkod:dam par sgrom du bcug la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs dus ngan sum cu kha ral dus: nga yi gter la spyod pa'i skal ldan ni:mdo khams rdza zhes bya ba'i chu chen rgyud brag ri phye mar bshams 'dre'i g.yas phyogs su shar bltas grong khyer stod du skye ba len:29

pad+ma'i zhal lung /sa stag mtho pa byams sems snying rje ldan: su dang 'phrad kyang dul nyams spyod pa zhib: nyon mongs khong khro mi ldang chos la dad: brla g.yas dpe yi mtshan rtags yi ge e: brla g.yon mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags yi ge 2: dus kun nga la mos shing gsol ba 'debs:phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel legs 'grigs na: bco lnga'i 'e1 la rang speru'abrag ri nas: zab mo'i gter gyi kha byang thon gyur na:'dul bya 'gro don nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: stod hor gdug pa'i dmag dpung bzlog pa yi: yi dam zhi khro'i dkyir 'khor nyer lngar dbang : chos bdag lnga brgya las can khri phrag gcig: 'brel thob bye ba thar pa'i lam sna drongs: de dus zab gter ma phyed lus gyur na nyer gsum lo ru zhu zaganas: zab gter kha byang lde'u mig lon gyur na: yang gsang dkyil 'khor bcu yi gter la dbang :gzhan dbang song na 'gro don ngang gis 'gogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel rang 'grigs na: 'gro don bod yul khams la rgyas par 'byung : chos bdag nyer lnga las can stong rtsa gcig: 'brel thob bye ba thar ba'i lam la bkod: dus rim sa gnad gso ba'i 30

pad+ma'i zhal lung /bcos 'grub na: stod hor lo grangs drug cur bzlog kyang srid: de dus zab gter ma phyed lus gyur na: sum cu'i lo la sprom gyi brag dkar nas: kha byang lde'u mig lung bstan lon gyur na yi dam dkyir 'khor gsum gyi gter la dbang : 'gro don shag shog gter gnas phyogs re 'byung : chos bdag lnga brgya skal ldan brgya phrag lnga: 'brel thob 'dren pa khri phrag bcu gsum 'byung : rong chen bzhi ru mtha' dmag re zhig bzlog: yun du mi gnas pad+ma 'od du bgrod:de ni rten 'brel rab 'bring tha ma gsum nyer gsum lo ru zab gter thon gyur na: de dus bslab bya'i zhal chems 'di la ltos:pha yul ma sdod lung bstan gnas su song : tshong khe ma spog yul pa bsod snyoms gyis: phyugs nor ma bsogs sdod pa'i mkhar ma brtsigs: khe drag ma che dma' sa sprang ltar sdod: gnyen dang nye 'brel brtse gdung ma byed par: gar song cha med yul la sgrub pa 'bungs:gnyen la brtse gdung byas na chos kyi gegs: dgra la ya bo ma bzung bzod pa sgoms: kun la brtse sems snying rje che bar gyis:grong chog 'dre brdung ma byed sri'u ma gso: 'khor slob rnam mang 'gal 31

pad+ma'i zhal lung /ba'i grogs ma brten: g.yog 'khor mang na 'dod pa je cher 'gro:de bas rang nyid gcig pur chos la spyod gzhan dbang ma brten rang thag rang gis chod: che 'dod dpon gyis bla mchod byas gyur kyang : yun du ma 'grogs 'gro don 'gog pa'i rgyu grong nag ma brten bag med chang ma btung : 'gro don chang rjes 'brang zhing spyod ngan 'go: rig ldan lung mthun las rgya ma yin pa'i: gzhan gyi bzhin bzang bud med bsten gyur na: rang gis rang nyid 'khor bar bskyur ba'i rgyu legs pa gang byas nyes pa ltar du 'ong : che 'dod can gyis chos bdag yin zer ba'i lung du ma bstan tshur la bsnyeg mkhan yod: de dang ma 'brel gdams ngag sbyin mi rung :slob ma'i rigs brgyud lo gsum ma brtags par gter rnams bkram du ma bstan gud du sbas: rim bzhin 'khel smad skud pa ltar du gyis: gzhan gyis legs zhes pra mo phab gyur kyang : ma mthong mi shes gyis la ma smra cig: de ltar smras rung zad pa ma yod kyang :dus ngan 'dre gdon glags lta cher rags pas: rkyen ngan bar chad dbang du 'gro nyen yod zab pa'i gter sgo 'byed pa'i dus su yang :32

pad+ma'i zhal lung /skal ldan lung mthun re re ma gtogs par: kun gyis mthong sar khrom gter byas gyur na: gdug pa'i 'dre srin rnams kyis bar chad 'ong : legs pa ltar byas mi rung sna tshogs btang : de yang sems la pra mo phab par gces: gter gyi kha byang lung bstan phyi nang rnams:bzang bstod ngan smad 'bab pa'i tshig mang bas: gzhan la ma ston rang gi blo thabs dril: rgyud lung bka' dbang zhu ba'i slob dpon ni:pra mo sems phobs lung bstan nang du ltos: de la ma bab bla ma slob dpon la: dbang bskur gdams ngag ma 'brel thabs kyis byol:'di dus dam tshig ldan pa'i slob dpon ni: dper na nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon: dam nyams bdud sprul gang du ma rung ba: thams cad dus der nyi zer rdul ltar 'tshubs: nga min nga 'dras sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig: bdud dang rgyal 'gong dam sris dbang byed nas kha rje dbang thang bsod nams de rnams che: bya spyod zhib zhib bzang bzang 'dra na yang : kha 'jam mi thabs byed cing zas nor bsdu: mi kha bcad pa'i byas chos ma gtogos pa'i sems kyis khrol ba'i khab skud btang mi nus dud 'gro re la srog btsang thub pa yi:33

pad+ma'i zhal lung / de 'dra'i bla ma dus der 'bu ltar g.yengs dkor 'byams 'dre brdung sngags bzlas ma gtogs pa'i: bstan don mdo tshar gcig kyang med pa yis: de 'dra'i dge bshes yin zer tshogs dbang bskur dam tshig mi ngo bsrungs nas ngur smig gyon lkog tu bud smad khyi phag tsam yang spyod: kha la nyan na sman gyi lo 'dab shar:khong du dug nag ha la 'khyil 'dra yi: ya tshul can gyi bla ma'i ming can mang : gang la gangs seng dkar mo 'dra ba yi: sprul pa yin zer zog po khyu mang 'byung : rang rgyud ma grol gzhan la chos bshad byed: 'od gsal stong nyid snying po ma rtogs pa'i rig pa btson bzung blun bsgom 'chad mkhan mang : gsog 'jog ser sna che zhing 'dre brdung byed: gnod byed phan byed gnyis ka kho rang ste: tshe 'di'i 'phral rkyen sel bar 'dra ba 'byung : rang 'dre rang phung byed pa'i dam log la kun gyis blo snying brang gsum de la gtad: dus 'dir mi 'dod ngan dgu de yis len: la la bya btang tshul bzung sa mthar 'grim la la dge bshes tshul bzung sdom pa nod la la bla ma'i tshul bzung khrom dbang bskur: la la sngags pa'i tshul bzung sngags 34

pad+ma'i zhal lung /'chol spyod la la bka' bab yin zer chos rnams bslad la la dpon gyi tshul bzung zhabrug rtsod byed la la dge slong tshul bzung dmag dpon byed la la'i khog tu rgya 'dre the'u rang zhugs: nga yi sa bcud gter rnams bslong zhing 'don la la sde brgyad srog yig mnan pa 'don: la la lha min lha ru brdzu bar byed byad gtad 'don zer yul 'ga' 'khrug gzhi byed: de ltar bdu da 'gong sprul pas sa steng khyab: bdag gis lung bstan gang zag phal cher dang :mdang sum skyes pa'i byis pa yan chad kyis: bzang spyod mi dad ngan pa'i spyod la dad: da ltar rgya bod paṇa grub thams cad kyis dka' spyad snying rus sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan dang : rdzu 'phrul 'od lus 'gro don stobs la 'gran: ma 'ongs gang zag ming can de rnams kyis:rgyan cha lus rgyan rgya dang hor gyi lugs: pho khrom khyu bskor zhwa gra gos gra bsgrigs: rta drel 'gros mkhan khyu chen gang mang dang : phyugs nor grangs dang gser dngul gang phyug dang : mtha' dbus tshong gi khe spog gang mang 'dren: gsang sngags nang gi sbyor sgrol la sogs pa: snod min mthong thos mi nyan rigs dag rnams: mngon du khrom 35

pad+ma'i zhal lung /'don gyer zhing rol dbyangs dang : 'cham gyi gra bsgrig mi nag pho mo bsdu: bha ling shing byed dam rdzas 'chol bar spyod: de ltar byas pas chose kyi byin rlabs cha sum gnyis yal bas bsgrub kyang 'grub par dka' gang zag ming can de dag thams cad spang : dper na ri mo bris pa'i nyi zla bzhin: mig la mdzes kyang mun gling mi gsal ltar: rdzu 'phrul mngon shes gzhan rgyud shes dka' zhing : rang la legs nyes gang 'byung mi shes par gzhan la legs nyes gang 'byung lung bstan ston: thog mi khel bas phal cher dad log gnas:gang zag de rnamasa'akhor slob mang la 'gran res 'ga' ma gartags phal cher bdud sprul mang : mdo yi sdom pa sngags kyi dam tshig nyams: de rnams 'chi khar smon lam log pa 'debs thams cad dam sri rgyal 'gong lus su len: bstan 'dzin sku tshe thung ba'i sri yang byed: dge 'dun nang zhabrug 'byung ba'i sri yang byed sde dgon 'thor nyams 'byung ba'i sri yang byed nang 'khrug mtha' dmag 'byung ba'i sri yang byed: lo nyes mu ge 'byung ba'i sri yang byed bud med 'chi tshad bsen mo'i rigs su gyur: rgyal bsen phal cher 36

pad+ma'i zhal lde/nga / bsdebs pas 'gro ba'i srog la rgol: 'di dus grub mtha' mi mthun so so dang : mthun kyang nga rgyal che 'gran phrag dog gis ngan sngags gzir bod mnan gtad sna tshogs byed sde brgyad nang 'khrug mi mthun glo bur 'beb: dge 'dun nang 'khrug phal cher gri ru 'chi:spyod ngan rang spyod kha nas dus ngan zer: de 'dra 'dul phyir zab pa'i gter chen 'di: gser sbrul khung nas thon ltar rim bzhin spyod: sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gro la phan thog 'ong : bstan pa mar me rgas kha'i 'od ltar gsal: mdo sngags bstan pa yun ring dar bar 'gyur: zhes slob dpon chen po'i gsung bzhin: bdag 'dra shang glang po sgang gi bu mo shel dkar bza' rdo rje mtshos shog ser ngosasu yi ger btab pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: snod ldan ma gtogs gzhan gyis mthong mi rung bka' rgya yod gter ston rig 'dzin 'jigs med nus ldan rdo rje rtsal gyis: mdor stod kyi brag ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba nas gter nas gdan drangs pa'o: shog ser las ser sgom g.yung drung phug pa ru zhal bshus so: bkra shiba'idapal 'bar 'dzam gling khyab cing dar bar gyur cig: sarba maṅga lo:37

ma 'ongs lung bstan/(nga )43 tshe sgrub 'chi med lcags rdzong las ma 'ongs lung bstan gsal byed shel gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs dren:ma thalton rnags gnas mtshungs med mtsho chen klong gi dbus:yab rgyal ba'i pha mtha' nam mkha'i mdangs: yum pad+ma ge sar gsal mdangs can sras mthu stobs nus ldan he ru da: 'gro 'dam snyog gi srin bu nyam dman la: mgon dam pas brtse bas myur gzigs mdzod dus bzhi bcu'i mtha' 'das sum cu'i dus: sa mi rtag sa g.yo ri bo 'gul: gnam mi rtag than gyi 'od chen 'phen: bar mi rtag lha srin pho mo 'khrug: chus mi rtag dmag dang 'brug rtsod byed:39

ma 'ongasalung bstan/lus mi rtag bcos med nad kyis gum zog mi rtag dgra yisamatshar zas byed: grog bsogs pa'i skye bo ltogs pas gum zob rdzun gyi slob dpon dad gus byed bstan 'gro phan gyi skyes bu gshe skur 'debs: chos tshul bzhin spyod pa sa mthar 'khyams: chos 'dul bar mthun pa'i dge slong ni: phag nag po'o mgo yi rwa co bzhin:gter shwa lo ka gcig med pa yi gter ston gyi ming thog 'bu bzhin g.yengs dam chos kyi rin thang sabasalod skyesachen gyi nor mchog mtshon cha bsogs: hor chas byed cing dug zas gsol las mi de rnams kyi byas tshul gyis: dus 'khrugs pa'i gzhi ma de nas 'byung :sprel shing gi rtse nas phyogs bzhir blta byas gnam 'phang gcod cing bya ra byed khyi nag pos sngags pa rgas por sdang : rje pad 'byung sku gsung thugs rten rnams: dgrar mthong nas me chu rlung la bskur:dmar po ri yi dar chen chag: byang phyogs nas lasakyi rlung nag g.yo:bod khams la bde ba sbu tsam med: shar mi nag snying nas rlung nag lang : shar lho nas me'i ral pa bsigs: shar stod nas bskal pa'i chu chen 'brug dmar po ri dang 'phrul mkhar bar mi rus 40

ma 'ongasalung bstan/kyi lam chen rdza bas 'jigs gnyen thang lha keng rus kyi ra bar tshud: phag ngur sgra 'byin nas thog mda' 'phen: byi bas sa phug ri bo thal bar gtor: thal dkar glang gis phyogs mtshams kun tu blta stag la bde tshig gcan gzan rwa dang 'dra yos kyi lo la byang shar mtshon char 'bebs bod khams thams cad mi bde zang ma zing : grangs mi lang gi dmag ni chu bzhin 'brub: 'brug gi sgra skad gnam sa gnyis kyang ngur: sprul nag mdo khams stod nas smad phyogs 'khyil: rta mchog phyogs mtshams rgyug nas kun la 'dren: lug dag spre'u 'dab chag bya lo la 'chi kha'i nad pa mal gsocung bde ltar: zang ma zing la phyogs mtshams kun nasa'agyings:lcags khyi'i lo la phyogs mtshams thams cad nas: dmag rigs mi 'dra ser chen 'bab pa 'dra mang ba'i grangs ni nyi zer rdul 'tshubs 'dra: 'jigs pa'i tshad ni gzhin rje'i 'dun sa 'dra:'dzam gling mi 'dra lha min grong khyer 'dra: mya ngan che ba dmyal ba'i sems can 'dra: chosasems med pa bdud kyi yul dang 'dra: 'dzam gling sum gnyis 'joms zhing gtan nas brlag bod khams mi 41

ma 'ongs lung bstan/rnams gri mtshon kha ru 'gro khyad par gsang sngags 'chang dang chos pa'i rigs bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad sku rkyen che: de ltar 'dul ba'i skal pa bdag yin pas: de tshe bzlog pa'i rim pa 'di 'bad 'os: gtsang chen phyogs yo rgyangs nas brtsegs ra bzhin:thad sor slebs na bzlog pa ga la nus mdo khams stod smad sa yi mdo rnams la: 'byung ba bzhi mdog pad 'byung sku gzugs ni:stong phrag brgya phrag tshang ba'i mchod rten bzhengs pad 'byung yang snying dar lcog phyogs mdog can: phyogs bzhir 'dzugs cing ri ngos brag rdo dang : khyad par sa gnyan rdo gnyan nag phyogs sar:badz+ra gu ru ci mang 'bri brko bya: yar mar tshes bcur spros bcas spros med dang : snying po 'ur 'don bsam pa lhun 'grub dang : khyad par yang gsang drag po khros chen mdos:rdor phur gar khug dmag bzlog mtshon 'khor sogs: de sogs dus 'dir bsngags pa'i bzlog rim bya: bstan 'dzin nges pa'i skyes bu yod nges na rang rang rnams kyis 'di la brtson par mdzod: sa mā ya rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa dus kyi lung bstan 'di ni rgyam rgyal rdo thi gangs dkar gyi byang ngos ga nam 42
rnyu na gyartsi 4rtso glo44 ༅tshe/14 ste //'i( 444thozug zhu/ljagazhugalta sku ))kyi ni/////777777༷potho 435ཿཿr+sāḥ rterno

(ca)/zab chos zhi khro sku gsum don gyi snying po las:kha byang snying gi me long dang : lung bstan gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so: lken yo6nya/lha/ga//thanagarlang sku gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: zhi khro sku gsum snying po yi: kha byang snying gi me long bstan: lung pa nub phyogs nyang khogs su dge bsnyen ge 'dzo'i ston gnas kyi ri bo khyung rtse'i g.yon zhol du brag la yig drug rang byon yod: yi ge drug pa'i 45

lung bstan gsal sgron/g.yon phyogs su pad+ma bdag gi phyag rjes yod: de nas gyen du mjal ba na: brag la 'khor lo'i ri mo yod: de nyid bskos na rdza sgrom gcig: mi 'jigs rgya rtsis gdams pa yod: gter bdag dam can btsan rgod la: bsang gsur dkar gtor dag gis mchod:bdag la gsol ba snying nas thob: rten 'brel thang gsum ma log par: snying stobs bskyed la gsang gter gyis: su 'grogs yon tan mi 'byung bas rang nyid lkog nor ltar du spyod: mdun nas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs: rgyab nas 'bar sha shib shib 'byung :de dus bzod pa'i go cha gyon: 'gro 'dug spyod lam thams cad du:thugs mchog gtum po'i bsnyen sngags ni: rtags mtshan ma rdzogs bar du bsgrang : lha sras mjing yon sad na legs: skyes mtha'i sbyin bdag nye phyogs 'byung : phan tshun tshe dpal ri dben du sgrub sde tshugs na mas na 1theyochog rigs gsum mgon po'i gter gnas su: gnam lcags phur bu khru gang dang : zi k+ṣ-i las grub rdo rje yod:rten 'brel byung na 'don par bya: da lta'i gson 'dre stag re ma'i:sprul pa bud med gcig 'byung bas: de yi bar chad glags lta 'tshe:46

lung bstan gsal sgron/de la rta mgrin bsnyen sngags gzir khyed kyis 'gro don lan gcig 'gogs: khyad par chos 'di'i bdag po ni: gdugs thogs seng khri ldan pa bdun dge slong khrims ldan nyer lnga 'byung : 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams: dgos lung nyi zla'i 'khor lo ltar:legs par brtags la chos 'di spel: skal ldan de rnams gang 'phrod kyang : 'gro don mtha' rgyas sras ltar brtse nyi shar dbyug pas mi khog go: bka' rgya grol nas rtags byung tshe: gter sgrub rgyal ba kun 'dus dang : yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi: zhag bdun bsgrub la tshogs 'khor bshams shog ser ma rnams rim bzhin bshus pad 'byung dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed: zla ba ma 'gyangs myur du bris: rang gi 'chang ba ma gtogs par gter tshab 'jog pa'i shog ser rigs: rang min gzhan gyis ma mthong gyis: bum gter 'bru sman dang bcas pa: shog ser dam rdzas sa sna sogs: chu thub snod du la chas gdams yi ge drug pa'i rgyab ngos supha waṃ rgya leb : sa la dong brus gdab par bya: zab gter 'don dus ma gtogs par rjes sor mi phyin gter gnas su: sngon 47

she lung bstan gsal sgron/ ma'i shog ser dam rdzas dang : rin chen 'bru sman tshab tu spos: de bzhin bka' ltar ma byas na: yul phyogs de yi sa bcud nyams:mi dge'i rtags rnams 'phral du 'byung : kun gyis gshe bskur log lta 'byung : glo bur rkyen ngan 'tshe ba 'ong thabs la mkhas pas byol ba gces: tshe tshad drug cu re gcig ste: bar chad 'phrang dgu dag la rtsub: gsang tshig sba spyod sba 'os rnams rkun nor lta bur spyod cing sbas: gsang ba'i gter dang dgos ched rnams: drang por ma smra sprul lce ltar gsang ba'i don du gnyis su smros: sngon gyi smon lam gnad nyes pas dbang dang chose 'brel zhus pa rnams log lta the tshom yang yang 'byung : de dus bzod pa'i go cha gyon: stong pa nyid kyi rgya yis thob: kun la dag snang ldan par gyis: rang rang grub mtha' dam tshig dang : lung du bstan pa ma gtogs pa'i: gzhan la dbang dang phyag ma 'tshal zab pa'i gter 'di 'don pa'i sa rtags ni: hor khrims 'jig cing rgya yis dbang yang bsgyur chos rgyal gdung chad 'bang gis sde pa byed: /po'isgoris mes skyong ba'i sde cacagacig byung na 'gro ba cung zad bde bar gnas mi dge 48

lung bstan gsal sgron/bcu la spyod pa'i las 'brel gyis bod kyi bsod nams mnga' thang mar mar 'grib: chos byed gang zag thams cad sku tshe thung : sdig can chos log ston mkhan rlung rta dar: de rnams nag po bdud phyogs dar bas 'byung : tshul ldan chos pa mi brin zog po brin: chos byed bla ma'i ngo so sa las dma' nor yod bla ma'i ngo so dgung bas mtho:bya btang zer zhing gzhan gyi mgo bskor mkhan: 'gro ba dbang bsdud bstan pa thabs kyis bsnubs: sems can skyid pa'i go skabs de dus med phru rlog gang la thug par sdug las 'bad: 'on kyang mu ge'i gdung bas mi thog bud gza' dang skar ma dus su mi 'phrod pas gtsug lag rtsis kyis 'gro bar phan mi thogs sde brgyad ma mo zhabrugasapa'i kha rlang gis: sngar ma dar ba'i nad rigs mang 'byung bas: me chu go log sman gyis phan mi thogs: phyugs kyi khyu mang ma nges skye ba'i rgyu: zas sgom bza' btung za thang mar mar bri: sngar gyi bstan bzhigs rang 'dod rten bzo byed: de nas 'gro ba'i bsod nam mar mar 'gribs: dge chos sems can srog gcod ston mo byed: byi bras yul 'don ri bya klung du bab stag gzig byang bzung 49

lung bstan gsal sgron/ byang g.yag rong du bab: lo nad sna dgu 'bu srin byi'us 'tshe: pho rnams tshe thung yug sa'i khyu chen 'byung : shi ba'i mi rnams thams cad 'dre ru 'gyur: shi 'dre gson 'dres 'gro ba'i tshe srog 'phrogs: mi ma yin gyis nyin mtshan co sgra sgrog: sa bdag klu gnyan 'khrugs pas sa g.yo 'byung : sde brgyad 'khrugs pas thog dang ser ba rgod: rlung 'tshubs chu smyo grong 'ga' gtan nas stong : glad med zhwa gyon lung med dbang bskur byed: thob med dpon byed phug med gtam mang 'don: srub med gos gyon so med mtshon gyis gsod: mi skyas ngur smig gos gyon ser chas byed: rab byung rnams kyis skya chas byed:bstan 'dzin rnams kyis grong yul 'grim: lha ma byi phos dgon gnas bzung : gsang sngags 'chol bas khrom du bsgrag dam tshig mi yi ngo ru bsrung : bla ma khri pa'i tshul can rnams: khog tu rgyal 'gong dam sris rlom: mthu gtad mnan pa'i 'brul 'khor gyis:rang gzhan phung ba'i las ka byed: 'di phyi gnyis ga med par 'gyur:mi dpon rnams gyi khog tu ni: rgyal 'gong the'u rang zhugs byas nas:phyogs gyi mi dpon kha 'og btsud: 'phral du mtho mtho 'dra na yang :50

lung bstan gsal sgron/phugs su rang chus brlag par byed: dgon sde brnye'i khog tu ni: rgyal 'gong dam sri zhugs nas kyang : chos kyi grub mtha' rtsod nas 'gran:dge 'dun gri khar 'chi bar gyur: de yis rkyen byas bod khams su:shi 'dre'i gnod pas yul 'ga' stong : zhig po zhig mo'i khog tu ni: the'u rang rgyal 'gong zhugs nas kyang : mnan gtad phung pa'i las byed nas: yul 'ga' 'khrug pa'i gzhi ma bting : rang gzhan phung ba'i rgyu ru 'gro: brnye bu mo'i khog tu ni: rgyal 'gong dam sri zhugs nas kyang : mngon shes yin zer mig 'phrul gyi rdzas byug mgo bskor grub thob mang : bod khams bsod nams dman stabs kyis: skye 'gro rnams kyis de la dad: bkur sti gang 'grub de la byed: bla ma gang bzang khyi ltar 'khyams: dam med bdud sprul seng ltar 'gyings: phas zer kha la bus mi nyan: dpon zer kha la bran mi nyan: dpon bsagayog ni dbang cher 'byung : sde brgyad 'khrugs pas yul khams su dmag 'khrug mang du 'byung bar 'gyur rgya 'dre 'gong po bod zhugs rtags: dbus su rgya yi dbang bsgyur bas:brnye btsun mas khrims mi thub: ma mo 'khrugs pa'i dbang gis ni:51

lung bstan gsal sgron/yams nad rims nad mang du 'byung : the'u rang skrun dgus dbang bsgyur bas: mi dbang rnams kyi gdung rabs chad: yams shud dmar pos dbang bsgyur bas: mi rnams mtshon grir 'chi bar 'gyur:srog bdag rgyal posadabang bsgyur bas brnye skyesapa bud med rnams:rang srog rang gis gcod par byed: gza' bdud rgyal pos dbang bsgyur bas nyi zla gza' yis bzung ba dang : gza' skar mi rung skyon can gyis: skye 'gro'i bla skar brlag nas su: mi phyugs glo bur hur thum 'chi: thog ser btsa' sad btang bar gyur klu rnams 'khrugs pas dbang bsgyur bas: char chu mi 'bab than pas gdung :rtswa kha lo rtag bsregs par byed: gnyan rnams 'khrugs pas dbang bsgyur bas: gnyan lhog 'brum bu me dbal dang : sa srin gnyan srin nad btang bas: sman dang bsrung bzlog gang gis yang : phan mi thog nasa'achi bar byed: gnod sbyin nor lha gud nas kyang : phyugs la god kha mi rung 'byung : 'o ma bshigs kyang mar chung ngo: zas rnams bcud med 'byung bar 'gyur yul lha gzhi bdag gud nas kyang : yul khams 'khrug cing sa bcud nyams rtswa dang lo thog 52

lung bstan gsal sgron/bungs mi skye dbyar dgun go ldog rlung lhag ldang : bod khams ltogasagrir 'chi bar byed bod khams bsod nams phyir gud rtags:lus rgyan gos sogs thams cad ni: ya ma zung du 'byung bar 'gyur:dus ngan sum cu kha ral dus: skye 'gro bde ba'i skal ba med: bzeng spyod na bun bzhin du yal: ngan spyod sprin bzhin gtibs par byed:de 'dra'i dus ngan byung ba'i tshe: nga sprul skal ldan bu yis ni: zab chos 'di nyid gdan drangs nas: skye 'gro bde ba'i bskal pa ni: sprin bar nyi zhar tsam zhig 'byung : kun gyis dad 'dun byed gyur na:g.yul 'khrug ngan spyod thams cad ni: mi rabs gcig la bzlog kyang srid: 'on kyang bdud sprul bla ma yi: tshul bzung gnyis gsum dag dang ni: stag ra'i sprul pa bud med kyis: tho 'tshams 'bar sha skur ba 'debs: phyi nang rten 'brel log kyang srid 'on kyang skal ldan re re yis: nyams su len par byed nas kyang : bstan dang 'gro la phan cher thogs: mthar thug 'og min zhing du bgrod: zab chos 'di nyid gar bzhugs sar: nad mtshon g.yul 'khrug lo nyes bzlog: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang : sems can bde skyid 53

lung bstan gsal sgron/'byung bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: zas chos zhi khro sku gsum yang snying gi: kha byang snying gi me long dang : lung bstan gsal ba'i sgron me 'di rje btsun ma hā gu ru la: gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po dang : bud med ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : rig ldan ḍāk+ki rdo rje mtsho:li za dpal sgron la sogs pa'i las ldan mang gis zhus pa'i lan:pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis gsungs: ma nor yi ger bris nas su: ma 'ongs don du mdo khams smad: gnas mchog yi ge drug pa'i brag:gter srung dam can nyid la gtad: las ldan bu la ma gsang gtod:dam nyams gter rkun srog dang phrol: bskur 'debs mkhan gyi dbang po bsnubs: 6yo 7gyi/gyi/rū ༈༈gleg /tharalhatshorig 7521rnyotherdzo47tharogathathanan /8na33tharathalbo/sga sa mā ya:rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin gar dbang nus ldan rdo rjes gling yul gnas mchog yi ge drug pa'i rgyab nas gdan drangs shing : zab yangs gsang sngags khang du rberteg ser las chos 'phel rgyal mtshos bod yig tu phab par byas so: sarba maṅga lo: dge'o:54

don gsal me long /(cha)/gsang bdag dregs pa 'jom byed las: ma 'ongs lung bstan don gsal snying gi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs tre(:snod ldan ma gtogs log lta mkhan la ston mi rung pa'i bka' rgya yod: na/shagam tharagyisamacolalha ོ min stonag lhathanagle'i/thanag〉thugs mchog rdo rje gtum po'i tshogs la 'dud: gnas mchog lho brag mkhar chu'i dben gnas su bdag 'dra gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po dang : dbyangs can sprul pa 55

don gsal me long /ye shesamatsho rgyal dang : rig ldan bu mo shel dkar rdo rje mtsho : gzhan yang las can pho mo mang po yis: kun gyis maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di skad zhus: kye ma ma hā gu ru rin po che: da lta'i dregs 'joms gtum po'i chosaskor 'di phyi rabs don phyir gakho du sbas nas su: 'don pa'i las can skyes bu ji ltar 'byung : de yi skye gnas 'byung khung gang na mchis: 'don pa'i dus su sa rtags ji ltar 'byung : las can skyes bu chos bdag ji ltar 'ong : bar chad brtsams mkhan bdud rigs ji ltar 'byung : dusagyi 'pho 'chug ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur:legs par bdag cag rnams la gsungs bar zhu: zhes zhus ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa: da lta'i dregs 'joms gtum po'i chos skor 'di: ma 'ongs don phyir smar khams shar ngos su gnyan chen ge 'dzo'i brag la gter du sbas gter srung dge bsnyen nyid la gnyer du gtad: 'don pa'i las can skyes bu zung gsum 'byung : bi ro 'khon chen klu dbang skyes mtha' yi: gter ston gnyis dang 'phrad na 'gro don ni: rab 'byung sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgron me shar bod khamasabade skyid ldan zhing mtha' dmag bzlog: yang na nam snying yon 56

don gsal me long /tan las sprul pa'i: skyes bu las can zhig dang 'phrad par 'gyur:de yi 'byung gnas mdo khams lho zla'i yul: brag ri phye mar bshams 'dra'i mdun ngosasu: chu bo dal 'bab g.yon ngosagrong khyer gyi: shar bltas grong stod dag tu 'byung bar 'gyur: glang ngam stag gi lo pa sbas tshul 'byung : bsod nams ming can lhag par nga la mos kun gyis blo dang mi mthun spyon spyod can: re ri cangaga' nges 'byung res 'ga' blun po'i tshul: ma nges spyod pas sna tshogs 'gro ba 'dul:smon lam mthu yis zab mo'i gter 'ga' 'byin: skyes bu de la bar chad cho 'phrul ldang : 'on kyang dam srir brdzus pa'i ser skya 'gas: la las gter min rdzun gter g.yo khram dang : 'bar sha mi kha sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs: ngos nas dad byed gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs: rgyab nas mi dad gshe bskur dad log byed la las bskur 'debs la las 'dul bya bsgags la las dug drang la las gsod shom byed: mdor na mi mthun pa yi las byed dus:de tshe sems zhum ma byed bzod par sgoms: gsol ba phur tshug ner tshug nga la thob: nga yi thugs rjes yang yang skyobs par 'gyur:57

don gsal me long /rten 'brel rab 'grigs zab gter thon gyur na: 'dulabya 'gro don bod khamasakhyab par 'byung : shar phyogasasmar yul lung gi dben gnas su: bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ma lusatshugs par 'gyur: 'dul bya 'gro don 'bring shos tsam du 'byung : las can chos bdag rnams dang chos 'phrod na: rang gzhan sku tshe bsringazhing mtha' dmag bzlog:bar chad bdud dbang bsgyur zhing ma 'phrod na: bar chad 'byung zhing sku tshe thung ba dang : nad mtshon g.yul 'khrug la sogs 'byung bar 'gyur: ma 'ongs las can skyes bu de nyid la: tshe 'phrang bar chad 'phrang gsum dag la rtsub: de dus zab chos sgrub pa rtags mtshan sgrub: sgo gsum ma yengs gsang bdag ting 'dzin bsgom: de ltar byas na drug cu rtsa gcig bar: bar chad bdud dang 'byungapos glags mi rnyed: mtha' dmag bzlog cing bod khams bde skyid ldan: sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' dbus nyi ltar gsal: de nyid mi rtag mya ngan 'das pa'i dus: 'ja' 'od zer dang rol mo'i sgrar bcas nas:tshe 'phos lcang lo can dang rnga yab gling : o rgyan nga yi drung du skye bar 'gyur: skye ba lnga la sprul pas 'gro don byed kha lag 'brel tshad 58

don gsal me long /sangs rgyas sa la 'khod: ma 'ongs las can de yi gzungs ma ni:rab ni 'tsho rgyal yang sprul zhig dang 'phrad: de dang 'grogs nas rten 'brel rab 'grigs na: lto zla'i phyogs su 'gro don rgya cher 'byung : 'bring ni shel dkar bza' yi sprul pa ni: bu med zhig dang 'phrad na rten 'brel ni: 'bring shos shar zla'i ngos su sgrub sde tshugs: phan tshun bar chad bdud dbang bsgyur srid na: 'dul bya 'gro don re zhig 'gogs par 'gyur: yang na li za dpal sgron skyes mtha' yi: bud med zhig dang 'phrad par gyur pas na rten 'brel 'bring tha 'gro don 'bring tsam 'byung : khams phyogs yul gru 'ga' re 'gro don 'byung : brgyud 'dzin gnubs ston zla rgya ye shes gyi: yang sprul loming can 'byung nas su zab chos 'di rnams 'chad sgrub spel bar byed ma 'ongs las can de yi sbyin bdag ni: rgyal sras sad na legs kyi skyes mtha' yi: gling yul phyogs su sbyin bdag lhaming : smar yul phyogs su sbyin bdag 5446 ming : spo bo'i phyogs su las ldan rig 'dzin ming : shar zla'i phyogs su sbyin bdag e yi ming : de rnams kyis ni zab chos 59

don gsal me long /'di rnams kyi bstan pa spel dang mthun rkyen sgrub par byed: de yang phyi nang bdud kyis ma bslus na: gling yul phyogs su sgrub sde tshugs kyang srid yon mchod chos srid bstan pa dar rgyas 'gyur:'on kyang bdud mo stag re'i sprul pa yi: bud med zhig dang rgyal 'gong brdzus pa yi: dam sri ser gzugs 'ga' yis dbang bsgyur nas: rten 'brel bsgyur nas bar chad 'byung yang srid: yang na shar zla'i smad phyogs dben gnas su: gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes dngos sprul pa'i: 'gran bral grub chen skyes bu lo/thaka/khyonazhig dang ni: yang gsang chos 'di 'phrad par gyur pas na: 'gro don mtha' rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs: mdo sngags bstan pa dar ba'i thabs yod kyang : dam sri rgyal 'gong brdzus pa 'ga' zhig gis: dbang ma bsgyur na rten 'brel 'grigs par 'gyur yang na khams kyi ru dam gnas rtsa dza: bhi ma mi tra'i dngos sprul skyes bu dang : dregs 'joms chos 'di 'phrad par gyur pas na: phan tshun 'gro don yun ring 'byung ba dang : gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs kyang srid: bar chad bdud dbang bsgyur nas 60

don gsal me long /thabs bral na: phan tshun 'gal rkyen bar chad dbang du 'gro: yang na dbus phyogs gsang bdag dngos sprul ni: chos kyi mtshan can /667skatha/skyes bu sprul pa'i sku: de la yang gsang gsang bdag chos 'phrod na mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par gyur: de ni rtsa ba'i chos bdag gsum yin no: gzhan yang las can chos bdag dam pa ni: zab gter 'di nyid gter sgo 'byed nas kyang :lo grangs drug cu rtsa gcig tshun chod du bod khams rnams su 'di ltar 'byung bar 'gyur ru dam phyogs su rig 'dzin mtshan can 'byung : yid lhung phyogs su pad+ma'i ming can 'byung : 'ba' yi phyogs su sprul sku bsod nams mtshan: kaḥthogs phyogs su sprul sku zung gcig 'byung : sprom gyi phyogs su nam mkha'i mtshan can 'byung: hor gyi phyogs su blo bzang mas can 'byung rjes rong phyogs su o rgyan mtshan can 'byung: 'dzam thang phyogasasu ngag dbang mtshan can 'byung :tsha khol phyogs su pad+ma'i mtshan can 'byung : lcags mdud phyogs su ghu ru'i mtshan can 'byung : khams stod phyogasasu 'phagasapa'i mtshan can 'byung : smar 'gyo'i phyogs su rgya mtsho'i mtshan can 'byung : gling 61

don gsal me long /gi phyogs su grub pa'i mtshan can 'byung : sde dge'i phyogs su bstan pa'i ming can 'byung : 'ba' yi phyogs su rig 'dzin mtshan can 'byung: smar khams stod phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtshan can 'byung : smar khams shar du garma'i mtshan can 'byung spo bo'i phyogs su legs pa'i mtshan can 'byung : gnyen kyi phyogs su gsang sngags mtshan can 'byung: kong po'i phyogs su o rgyan mtshan can 'byung gtsang gi phyogs su nyi ma'i mtshan can 'byung : dbus kyi phyogs su bsod nams mtshan can 'byung : lto brag phyogs su skal bzang mtshan can yang : byar gyi phyogs su rdo rje'i mas can yang : don pa'i phyogs nas 'brug gi ming can 'byung : mon gyi phyogs nas tshe ring ming can 'byung : sto ri'i phyogs nas grub chen ming can 'byung :zam bu lung du bstan 'dzin ming can 'byung : ti se'i phyogs nas ras pa'i ming can 'byung : nag shod phyogs su dri med mtshan can 'byung : gtsang stod phyogs su bkra shis mtshan can 'byung : ke yi phyogs su don grub mtshan can 'byung : 'dzi yi phyogs su ngag gi ming can 'byung : go yi phyogs su rnya'i ming can 'byung : shar rdza'i 62

don gsal me long /phyogs su dkon mchog ming can 'byung : lho zla'i phyogs su ngag gi ming can 'byung : sga yi phyogs su bstan pa'i ming can 'byung : 'dan stod phyogs su rig 'dzin ming can 'byung : ri bo che phyogs o rgyan ming can 'byung : 'bri chu'i rgyud du pad+ma'i ming can 'byung : sto rdza'i phyogs su dharma'i ming can 'byung : lto rdza'i smad phyogs bsod nams ming can 'byung : lho rong phyogs su ngag dbang ming can 'byung : lho zla'i rong du ngag gi ming can 'byung : tsha khol phyogs su pad+ma'i ming mtshan can 'byung : ru dam phyogs su bstan 'dzin ming can 'byung :gling gi phyogs su dzñā na'i mtshan can 'byung : shar zla'i phyogs su ngag dbang mtshan can 'byung : smar gyi phyogs su bsod nams mtshan can 'byung : rdza yi phyogs su 'gyur med mtshan can 'byung : 'bri chu'i rong du chos kyi ming can skyang : smar stod phyogs su o rgyan mtshan can 'byung : dpal thang phyogs su garma'i mtshan can 'byung :sde dge'i phyogs su rig 'dzin mtshan can 'byung : 'dan gyi phyogs su bsod nams ming can 'byung : hor gyi phyogs su kun dga'i ming can 'byung : rgyal rong phyogs su pad+ma'i mtshan can 'byung : zil 63

don gsal me long /khram nye phyogs phun tshogs mtshan cad 'byung : sgo thi'i nye phyogs garma mtshan can 'byung : she 'dzo'i nye phyogs 'gyur med mtshan can 'byung : rdza rgyal nye phyogs nor bu'i mtshan can 'byung : 'brong ra'i nye phyogs o rgyan ming can 'byung : gnyen dong nye phyogs chos kyi mtshan can 'byung : sdong ra'i nye phyogs nyi ma'i mtshan can 'byung :shar zla'i nye phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtshan can 'byung : smar yul phyogs su rdo rje rin chen ming : phun tshogs pad+ma bsod nams tshe dbang ming :o rgyan ming dang chos dbyings rig 'dzin ming : chos dbang ming dang mgon po'i ming can 'byung : khyo yi phyogs nas mgon dang o rgyan ming : gser gyi phyogs su pad+ma o rgyan ming : 'bri yi phyogs su kun dga' o rgyan dang : pad+ma bsod nams rdo rje rin chen ming :blo bzang ngag dbang grags pa'i ming can 'byung : gzhan yang yul gru re la chos bdag re: sbyin bdag re sogs las ldan bu mo re:kun gyis nga la dad cing gsang sngags kyi: chos sgor zhugs shing bstan pa'i sbyin bdag byed: tshe 'dir tshe ring mthun rkyen 'byor ba rgyas: mthar thug yang dag lam bzang dag la 'khod: skye ba tshe 64

don gsal me long /rabs mi lus gtsang mar skyes: chos dar yul phyogs nyams dgar skye bar 'gyur yang gsang gsang sngags nyams len byed par 'gyur:ma 'ongs las can skyes bu de nyid kyis: zab gter 'di rnams sa steng drangs ba'i dus: lo grangs drug cu rtsa gnyis tshun chad du: dam sri bdud kyi sprul pa dpag med 'byung : zhib tu bshad na bsam 'das brjod mi lang : mdor bsdus tsam gcig brjod na 'di ltar ro: lho zla'i phyogs su bsod nams ming can dang : tshe ring ming dang lhun 'grub ming can dang : she dge'i phyogs su dge ba'i ming can dang : bsod nams ming dang klu yi ming can dang : mgon po rdo rje'i ming dang chos skyong ming : ngag dbang ming dang lhun 'grub a yi ming : 9ku1ga phyogs su chos dang dkon mchog ming : 'bum gyi ming dang kun 'ga' blo bzang ming : bstan 'dzin ming dang sgron ma'i ming can dang : o rgyan ming dang tshe ring bsod nams ming :hor yul phyogs su blo bzang kun dga'i ming : skal bzang ming dang sangs rgyas rin chen ming : shar zla'i phyogs su tshul khrims blo bzang dang : kun dga' 'byung gnas lha mgon ming can 'byung : gter 65

don gsal me long /gnas nye phyogs tshe dang dbang gi ming : kun bzang 'gyur med bsam gtan tshul khrimasadang : gu ru rdo rje bkra shis ming can 'byung : 'dan gyi phyogs su bsod nams ming can dang : blo gros blo bzang bkra shis bsod nams ming : phun tshogs shākya lhun 'grub tshe ring ming :smar dang rdo phyogs rig 'dzin rdo rje ming : tshe dbang ming dang lhun 'grub bsod nams dang : mgon po lhun grub rkarma'i ming can 'byung : tsha khol phyogs su tshe dbang ming can sogs: dam nyams bdud sprul 'ga' zhig 'byung bar 'gyur: kun gyis gsang sngags chos la log par blta: zab gter smad cing gdul bya 'gro don bsgags bdag sprul rnams la gshe zhid skur pa 'debs: de ltar bdud sprul mang du 'byung bar 'gyur: de nas zhu ba gsum gyis 'di skad zhus: e ma rig 'dzin slob dpon chen po lags:ma 'ongs bu yi gter la spyod pa'i skabs: dus dang sa rtags nam zhig ji ltar 'byung : bdag cag rnamasal legs par gsungs bar zhu: zhes zhus slob dpon chen pos bka' stsal pa ma 'ongs dus ngan sum cu kha ral tshe: hor khrims 'jig cing rgya yis dbang bsgyur dus rgya 66

don gsal me long /'dre 'gong pos bod khams dbang yang sgyur bod khams bsod nams mar mar 'grib pa dang : sangasargyasabastan pa dar yang 'chol bar spyod: rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i bstan pa'i skabs yin pas: de dus bod khams rnams su 'di ltar 'ong : mdo sngags bstan pa nyi zla zung 'brel la: zhu ser zhwa dmar zer nas nang 'khrug rtsod bod khams sangs rgyas zhabs kyis ma bcags pas: dngos sprul bod khams drin chen pad+ma ngas: lha srin 'dul zhing gtsug lag khang chen bzhengs: bod khamasari brag thamasacad gter gyisabakang : snyigs dus las can nga sprul skyes bu yi: gsang sngags zab chos rin chen spyan drangs nas: mi rabs re la bod khams bde la bkod: 'on kyang dam sri bdud sprul 'ga' 'byung nas: gsang sngags chos la log par bltas nas kyang : rang bzos mdo sngags dkrugs pa'i chos brtsams nas kun gyis de la 'dud cing dad par byed: de yi rkyen gyis chos kyi byin rlabs nyams mkha' 'gro chos skyong na bun bzhin du yal nag phyogs srung mas dbang bsgyur bod khams kun nang 'khrug byed cing bde ba'i go skabs med gang zag chos bsgrub 67

don gsal me long /sku tshe mthar mi phyin dam sri bdud sprul bdud kyis mgon byed nas:dbang thang za kha rlung rta dar bar 'gyur da lta skad cig legs par 'dra na yang : phyi ma thar med dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur: nga sprul las can skyes bu chos byed la: kun gyis gshe zhing 'dud pa byed mkhan nyung : gsang sngags chos la than du lta bar 'gyur zog po bdud sprul rnams la bkur sti byed: bskyed rim ting 'dzin bsgom bzlasamed pa yi: ya tshul can gyi bla mi'i ming 'dogasamang : sdom pa dam tshig bsrung sdom med pa yi: dge slong ming 'dogs 'bu ltar g.yeng bar 'gyur: 'gro ba sems can yongs la gnod pa yi: bdud kyi sprul pa dpon ni mang du 'byung : kun kyang nang 'khrug 'khrug rtsod dar bar 'gyur bod khams sems can bde ba'i go skabs med:da lta'i bon blon rnams kyi sprul pa ni: gter gnas gnyan chen ge 'dzo'i shar stod nas blo tha /ming gis jing mdur sna drangs nas:dmag gis bod khams ma lusa'ajoms par byed: shar smad phyogs nas na tha rab brtan ming can gyis: rang phung gzhan gnod mi dge'i las la spyod dmag dang 'brug pa'i gzhi ma bting nas kyang : bod 68

don gsal me long /khams sems can sdug bsngal khur gyisanon: lho yi phyogasanas chos skyong mgro ming gis: dbang bsgyur sems can sdug bsngal las la bkol: bod khams sum cha de yi mnga' 'og 'dzud dud 'gro nyes med sdug bsngal gzir bar byed nub ngos phyogs su nad yams mu ge dang : lo nad btsa' sad than pas yang yang gdung :byang ngos phyogs su jag rkun 'tshe ba mang : dar gud 'byung zhing 'pho 'chug che bar 'byung :shar lho mtshams su rtsod 'khrug nang dme dar:lho nub mtshams su rgyal bstan nang 'khrug byed: nub byang mtshams su dpon la dar gud 'byung : byang shar mtshams su mtshon 'brug yang yang 'byung : gter gnas nye phyogs mtha' mi'i dmag sgar bca': mi rigs skad rigs mi gcig mang 'tshogs nas: yul la bzung res shor res yang yang 'byung : dbus kyi phyogs nas g.yoming can gyis dbang bsgyur bod yul sdug bsngal las la bkol: chab mdo'i phyogs su blo thaza/skal ming gyis: dbang bsgyur skye 'gro nyes med sdug la bcol: smar gyi phyogs nas don 7thaming can gyis: dbang bsgyur nang dme nang 'khrug yang yang byed nyag 69

don gsal me long /rong phyogs nas na lhaming can dang : tha7316ming gis dbang bsgyur nang 'khrug brtson: hor gyi phyogs nas 1tha cho mdzad ming :zung 'byung 'khrug rtsod gzhi ma bting ba dang : mdo khams smad phyogs mi bde'i las la bkol shar zla'i phyogs nas a yi ming can gyis: dbang byed mi dge 'khrug pa'i las la 'bad: 'bri chu'i rgyud nas mgon dang 'bum gyi ming : 'brug rtsod sna 'dren ban dgra dar bar byed sga 'dan phyogs su bsod nams chacha drung ming :dbang bsgyur skye 'gro nyes med sdug bsngal gzir : tsha ba'i rong nas zenganaming can gyis gsang sngags chos bsnubs log chos dar bar byed zil mo stod du thablo ming can gyis gsang sngags chos smad dam sri'i 'byung po byung :shar zla'i smad nas thosanagrwaming can gyis: chos min chos 'dra'i bstan pa dar bar byed: 'bri chu'i rong nas a yi ming can gyis: sangs rgyas chos smad log chos dar bar byed:hor yul phyogs nasazlobaka ming can dang :thaganyubazang ming gis ser gzugs mang 'byung nas gsang sngags dgrar lta gsar chos bstan pa btsugs: de yi dbang gis yul khams nang 70

dor gsal me long /'khrug byed zil khog phyogs su gsang sngags mi dad pa'i smos/rtowonya dang bla ma'i ming 'dogasakyis: log spyod byed cing skye 'gro sdug las bkol rkathog phyogs su sprul sku zung gsum 'byung : nang mi 'cham nas bstan pa nang 'khrug byed: dbus gtsang phyogs su bla ma'i tshul bzung 'gas dbang bsgyur rgyal khrims bzung ba'i las byed nas nang mi 'chams nas dbus su rgya nag gis dbang bsgyur skye 'gro sdug bsngal gzir bar byed gling gi phyogs su dam sri brdzus pa yi: dbang bsgyur ser gzugs zung gis dbang bsgyur nas: rgyal bstan na/zhizhwa/gabyed pa'i dbang gis ni: yul lha dang ni sde brgyad zhabrugs pa yi: mi dge mi rung sna tshogs mang bzhin 'byung : ri ngom phyogs su ser gzugs zung gis ni: mthu gtad dug sbyor mi dge dar bar byed: hor yul phyogs su dam sri brdzus pa yi: sna/ming gi sprul sku'i tshul 'byung nas: gsang sngags chos smad 'dul ba khyad gsod mkhan: rgyal rong phyogs su dam srir brdzus pa ni: bla ma'i tshul bzung dmag las nang zhabrug byed nyes med skye 'gro thams cad sdug bsngal non bod yul dbus su rgya yis 71

don gsal me long /dbang bsgyur nas: rgya 'dre 'gong po spun dgu bod la zhugs: de yi dbang gis bod khams 'khrug rtsod dar: mi rnamasaphal cher mtshon khar 'chi bar gyur gnam la skar ma phod can dud pa can: shar tshe nad dang 'khrug pa dar bar 'gyur: gza' skar stag mgo me 'bar 'byung ba'i tshe: than pa 'byung zhing me yi bskal pa dar: gza' skar g.yag mgo rlung 'tshubs shar ba'i dus: nad yams 'byung zhing rlung dang ser bu rgod: gza' skar chu ti sngon mo 'char ba'i tshe: gnyan lhog dar zhing chu spyo ri brag nyil: sngar med mkha' la gza' skar mang du 'char: de byas gnam gyi gza' skar thams cad 'khrugs:bar du lha srin sde brgyad 'khrugs pa'i rtags nyi ma dpag tshad gcig tu mar lhung nas: srid pa'i gangs ri rnams kyang zhu ba dang :than pas lo tog rtsi shing bsregs nas kyang : skye 'gro sems can mu shes gzir bar byed lo nyes btsa' sad 'bu srin sna dgu 'byung :mi nad nor nad 'gos rim sna tshogs 'byung : 'og phyogs sa bdag klu gnyen 'khrugs pa'i zer gnyen lhog nad ldang sems can mang po gsod: sa srin 'khrugs pas glo bur rma skrang 'byung : chu spyo ri 72

don gsal me long /rdib brag zhig yul grong brlag: me than gyis ni gtsug lag khang mang 'jig: thog dang ser ba sa g.yo yang yang 'byung : mu ge zhabrug rtsod mtha' dmag dbus 'phyur nas: skye 'gro sems can bde ba'i go skabs med: gzhan yang dus ngan spyod pa 'di ltar 'byung : rab byung rnams kyis hor chas byed pa 'byung : sngags pa rnams kyis rab byung cha lugs byed ban btsun rnams kyang sdom pa bsrung mkhan nyung :mi rnams chas gos spyod pa log chos dar : dbang lung med pas lha sgrub sngags bzlasakyang : bsgrubs rtags med cing lha srung 'khor ba dka' bsod nams dbang thang rlung rta gud pa'i rtags: chas gos lus rgyan 'dra min mang du dar: chos kyi bstan pa nyams pa'i snga ltas su mi res mkhas chos mang du brtsam par 'gyur: sngags kyi bstan pa nyams pa'i snga ltas su: sngags pa rnams kyis gsang sngags khrom du gyer: gzungs sngags dbyangs byed bha ling shing la byed: lta sgom zab mo nyams pa'i rtags mtshan du: bla ma sgom chen rtogs ldan tshul can 'gas: dben gnas dgon pa sgrub khang spangs nas su: grong nag 'grim zhing bag med dkor la spyod:73

don gsal me long /sems la mi lta kha bshad byed par 'gyur nyi ma'i mdangs shor sa chu gso bar dka': 'byung bzhi go log dbyar la dgun bzhin 'asposman gyi bcud yal nad la phan thog chung : sngags kyi nus nyams gdon bgegs thul bar dka' bur sbrang dkar shing rnams kyang mngar bcud nyams: sa bcud nyams pas lo rtag bungs mi skye rkang bzhi phyugs nor yod kyang zho shad chung : 'o ma mar med chu 'dra zas bcud nyams: phyugs g.yang nyams pa'i rtags nor 'phel stobs chung : gza' skar 'khrugs pas gza' skar dus mi 'phrod: tshe lha srog lha phrag lha nyams pa'i rtags mi gzhon rnams kyang rgas pa'i rtags mtshan tshang : mi rnams tshe mthar mi phyin 'chi ba mang : ri btsan gyis ni mi rnams brlam nas 'khyer: gza' nad kyis ni phal cher khur thim 'chi rgyal 'gong gdon zhugs spyo 'bog rengs bar byed rdzun dang kha lce nang 'khrug gzhi ma gting : mi rnams rang srog rang gis gcod par byed shi ba'i mi rnams phal cher 'dre ru sdang :bud med phal cher gson 'drer 'gyur bar gyur the'u rang dam sris brdzus pa'i jo brdzu mang : mi spyon dang ni khyi spyon mang du 'byung : rlung 74

don gsal me long /nag 'tshubs mas khang khyim nags tshal rdog chu spyo gru gzings zam 'gyel mi mang 'chi me than mched pas rtsi shing nags tshal bsregs: sa g.yo 'byung nas yul khams phal cher brlag shwa 'ud rbab kyis grangs ming bcom par byed sa bdag 'khrugs pas ri bo dgun yang nyil klu rnams 'khrugs pas char chu dusami 'bebs:yul lha 'khrugasapasarlung nag cho 'phrul gyis: ri klung rnamasasu char pa bkag par byed: 'gro ba phal cher tshad pas gdung nas gum yul lha nyams pas yul gyi bkrag mdangs 'asnang: sa mdog skya zhing thal ba'i na bun 'khrigs: byang g.yag rong bab stag gzig byang du bsgrod:ri bya klung bab klung bya ri la bgrod: sngar med bya gcan ri dwags mang du 'byung : mi rnams bsod nams dbang thang phyir bud rtags:lus chas gos rgyan sngar med gsar du dar dam srir brdzus pa'i dud pa kha yis 'jibs dud pa gar phog lha srung nyams par byed:'chi nas thar pa'i lam bzang 'gog par byed dam sri smon lam btab pas du kha myong : sa bdag sa srin dbal zer dug rlangs ngad nad bdag sems can shar zhugs dug nad kyis kha ru song 75

don gsal me long /tshad skye 'gro 'chi bar byed: kha zas myos byed chang dang bsgrags nas kyang : zas ngan dug sbyor bla dpon rnams la drangs skye 'gro phal cher sbyor dug dag gis 'chi: mu stegs mtshon khar mi rnams hur thum 'chi: 'chi tshad skye ba bdun la gri ru 'chi: mi ma yin dang yul 'dre ri btsan gyis nyin dang mtshan mor co sgra ku sgra bsgrog: de dang gang 'phrad skye 'gro khur thum 'chi: 'chi tshad de yi 'khor du skye bar 'gyur sems can rnams la gnod cing tshe srog bsdud: mthar ni thar med dmyal ba dag tu 'gro: mu stegs lha sgrub sngags pa 'ga' zhig gis mthu gtad ngan sngags rdzas sbyar bsgrubs byas nas:bstan 'dzin rnams dang chos byed dgrong pa dang : nyes med skye 'gro phal cher mthu yis gsod mthar ni mthu bsgrubs byed mkhan sngags pa de thar med rdo rje'i dmyal bar nges par lhung : ji srid bskal pa'i bar du thar bar dka' dam srir brdzus pa'i bla gzugs tshul bzung 'gas pad 'byung bdag la smad cig than du blta gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i chos la smad bdag sprul gter ston rnams la snang bar byed dam sri'i mgon byed de rnams dbang thang dar:76

don gsal me long /de nyid 'chi nas thar med dmyal bar skye kha lag 'brel tshad lam log ngan song lhung : bdud kyi sprul pa dpon gyi tshul bzung 'gas:skye 'gro sems can nyes med skye 'gro la : sdug bsngal las bcol nyes med khrims la sbyar: rgyu nor gang yod dbang med 'phrog bcom byed: kun kyang ltogs grir 'khyag grir gum par 'gyur don med las sgrub mtha' ru dpon po de dmyal ba mnar med dag tu skye bar 'gyur kun gyi rnam smin sdug bsngal rang gis khur rgyal 'gong brdzus pa'i ser gzugs 'ga' re yis mdo sngags gzhung dkrugs mkhas chos mang brtsams nas kun gyis de la dad cing 'don sgrub byed: byin rlabs rtags mtshan gang yang thon par dka' rang gzhan don med lam log zhugs par 'gyur zab gter rnams kyi 'gro don 'gogs mkhan ni: dam srir brdzus pa'i ser gzhigs de yis byed ya tshul can gyi bla ma'i tshul bzung 'gas:bskyed rim ting 'dzin sgrub pa med pa yi: 'gro don yin zer don du dkor bsdud mkhan zang zing rgyu dang rta nor gang bzang bsdu: kha zas dud 'gro bsngos sha chang la byed bslab gsum bsrung sdom 77

don gsal me long /ci yang med pa yi bstan don mdo bsngo tshar gcig med pa yi bla ma'i tshul can mang du 'byung bar 'gyur dge bshes tshul bzung phyi ru ngur smig gyon bslab sdom mi bsrung nag chang sred pa che las su tshong byed sems can gsod dpon byed: mna' sdig khrel med mi dge bcu la spyod: ming ni dge bshes don du sdig bsags mkhan: de 'dra dge bshes tshul bzung mang du dar: sngon gyi grub thob bla ma gong ma yi: phyag len dkyil 'khor gtor la 'don 'grigs sogs gsar bu 'ga' yis bcos nas rang bzo byed: de yis rkyen gyi lha srung 'khrugs pa dang : 'khu ldog 'byung zhid 'grub rtags yal bar 'gyur: gzhan yang mi rung spyod ngan 'di ltar 'byung : nam mkha' khrag mdog bar snang na bun 'khrigs: thog ser rgod cing than pas lo thog bsregs nor phyugs god cing skye 'gro mu ges gzir: dbyar la dgun 'gyur thog dang ser ba rgod gangs than 'bab pas mi nor 'khyags grir 'chi: ma mo 'khrugs pas nad yams sna dgu dar sman pas bcos med gnyan lhog gza' nad dar rma srin 'brum bu mdze nad mid gcus dang : bcos med 'chi 78
