don gsal me long /rkyen nad rims mang du 'byung : mi yi tshe tshad mar thung bsod nams zad: rgyal po rnams kyang rabs chad rgyal sa stong : sngar gyi phyugs po kun kyang dbul por 'gro yul sde kun kyang lo re song bzhin ngan: kha zas mi rnyed sa mtha' 'khyams yang srid rab byung rnams kyang sdom srung nyin skar tsam sngags pa rnams kyang sngags 'chol nang mthu brtson mi dpon rnams kyang nang 'khrug nang dme brtson:dgon sde sgrub sde nang 'khrug nang dme byed dge slong rnams kyis go thogs dmag dpon byed: lha chos bshad pa mi nag mkhas par gyur lta sgom zab mo nya mas gleng bar byed dgon gnas lha khang 'thab ra byed pa dang : dgon gseb gtsug lag rnams su bsha' ra byed dben gnas rnams su jag rkun 'dug mal byed dgon khang bu chung ngu skad 'byin par 'gyur: sku gsung thugs rten bzhigs nas mtha' la dor: gos zur bzhi bsgyur khrab rmog go cha bsags:dge slong brnye rnams kyis hor chas byed: dam chos nyan dang 'chad pa'i skal ba med: bzang po'i spyod pa na bun bzhin du yal : ngan spyod mi rung yang yang dar bar 'gyur sde brgyad the'u rang lha min 79

don gsal me long /brdzus pa yi: bla ma dang ni dge bshes tshul can dang : zhig po zhig mo jo brdzu mang du dar: kun gyis de la 'dud cing bkur sti byed :mthu gtad mnan pa phud zer yul khams rnams kun kyang 'khrug pa'i gzhi ma bting bar byed che btsun nang 'brug mthu dug dag la 'bad: saganasabyang chub sems dpa' man chad nas: lo brgyad lon pa'i byis pa yan chad kyis bzang spyod bor nas ngan spyod las la brtson slob dpon bas kyang slob bur dbang che 'gyur: phas zer kha la bu yis mi nyan cing : rje bas 'bangs rnams dbang che 'byung bar 'gyur lo re song bzhin dus ngan spyod pa dar: mug ge nad yams 'khrug rtsod yang yang 'byung : semasacan bde skyid skal pa nub par 'gyur dus ngan dbang yin sus kyang bsgyur bar dka':dus ngan snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus: chos kyi bstan pa rgya gar yul nas nub: mu stegs bstan pa mtha' nas dar bar 'gyur:mdo khams smad phyogs lan gcig mdo sngags kyi bstan pa mar me rgas kha'i 'od ltar gsal: gzhan yang dmag dang 'brug rtsod 'di ltar 'byung : dbus kyi phyogs 'dir 'pho 'chug mang bar 'byung :80

don gsal me long /rgya yis dbang bsgyur bod khams sdug bsngal non: kong po'i phyogs su nang 'brug nang dme 'byung : hor phyogs zi ling phyogs su khrag mtsho 'khyil mon gyi phyogs su dug gis gsod res byed: rgya nag yul du sa 'gul 'pho 'khrug 'byung : rgyal mo nang du nang 'khrug rgyun mi chad: lcags mdud phyogs su nang 'brug rgyun du 'byung : hor yul phyogs su nang 'khrug nang dme byed me yul lung du nang 'brug nang dme dar gling yul phyogs su nad yams mu ge dang : dar rgud 'pho 'chug mi 'dod yang yang 'byung : shar zla'i phyogs su mtshon 'brug dar bar 'gyur 'bri chu'i rgyud du rgya yi dmag sgar 'byung :lto rong rdzong phyogs dpon ni zung 'byung nas: nang mi 'phros nas dme 'khrug las la 'bad: skye 'gro phal cher sdug bsngal khur gyis non: lto zla'i phyogs su mu ge'i bskal pa dar: sga stod phyogs su dmag 'khrug sa log 'byung : 'bri rong rgyud du dmag gi khrims rnga brdung : lho rong phyogs su rgya yis dmag sgar 'debs: lhag stod phyogs su dmag 'khrug yang yang 'byung : nag shod phyogs su dar gud 'byung bar 'gyur: mi nyag phyogasasu dug gis gsod res byed:81

don gsal me long /dho yi phyogasasu nang dme phung gshing 'byung : sga stod phyogasasu lo nyes mu ge dar shar zla'i stod du rgya sog thag ltar bran sto zla'i mdo ru rgya yi dmag sgar bca' mdo khams smad phyogs ban bon nang zhabrug byed tsha ba rong du dmag 'brug nang dme brtson: hor gyi smad du nang 'thab rgyun chad med dar mdo'i phyogs su nad rims rgyun chad med: rjed rong phyogs su mu stegs ban dgra dar dam sri'i brlam pa'i ser gzugs zung gsum 'byung : gsang sngags bstan bsnubasabastan 'dzin yongs la sdang : smar khams phyogs su dmag 'khrug yang yang byed lha sa'i stod du stod hor thag ltar bran:sga 'dan phyogs su skye 'gror sdug bsngalagazir: gzhan yang yul gru so so mtha' dag gi sde dpon 'khrug cing pha spun nang dme byed dug dang mtshon cha'i las byed bde skabs med skye 'gro sems can sdug bsngal drwa bar chud zas su sha za skom du khrag la 'thung : nyes med dud 'gro dpag med gsod cing za ma 'ongs tha ma de ltar 'byung bar 'gyur: ces gsungs so: de nas zhu ba gsum gyis 'di skad gsol: kye ma ma hā gu ru rin po che: phyi rabs dus ngan 82

don gsal me long /bskal pa shar ba'i tshe: de la bcos ka phan thabs gang ltar bgyi:ma 'ongs don phyir gsungs bar bka' drin zhu: zhes zhus ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa dus ngan mtha' yin de dag bzlog par dka' 'on kyang bzlog thabs yod kyang bsgrub mkhan nyung : bsgrub mkhan yod na lo grangs cha shas re cung zad phan 'gyur yun du phan par dka': de dag bzlog pa'i thabs ni 'di ltar ro: nga yis bzhengs pa'i bod khams sa gnad rnams: bcos pa'i gtsug lag mchod rten zhig gsobyed: gangazag bzang posarab gnasayang yang bskyal:sa mdo gang cher rigs gsum pad+ma'i sku legs par nang gzhug can bzhedas rab gnas byed: rgyal ba'i bka' sgrogs bsang brngan ri khrus dang : yul lha'i rten mkhar brtsigs shing bum gter sba:bka' brgyad phur pa drag khros gro lod dang : gsar rnying yi dam sgo nas gtor bzlog 'bad: ma mgon gsol kha dmag bzlog phrin las bcol sa g.yo'i bzlog thabs sa bdag 'khrugs bcos dang : 'byung bzhi gtor ma cha gsum 'bar ma brdzongs: las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ci 'grub yang yang bya: rdo spangs brag la rigs gsum 83

don gsal me long /pad+ma'i sku: yang snying brkos shing dar lcogs phyogs mdog 'dzugs:sa mdo gang gnyan mtha' dmag mnan pa dang : rgya 'dre dam sri'i mnan pa tshad ldan bya: de steng sāts+tsha 'byung bzhi'i phyogs mdog can:rigs gsum pad+ma'i sku 'dra ci 'grub bzhengs: tshad ldan zung 'jug rab gnas ldan pas mnan: yar ngo'i dus su bsang brngan ci 'grub bya: mar ngo'i dus su gtor bzlog mnan bsregs bya: khyad par dus chen tshes bcu nam 'ongs dus: tshogs 'khor bskor zhing sirnyi 'ur 'don bya: bsam pa lhun 'grub che chung ci 'grub 'don lam 'phrang bcos shing dge ba ci nus 'bad: ri rgya klung rgya la sogs byed gyur na lo grangs cha shas mtha' dmag nges par bzlog: skye 'gro gnas skabs bde skyid ldan par 'gyur: phyi rabs rnams kyi yid la de ltar zhog: ces gsungs so: ma 'ongs lung bstan don gsal me long 'di ma 'ongs rnams kyi yid ches ldan phyir du: yi ger thob la rdo rje'i gter du sbos: gter bdag srung ma dag la gnyer du bcol: snying po don gsal lung bstan me long 'di: snod ldan slob ma re la ma gsang gtod: snod min dam nyams log lta 84

don gsal me long /gshe bskur mkhan dam chos kha yis bstan zhing zhe yis smad: gsang sngags khyad gsod mkhan la ma ston cig: 27/than lha lha//|(kanaskyes nyu7ston/ga:sa mā ya: rgya rgya rgya: dus mtha'i lho gter ston pa ser skya phal cher gyis gter brdzuyin par smra ba'i: 'jigs med nus ldan rdo rje rtsal gyis me pho 'brug gi lor hor zla bdun pa'i yar tshes la nye gnas dkon mchog ming can sogs kyis mthong sar gnyan chen ge 'dzo'i brag nas gdan drangs pa'o: phyis rgya rong phun tshogs phug tu shog ser las rang gis bshus pa'o: sarba maṅga lo: bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling kun tu khyab gyur cig:85

don gsal sgron me/(ja)/dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i las mtha' las dmag bzlog le'u dang po lung bstan gyi skor don gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so:sa mā ya: rgya rgya rgya:5no ma ga lhas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal bstod 'gro la phan bde ma lus yang ster ba'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rnams: chu zla'i ngang tshul bsgrang bar mi lang yang : yongasakyi gzhin gyur nam mkha'i 'od dkar bzhin: kun gyi rtsa lag mtsho skyes rdo rje la gnam lo shugs ldan 87

don gsal sgron me/me pho rta yi lor 'od dkar rgyal gyi grogs byed rgyas pa'i dus: blo dman 'gro la brtse ba'i rdo rje mtshos: gser g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal lus phud bde stong gis: yang yang mnyes pa'i zhabs tog lan mang bsgrubs:gnubs rigs rnal 'byor nam mkha'i mtshan can dang : dkyir 'khor gcig tu gsang dbang stsal ba'i tshe: ma 'ongs dus ngan sum cu kha ral dus bod khams don byed mtha' dmag 'dul ba'i phyir:sprul pa rigs gsum khams phyogasa'agyed pa'i dus bdag kyang de yi bar chad bsal ba'i phyir: rim bzhin sprul pas 'gro don dgos lung bstan: de dus bod khams bsod nams mar 'grib dus: mi mthun mi shes sdug bsngal sna tshogasadang: stod hor la sogs bdud dmag bco brgyad kyis: sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gro la 'gal rkyen byed: zhes gsung lung bstan rab gsal me long dang : yang gsang zhi drag skor rnams bstsal ba'i dus ma 'ongs mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i man ngag dang : las tshogs spros bcas sprod med yang yang zhus:kun mkhyen ye shes thugs kyi sgo phyed nas: rim par gnang nas shog ser ngosasu bkod: de dus rig ldan bu mo rdo rje mtshos: skyabs 88

don gsal sgron me/gnas 'gran bral ma hā gu ru la:zab gter 'di rnams 'don pa'i dus tshod der:mtha' dmag 'byung ba'i snga ltas ji ltar 'byung :dus kyi rim gro sa phyogs gang na bsgrubs:ma 'ongs don du yang dag stsal du gsol:zhes zhus slob dpon chen pos bka' stsal pa ma 'ongs zab gter 'byin pa'i dus de la:zathaganaragaloca'agro don rdzogs nas gshegs:nasathamagasherag77 ji/ dang mnyam du 'byung :tha sgroganaragasakhri'adi la bar da 'bebs:1546216thabadun gyis 'gro don 'gogs: glebazasagamatha' la dor:rna/rgyoganago/chur+shacho'ing 'byung :kha7lo245tshanaming can gsum:riranaphyogale/thosaci'abyung :lho nargya'irtsok+ṣa/chen zhes 'byung :'a76i 'o/ma'i tshul zung 'byung :lto shubashamā/zuga'abyung:gter gnas de dang nye ba'i phyogs rtaganyu7tshe/'byung :mgonyugu/lodabang lus sme ba rtags mtshan zur du ga de nas sa rtags rim pa cung tsam ni:dbu tshal gser khang me lha'i dgra ru sdang :lha sa'i jo bo'i gser 'phru rlung gis bskyed:jo bor mas brgyan bdud sprul shar ma'i drangs:spyan gzigs thad du mtsho chung chu bo rdol khams 89

don gsal sgron me/kyi phyogs su gter brdzu zung gsum dang : 'gong pos brlam pa'i btsun chas bcu gsum 'byung : rgya bod mtshams su sa g.yo me yis brlag 'bri chu'i rgyud du ri bo dgun yang nyil: shar gyi phyogs su gson 'dre mang du 'byung : me yi yul du hor sogs sil bur 'thor :rgya nag mthil du sa g.yo 'pho 'chug 'byung : lho rdza'i phyogs su mu ge che bar 'byung: byang gi phyogs su stag gzig dom gsum 'byung :spu bo'i phyogs su dge 'dun gri thabs 'chi: kong po'i phyogs su ngan 'gro'i gter gcig 'byed: lho brag phyogs su shi ba'i mi ro long :mon gyi phyogs su mtha' yi mi gcig gis: kha lo bsgyur nas khyu gcig mar la lhung : bya gnyen lo gsum smyo 'bog mang du 'byung :ru bzhi bod 'di nag pos bdag tu bzung : dmar po ri ljongs sngon lasa'abrel pa yi: bsod nams chung ba'i rgyal po'i ming can gsum:gsod pa'i sems can khang bur tshud pa 'dra: mkhar chu'i zhol du mkhar rdzong gsar pa brtsegs: shang gi brag la gter gcig rang khar rdol: khyung po'i grong du thog gis sde 'ga' bcom dbus kyi phyogs su 'khrug pa che bar 'byung : bra ba 'bu srin char 'bebs 90

don gsal sgron me/yul 'ga' stong : dbus phyogs mi rung than ltas bco brgyad 'byung :gtsang po zhag po bdun la khrag tu mthong : bsam yas mchod rten nag po byang du 'gyel tsā ri'i mi lpagasathang la so nams byed: khams kyi mdo khams mchod rten sul bur 'thor: chos srid 'dzin pa bzhi yi gdung rabs chad: lha sa bon la phyogs pa'i rgyal pos bzung :de ltar dus rtags sum cu rtsa lnga'o: bod kyi bstan pa 'jigs pa'i snga ltas so: 'di rnams dus gcig thams cad 'dzom gyur na shin tu bzlog par dka' ba'i gnas su bros: gsum bsgos cha gnyis tsam byung bzlog na thub phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel legs 'dzom na: spros bcas le tshan bcu gsum dmag bzlog 'bung :'bring dang tha shos tsam du song gyur na: spros med le tshan bcu gsum dag la 'bung : sangs rgyas bstan par phan thogs byung srid na: rang don mi dgos sangs rgyas go 'phang thob: 'di dus sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin khas len pa'i: dkor sdud phyags ma ra khyu tsam 'byung ste:sangs rgyas bstan la mi sems chos brgyad bsgrubs: ston pa'i zhabs 'dren spyang ki gos ser can: sngon ma grub thob gangs seng 91

don gsal sgron me/'dra rnams kyi:sprul pa yin zer 'brel tshad dmyal bar lhung :mdo ltar srung sdom med pa'i dkor zan mkhas:sngags ltar bskyed rdzogs mi shes ser cha'/can:nga min nga 'drasasangasargyas bstan pa bshigs:chos min chos 'dras chos kyi bstan pa bshigs da lta rgyal bas lung bstan dus 'di n+da sangs rgyas sprul pa'i chos rgyal rim par byon:sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' dbus med par brdal ldi ba'i bka' khrims gser gyi gnya' non bzhag:'phags yul rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar dus 'dir paṇa chen mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar ltar bkra:sangs rgyas sprul pa 31 tsā brgya rtsa brgyad:rdzu 'phrul ldan pas rgya gar yul kun nyul:nyi zla 'dra ba'i paṇa chen mang po drangs:paṇa chen rnams la rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gter rgya'i mdzod bkrol nas: mdo sngags zung 'brel bod du gdan 'dren byas:'dzam gling rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis:zhu ba'i rten la gser phye bre re dang :gser gyi pa tra re dang gos yug re ljongs 'dir srid tshad phyag rten dang bcas nas:bod du mdo sngags bsgyur bar zhu ba phul: blo dman rnams 92

don gsal sgron me/la nyan thos 'dul ba'i chos: dbang po rab la gsang sngags theg chen chos: mdo sngags zung 'brel bod la bsgyur nas su: thams cad 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa la bkod: de nus thugs sras nye ba'i bu brgyad dang : grub rtags thon pa brgya dang rtsa brgyad sogs:chos la mos pa'i blon po yang dag dang : gsang sngags phyag rgya rig ldan nyi shu lnga: chos kyi kha 'dzin bud med brgya rtsa sogs: kun gyis tshogs kyi 'bor lo rim par bskor: rang rang thog mtha'i skye ba'i lung bstan zhus: de dus slob dpon dus gsum mkhyen pa yis:ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don la brtser dgongs nas: rang rang lha skal me tog gang bab pa'i sgrub pa che chung man ngag las tshogs bcas:dbang bskur lung nod bka' gtad smon lam btab: bsnyen sgrub bgyis nas so sor gter du sbas ma 'ongs sa rtags dus tshod 'di shar dus: yul lung rigs rus lus kyi rtags mtshan dang :chos bdag phyag rgya phan gnod las byed rnams: rim par lung bstan skal ldan bu de la: dngos nyams rmi lam bdag dang ḍāk+ki yis:dngos nyams lung bstan cho ga'i lasa'agrigs bstan phyi nang gsang 93

don gsal sgron me/ba'i rtags bzang mtshan ma 'byung : bka' srung dam can de la khyi bzhin 'brang : ma tshogs mkha' 'gro sha la sbrang bzhin 'du: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra dpung de yis bzlog ma 'ongs rtog ge blo chung 'ga' zhig gis bdag gi gter chos bka' lung brgyud med zer:'di nas lo grangs lnga brgya song tsa na rgya gar yul kyang chos rnams 'chol bar spyod parnyi ta yin grangs med gser la rlom: bod kyi so skye lo tswa'i ming can mang : che 'dod 'gran nas rgya gar thag ltar bran: mu stegs ngan sngags phra man log mthu dang : da lta'i chos la 'phri bsnon sna tshogs byed: gser zho re dang nyo tshong byed nas bsgyur bod rnams gsar 'grogs che bas de la 'dud bsgrubs kyang rtags dang mtshan ma ci mi 'byung : de yang bod kyi mkhas grub yin rlom 'gas: gzu lum ras chod byed nas rang kha 'dzin chos brgyud nga bzang zer nasatshong dus 'grim: bla ma slob dpon dam sel sil bur 'thor: de 'dras chos kyi byin rlabs rgyun chad de: shāka thub bstan zhes gos kyi tshul tsam 'dzin: rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i bstan pa de dus yin: ston pa'i bstan zhabs pad 'byung chos kyis 94

don gsal sgron me/skyongs: zab gter 'di nyid sa steng 'byed pa'i dus bdag gi gter spyod gter ston brgya tsam rdzogs ma 'ongs 'byon pa'i gter ston grangs mi longs: yul gru so sor rang rang gdul bya'i zhing :nga yi thugs sprul gter ston tshad ldan lnga sum cu kha ral 'dul ba'i gnyen por byon: kun gyis gcig dril dus rim la 'bad na:sangs rgyas bstan pa sprin bral nyi ma 'dra: khams kyi sa gnas gang zag mi bzhi yis dbus kyi phyogs su bstan pa'i rim gro 'bung:kham/skyoganamardorje'i ming can dang : 'bri rong phyogs nasarig 'dzin ming can dag :josgomargyog rdo rjesaming can dang :'chayikhyogan lha/pos ming can dang : /ga rkyargyog༈rdo rje'i ming can dang :nadza'askyachogasacanas ཿpho na/na tha na: de lnga yis ni zab mo'i gter rnams 'don: bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i bsrung rim dang : mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i mnan gtad tshad ldan byed: de yis rim gcig bod khams bde bar 'gyur khyad par lcags pho khyi lo shar ba'i tshe:gnam dang sa yi nang nas ma gtogs par: phyogs mtshams kun nas mtha' dmag chu ltar 'brub: gsang sngags bstan dang sems 95

don gsal sgron me/can kun la 'tshe: mi bzad sdug bsngal dpag med myong ba'i dus:ci bya rtol med dus la babs pa'i tshe: lho rdza'i phyogs nas nam snying sprul pa yi: gnas chen rnams nas zab mo'i gter sgo 'byed: khyad par yi dam kun gyi mthar thug pa rdo phur gang khug gnam lcags spu gri dang : yang gsang drag por khros pa'i mdos chen dang : yi dam rnams kyi sgrub pa tshad ldan bya: mtha' la drag po'i gtor bzlog gnad smin sgrubs: mtha' dmag g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i ched du 'phen:spros med le'u bcu gsum dmag bzlog bya: de yi byin rlabs rim bzhin mtha' dmag bzlog: slar yang bod khams bstan 'dzin 'di ltar 'byung : lha sar lha chen tshangs pa'i sprul pa ni:mi tha/zhes gdong sme can zhig 'byung : de yis bstan pa skyong zhing gtsug lag bzhengs: ris med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par byed:de dus skye 'gro thams cad bde bar gyur: dmag dang g.yul 'khrug nad mtshon sgra mi grags: mdo khams smad du mu khri btsad po yi: sprul pa chos skyong rgyal po thaman68mtshan: 'byung nas ris med sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong : bka' bstan dbu 'dzugs gtsug lag sgrub 96

don gsal sgron me/sde skyong : de dang zung 'brel spyan ras gzigs sprul pa'i cho 77mtshan can bla ma zhig dang ni: phyag rdor sprul pa sa steng 'gran med pa'i: dharma'i mtshan can grub mchog dam pa 'byung: de gsum gyis ni chos kyi srol yang btod bod khams bde skyid nga nyid 'byon dang mtshungs : mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i sa gnad mchod rten gso: de rkyen lan gcig khams phyogs bde bar 'gyur: de nas mi rabs gnyis gsum song ba'i dus: skye 'gro bde skyid skal pa nub par 'gyur: de nas mtha' dmag 'byung ba'i snga ltas su: gnam rtags sa rtags spyod ngan 'di ltar 'byung : dus kyi 'pho 'chug gar mkhan lag pa 'dra: sems can bsod nams sos ga'i chab rol 'dra:nam mkha' khrag mdog skabs su thal char 'bebs: nyi zla gzas bzung 'gro ba'i lam mi mthong : gza' skar sngar med mkha' la rim bzhin 'char: skar ma me 'bar dud pa can zhig gis: skye 'gro'i bla skar brlag cing stor nas su: de rkyen bod khams mi nad nor nad dar bar snang mi rung ltas ngan sprin gzugs 'byung : nyi ma dbyar ston dpag tshad mar la babs: lo 'bras rtsi shing nags tshal 97

don gsal sgron me/bsregs par byed: dgun dpyid gangs than babs pas sems can gum dbyar la dgun 'gyur rlung dang ser ba rgod: dgun gsum 'brug drag ser 'beb thog kyang lhung : 'brug ni thang babs mtsho chu 'thung bar 'gyur gnam nasa'abu srin bra byi'i char pa 'bebs:lo 'bras rtsi thog thams cad brlag par byed gnam nad gza' nad 'byung ba'i dug gzer gyis: mi phyugs bcos med hur thum dag tu 'chi: rlung chen 'tshubs mas mkhar khang nags tshal bskyel:gnam nas rdo lhung skye 'gro gsod par byed: de sogs gnam gyi rtags mtshan rim bzhin 'char: de nas sa yi rtags mtshan 'byung tshul ni: sa bcud nyams pas lo thog bungs mi skye: rtsi thog shing thog 'bru mar mngar bcud nyams: dud 'gro zho shad chung zhing mar mi 'byung : sman gyi nus yal nad la phan thog chung : sa bdag 'khrugs pas sa g.yo ri bo ngur brag zhig mkhar khang rdib dang gsha' rgob dang : sa nad sa srin gnyan lhog nad rigs kyis: mi phyugs phal cher bcos med nad kyis gum: sa bdag klu gnyan 'khrugs pa'i dbal zer gyis: mdze dang phol mig zha grum rengs 98

don gsal sgron me/ba dang : sngar ma dar ba'i nad rims mang du 'byung : de nas bod khams rnams su 'di ltar 'byung : dus ni lo re bzhin du ngan du 'gro spyod ngan rang gis spyod nas dus ngan zer rgya gar yul du mu stegs bstan pa dar: thub dbang sku gdung sha khrag dag gis mchod: bal yul mchod rten zung 'jug nyams par 'gyur skye 'gro bsod nams de nas mar la 'grib dbus kyi phyogs su 'pho 'chug mang du 'byung : lha sa'i mthil du sdug bsngal khang bu brtsegs:lcags pho ri la mi dge'i lha khang 'byung: de yis gnam dgra sa dgra thams cad langs mon kha ri la kha ba chag pa dang : kong po'i yul du dge 'dun nang 'khrug byed dbus su glang dar sprul pa'i sdig rgyal 'byung : dge 'dun dgrong zhing sems can bsad gtubs brtson las su sdig spyod nor du go mtshon bsags 'gro ba sdug bsngal las la bkol bar byed dmar po ri rtser ser gzugs zung gnyisa'abyung snye nang mi 'chamasanasadamag zhabrug gzhi ma bting :lha sa'i mthil du rgya yis dbang yang bsgyur gtsug lag khang la sems can gsod mal byed jo shāka mchod pa sha khrag chang gis 99

don gsal sgron me/byed sngon srol dkar po dge ba phal cher nub las ngan mi dge ba yi las la spyod: nag phyogs rgya 'dres gtsug lag srung ma byed:dkar phyogs srung ma na bun bzhin du yal bod yul bsod nam mnga' thang nub par 'gyur: gnyen chen thang lha g.yag kham 'dra ba 'ong : gnam mtsho'i nang nas khyung gis klu rigs drangs : g.yang nyams bod khams dbul zhing phongs par 'gyur bar snang glog ma sprin gyi cho 'phrul gyis me than 'chad pas gtsug lag byin ldan dang : khang khyim mkhar rdzong phal cher me yis 'jigs: de yi rkyen gyis bod khams bsod nams nyams dkar phyogs srung ma mnol shing rgud par 'gyur bsam yas mchod rten zung 'jugs nyams pa dang : gtsug lag khang la zhig ral ser kha 'byung : bsam yas dkor srung byang chub sems bskyed nas skye 'gro phal cher brgyal nad smyo 'dres gzir mchims phur ra mda'i lha khang zhig ral dang :dge rgyas lha khang bye mas non pa 'byung : zur mkhar rdo'i mchod rten nyams pa dang : zung 'jug dam sri gter rdzun 'ga' yis 'don:de yis bod khams sa bcud thams cad nyams: khams kyi glang 100

don gsal sgron me/thang sgrol ma'i g.yas phyogs su bre stong thur la sbub 'dra'i lha khang 'byung : de rkyen lo nyes mu ge 'byung ba dang : khams phyogs bsod nams mnga' thang gud par 'gyur po ma/phyogs su mi dge'i lha khang brtsegs: de rkyen yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad 'khrugs:mi nad nor nad sngar ma dar bar 'byung : mi(1132nye phyogs lha khang 'byung : de rkyen yul lha phrag dog dug zer gyis: gang zag rje dpon gum shing mi shis 'byung : nag 'bur rdzongs su dmag sgar 'byung bar 'gyur: de rkyen gnas po btsan rgod phrag dog gis: rje dpon rnams dang yul sde mtha' dag la: mi bde mi shis rkyen gegs che bar 'byung : lar yang gtsugakunayin zer sems can la: sdug las bcol nas sa gnyan rdo gnyan phud shing gnyan gcod cing chu gnyan thams cad dkrugs: ming nilha' don du sdug bsngal khang :de 'dra bod khams rnams su mang du dar: de'i rkyen sa bdag yul lha gzhi bdag 'khrugs: sngon du chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang : pad+ma bdag gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang : sa yi me btsa' mchod rten thams cad nyams phal cher bdud dang dam sri'i 101

don gsal sgron me/sprul pas bshigs gsar pa bzhengs zer zung 'jug 'don pa dang : 'og gi dam sri'i mnan gtad thams cad phud bdud dang dam sri bar snang khams su 'phur: ngan spyod bdud sprul rnams kyis grogs byed nas bsod nams mnga' thang rlung rta dar bar 'gyur:gang zag chos byed bstan 'dzin yongs la sdang : mi mthun ltas ngan mtha' dmag sna yang drangs: sems can bde skyid skal pa 'byung mi 'gyur: gnyen chen thang lha'i nye phyogs rdzong zhig 'byung : de'i rkyen dbus phyogs mi dge phung sel 'byung : rgyam rgyal rdo thi zil khrom bzhag ra sngo: gzhi bdag gangs che'i gangs ri zhu ba dang : sga stod jo bo'i gangs ri chu yis bgol: sga stod phyogs su mu ge shi chad 'byung : klong thang sgrol ma sa g.yo chu yis 'jigs bod khams sa yi me btsa' de nas nyams nye phyogs chos sde dmag gis tho 'tshams byed: de rkyen 'bri rgyud bsod nams mar la 'gribs:bar gling phyogs su dme 'khrug dug g.yo byed: de'i rkyen yul lha gzhi bdag nyams nas kyang : dar gud 'pho 'chug yang yang 'byung ba dang : bla dpon rnams kyang dus min dag tu 'chi: mi dge mi 102

don gsal sgron me/rung bar chad mang bzhin dar: 'bri chu'i rong du bdud rgyal lag ring gi sprul pa sdig spyod rgyal po zhig 'byung nas: las su dmag zhabrug mtshon cha rdzong la 'bad bod khams skye 'gro mnga' 'og dag la btsud 'gro ba nyes med sdug bsngal las la bkol: lho zla'i mdo ru rgya yi dmag sgar bca' rgya 'dre 'gong po'i khams phyogs yul kun bzung : dkar phyogs lha klu gzhi bdag rgud par 'gyur mi nad nor nad sna dgu yang yang dar smyo 'dre'i gdon gyis skye 'gro phal cher gum kre shod kha ba rlung ri'i nye phyogs su lo nyes mu ge 'byung bsaskye 'gro rnams: mu ges gum zhing mi 'dod yang yang 'byung :rgyal rong phyogs su bdud sprul dpon zung ni: nang mi 'chams rkyen 'khrug rtsod chen po 'byung : nyes med 'gro ba mtshon grir mu ges gzir dkon pa'i rin chen sa rdo bas kyang mod: longs spyod bza' btung bsod nams mar mar 'grib: yul grong phal cher ltog grir gum par byed dmag 'khrug 'ongs ltas mkha' la than sprin ni: dmar nag mtshon cha'i dbyibs 'dra 'khrigs pa dang : nad yams ltas su sngo dmar na bun 'thibs ye shes dbyings kyi srung 103

don gsal sgron me/ma dbyings thim nas chos skyong mthu rtsal rtags mtshan 'bras bu yal: lha min lhar brdzu'ajig rten gdug 'dre ni: bka' srung yin zer btsan dang rgyal por brdzu ming btags chos skyong mang du 'byung bar 'gyur: gang zag phal gyis de la sgrub mchod brtson mchog gi 'bras bu yal cing thun mong gi 'jig rten bslu brid zang zing dkor nag 'du: 'phral du legs legs 'byung yang tha ma n+da/ de yis srog gcod 'khor du skyes nas kyang : lus ngan len cing 'gro ba'i srog la gzan: nyin dang srod la 'ur rgyug mngon sum mthong :ban btsun nang dme btang zhing phung sel byed: de 'dra'i chos skyong yin brlom mang zhig 'byung : 'bri rong rgyud nas dam srir brdzus pa yi: ser gzugs zhig gis dmag zhakhrug las la 'bad gsang sngags sgrub pa'i gang zag dag la 'tshe: de phyogs 'gro la mi bde sdug las bcol: gtsang stod phyogs nas sngar med gser than rdol:ma sman khros zer yams nad sna dgu yis: ser skya phal cher gum zhing mi rung 'byung : dbus phyogs gtsug lag khang la gser jo 'byung : bstan 'gro lo 'bras dag la cung phan kyang : dmag 'khrug 104

don gsal sgron me/nad yams chu mgo de nas rdol byang gi phyogs su dmag 'brug che bar 'byung : nyes med 'gro ba mtshon gri dag gis gsod: 'bri rong rgyud du dmag 'khrug nang dme dang : dar gud 'pho 'chug 'byung zhing lo nyes 'byung : lcags mdud phyogs su mtha' yi dmag sgar bca':ru dam phyogasasu nang dme mthu gtad brtson: chos min dag gi bstan pa 'byung yang srid yid lhung phyogs su mtha' dmag tshogs ra byed hor yul phyogs nas bdud sprul ser gzugs kyis: sna 'dren mi dge byed pa'i las brtson pas: rgya mi la sogs mi rigs mang bzhin 'tshogs dmag 'khrug yang yang 'byung zhing sems can rnams:sdug bsngal dra bar tshud cing srog gcod byed zil khrom nye phyogs dmag 'khrug che bar 'ong : yul la bzung res 'chor res mang du 'byung : zil khrom zhol du sngar med chu than rdol: chu de 'thung tshad ngan song dag tu lhung : shar phyogs rma rgyal spom ra'i nye phyogs su: dmag 'khrug 'byung nas yul 'ga' stong par 'gyur dar mdo'i phyogs su sa g.yo me than 'ong : rgya nag mthil du nang 'khrug phung sel dang :rgya nag rgyal po'i rgyal sa 'pho 'chug 'byung : hor yul phyogs su 105

don gsal sgron me/bdud sprul dpon ming mang : nang mi 'khyams nas dme 'khrug rgyun mi 'chad: rgyal rong phyogs su bdud sprul zung zhig gis: gsang sngags chos smad sku gsung thugs rten bshigs: de'i rkyen rgyal mo rong du nang zhabrug 'byung : nyag rong phyogs su mi dge'i rdzong gsum 'byung : de rkyen gnas po yul lha 'khrugs pa yis: nang 'khrug nang dme yang yang rgyun chad med: gser thal phyogs su shi 'dre'i yul 'ga' stong : smar yul phyogs su bdud sprul zung mang 'byung :nang mi 'chams nas dmag 'khrug las la 'bad: rdo yi phyogs su bdud sprul mang zhing 'ong : nang dme phung sel rgyun mi chad par 'byung : 'bri rong rgyud du bdud sprul zung 'byung nas: dbang bsgyur dmag 'khrug rtsod pa lan mang byed: de rkyen srung ma yul lha'i phrag dog gis: than pa 'byung zhing lo thog bsregs pa dang : rje 'bangs kun kyang tshe la bar chad mang : mi phyugs 'gos nad sngar ma dar ba 'byung : zur mang phyogs su nang dme phung sel 'byung : lto zla'i phyogs su sdig spyod zung gsum 'byung : mdor rgyal nye phyogs sngar med rdzong zhig brtsig: rdza rgyal nye phyogs sngar med dgon sde 'byung :106

don gsal sgron me/sga stod phyogs su zob rgyu khyu mang 'byung : chu mdo'i phyogs su zob brdzu mang du dar man nyag phyogs su bdud sprul ser gzugs mang : 'bri rong rgyud du sngar med mkhar mang brtsig rdza rong phyogs su mi dge'i lha khang 'byung :ngom yul phyogs su dmag 'khrug yang yang 'byung : lho rong rdzongs su dmag gi khrims rnga brdungs byang gi phyogs su dmag 'khrug mu ge dar: lho zla'i phyogs su dge bdun nang 'khrug byed zil mo rong du sdig spyod mi mang dar: go brag phyogs su dmag 'khrug yang yang 'byung : khyad par dam sri mu stegs sprul pa dang : bdud blon klu dbang sogs kyi sprul pa yis log chos gter log rnam lnga dar bar byed: lhag rog phyogs su log chos gter zhig 'don: phal cher de yi dbang du 'gro bar 'gyur:tsha rong phyogs nas chos min gter gcig 'don: skye 'gro phal cher de la 'dud par byed shar zla'i smad nas log chos gter zhig 'don phal cher de yi lugs su 'gyur nas 'gro: lho zla'i phyogs su gter log zung zhig 'byung : zab chos rnams la bsre bslad bzo bcos byed: a ta rong du gter brdzu zung zhig 'byung : mngon shes 107

don gsal sgron me/rdzu 'phrul pra mo ston pa dang : las su mthu gtad ngan sngags dag la brtson: sangs rgyas bstan pa phung sel nang dkrugs byed: de lnga dus gcig khams phyogs 'jom gyur na bod khams rnams su mi rung sna dgu dar bod khams lha srin 'byung po thams cad 'khrugs:dam sris mgon byed de rnams dbang thang che: da lta nad gdon cung zad phan snyam kyang : de dang kha lag 'brel tshad skye 'gro kun: phyi ma dam sri'i 'khor du skye bar 'gyur ma 'ongs gter la spyod pa'i skyes bu dang : snying yod po rnams de dang ma 'grogs cig: zab chos 'gro don 'gogs mkhan de lngas byed: log chos spyod pas bod khams gang bar 'gyur zab chos nges don rnams la than bzhin mthong : ma 'ongs skye 'gro bsod nams dman stabs dang : dam sri mu stegasadabang yin bsgyur bar dka': g.yin yang dusangan spyod pa 'di ltar 'ong : nor yod ya tshul can gyi bla ming gis: bag med dkor la spyod cing grwa 'khor bsdud gtan don dam chos cho ga phar bzhag nas: 'ostog chos 'jig rten lha srin dregs pa bsgrub:dbang sdud rdzas sbyor thabasakyis 'gro ba bsdu: rta drel khyu dad pho khrom 108

don gsal sgron me/khyu mang bskor zhu gra gos gra bsgrigs shing chos brgyad chas: khrom du 'dus byas cho ga 'ar 'ur 'don gser dngul rta phyugs zang zing nor la brlom: sngon dus bla ma grub chen gong ma yi: mdzad pa'i cho ga chos spyod phar bskyur nas phyag len 'chug zer rang 'dod mkhas chos brtsam dkyir 'khor gtor ma gsar bsgrigs byed nas su: snying med mkhan tshos de la nyams len byed bsgrubs kyang byin rlabs rtags mtshan 'byung mi 'gyur: de rkyen chosakyi byin rlabasasum cha yal: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mas 'khu ldog byed mi min lha srin khengasalog chu ltar 'brub: cho 'phrul yul khamasarnams su mu ge dang : nad rims bkra mi shis kun rlung ltar 'tshubs: skye 'gro sems can sdug bsngal dra bar tshud: sngar ma mthong ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul 'byung : rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i stan pa de dus yin:chos pa yin zer tshul bzhin chos 'chol spyod: slob dpon smad cing rang gi che ba 'don: 'dul khrims mer bsregs sems bskyed rlung la bskur mi tshe chos spyod nga rgyal lam khyer byed ting 'dzin phrag dog bsgom zhing nor rnams bsags grub thob tshong dus 'grim 109

don gsal sgron me/zhing log 'chol spyod sgom chen rir 'brugs chags snang mig ser che: zang zing nor dang rta phyugs mang du bsogs ban btsun lus rgyan mtshon cha dag la byed hor chas byed cig nag chang sred pa che yidapon sprang chas byed cig grong mthar 'grim dge bshes dbu gtso byed nas dmag dpon byed lha ru bdud btsan 'gong po mchod par byed blo gtad pra mo zob brdzu dag la byed: dkon mchog dgrar lta byang sems thugs kyang dkrugs nor la blta nas lung med dbang bskur byed: dge 'dun phal cher tshong 'dus 'grim nas su dam chos sku gzugs tshong dus 'grim zhing btsong : rang nyid nam 'chi bde sdug mi shes pa'i gzhan don sems can mgo bskor bslu brid pa'i mngon shes mkhyen pa ston pa'i bla ma mang :rgyal dpon dmangs 'bebs dpon bas g.yon dbang che: chos byed sku tshe thung shing bar chad mang : bdud kyi dbang bsgyur gshe bskur thabs kyis smad: chos skyong 'drer ldang spyo 'dres sa steng khyab dge bshes 'dul khrims mi bsrung khyim thabs brtson: sngags pas dam tshig mi bsrung bsnyen sgrub dor grong chog 'dre brdungs srung ma 110

don gsal sgron me/ar la gtad btsad pos rgyal khrims mi bsrung sdig las 'bad nyesamed khrimasagatad ri dwagasago ru btsud lasasu rdzongasabartsegasasems can mtshon la byed rta nor zang zing nor rdzas ci sogs byed: dkar po dge ba'i phyogs la btang mi nus mi min lha 'dres mi rnams brlam nas su: ri rtse nags tshal brag dmar dkyil du khyer gzugs med lha 'dres nyin mtshan co sgra sgrogs: gdong 'phrad skye 'gro hur thum dag tu 'chi: sman pas bcos med nad rigs mang du 'byung : nad du mi 'ongs zer ba gcig kyang med dbyar dgun go log sa chu gso bar dka' chos log brtsams mkhan grangs mi langs bar 'byung : btsun pas bsrung bsdom mi thub khyi bzhin rgyug skye bo mna' za sdig byed rkun jag 'bad bud med lusami thub pa rlung ltar rgyu pho zhig gnam gyi skar ma tsam zhig 'byung : mo zhig sa kha'i rtsi mchog tsam zhig 'byung : brdzun ma min pa bden pa'i zasami za:chos byed bla ma bsgom chen dad bkur chung :bdud sprul zob brdzu mkhan la bkur sti 'bung : lo skor re bzhin lus chas lus rgyan sogs sngar dus med pa gsar du rim bzhin 111

don gsal sgron me/'byung : ser skya kun kyang 'chol dang rgyan la dga' ma 'ongasa'agro ba gsar dad shin du che: sngar med bya gcan ri dwags grong yul 'grim lo re song bzhin dus rtags rim bzhin 'char: skye 'gro bde skabs sprin bar nyi zhur 'dra: de sogs gnam rtags sa rtags dus rtags dang : mtha' dmag 'byung ba'i snga ltas de ltar 'ong :zhib tu bshad na brjod par mi lang ngo : 'di ru mdor bsdus tsam zhig bshad pa'o: de 'dra'i dus ngan bskal pa shar ba'i tshe: sum cu kha ral spyizhu nye ba'i dus: sgo bzhi'i gangs zhu mtha' dmag lhud par 'gyur: dmag mi mi 'dra lha srin dmag tshogs 'dra: dmag dpon gcan gzan dud 'gro'i mgo brnyan gyi: mi 'dra mi gcig ya ma zung du 'byung : go cha mtshon cha mi 'dra dpag med bsgos: du ru ka yi dmag dpung bco brgyad de phyogs mtshams kun nas ser ltar 'bebs nas 'ong : 'dzam gling sems can thams cad gsod par byed: ngan song gsum 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur:dus ngan skabs su zab chos 'don mkhan med gal srid yod kyang bdud kyis dbang bsgyur nas bzlog thabs yod kyang 'dud mkhan 112

don gsal sgron me/mi nyung ngo : le lo btang snyoms ngang du lus nas 'gro: de 'dra'i dus ngan bskal pa shar ba'i tshe: sangs rgyas gzhan gyi thugs rje sdug pa dang : dam chos gzhan gyi byin rlabs yal bar 'gyur bdud dang lha srin 'byung po kha dar tshe: o rgyan nga nyid thugs rje byin rlabs che: ma 'ongs las ldan 'gro phan skyes bu yi: mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i las thabs brtson par mdzod: sngon byon gter ston rnams dang skyes bu yis: bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul mchod rten zhig gso dag: khyad par chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis: bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag mchod rten zhig gso dang : gang zag bzang po'i rabs gnas tshad ldan bskyil: khyad par pad+ma bdag gis bzhengs pa yi: gtsug lag mchod rten sgrub gnas thams cad du: tshes bcu rgyun 'dzug gtor chog mchod pa dang : mdo khams sa yi me btsa'i bum pa gso: gter kha gong ma'i lung byang ltar yod pa'i bod khams sa bcos gang 'grub dag la brtson: ri rgya klung rgya chos khrims gsar du bsdams btsun khrims sngags khrims yul khrims gsar du bsdams: nor gter mi 'don sa gter bsko mi bya yul lha bsang 113

don gsal sgron me/brngan rten mkhar bum gter sba: gang zag sgom chen rtog ldan bzang po yi: spros med le'u bcu gsum dmag bzlog 'bung : dge 'dun sde dang sngagasapa thamasacad kyis sprosabacasale'u bcu gsum dmag bzlog 'bung gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' sgrogs thang 'bum dang :bka' thang sde lnga bklag cing mdo bzlog bya: gang zag bsnyen song nus ldan 'ga' zhig gis: yang gsang rdo rje phur pa'i bsgrub chen 'dzugs: mtha' la drag po'i bzlog pa stong rtsa dang : rjes su mnan tshad ldan ci ming bya: sa mdo gangs che sa gnad che sar mnan:steng du bdud 'dul mchod rten tshad ldan brtsigs zung 'jug legs bzhugs rabs gnas yang yang bskyal: rigs gsum pad+ma'i sku gzugs mang du bzhengs: rdo spangs brag la yang snying ci 'grub bsko 'byung ba bzhi mdog sāts+tsha ci 'grub bzhengs: sa mdo gangs gnyan rnams su bzhug par bya: gzhan yang mdo khams sa yi snying de'u bdun: mdo khams sa yi de'u chen bco brgyad la: snying gter bum gter rin chen gter kha sbas ri khrus bsang brngan rten mkhar brtsegs par bya: de ltar byas na skye 'gro cung zad bde 114

don gsal sgron me/mdo khams sa yi mdo chen bco brgyad la dam sri mtha' dmag mnan pa tshad ldan bya: steng du mchod rten rdo 'bum sutsās mnan:mdo khams sa yi thang chen bzhi po la: mtha' dmag mnan pa gzhung ltar tshad ldan bya: bod khams skyong ba'i rtse bla bcu gsum la bsang mchod brngan dang bum gter rten mkhar brtsegs: gzhan yang yul phyogs rang rang so so yi: gnas bdag gzhi bdag ri rtse la sogs su bum gter tshad ldan snying gter sba bar bya: bsang mchod brngan dang rten mkhar gang 'grub dang : pad+ma'i yang snying dar lcog ci mang bya: skye 'gro rnams kyis bsam pa lhun 'grub dang : rigs gsum pad+ma'i yang snying 'ur 'don bya: sa bdag 'khrugs bcos bshags 'bum klu gtor dang : sa g.yo bzlog pa'i bcos ka dag la 'bad:gzhan yang gsar rnying rang rang sosoyi: yi dam bsnyen pa gang 'grub dag la 'bad: chos srung rnams la bskang bshags ci 'grub btang :rgyal ba'i bka' sgrogs mdo zlog ci 'grub dang : sdi brgyad khengs mdosasrid pa spyi mdos dang : kha 'bar gtor r+sā 'byung bzhi gtor ma btang : cha gsum glud dang lan chags mang du bsngo: de ltar 115

don gsal sgron me/brtson na lan cig bod khams su mtha' dmag g.yul ngo lo skor re zhig bzlog: zhes pa ma hā gu rus gsung bzhin du blo dman 'gro la brtse ba'i rdo rje mtshos: yang yang zhus ngor pad+ma bdag gis bkod: legs par yig ris thob la ma 'ongs don: skal sdan 'ga' re yid ches skye phyir du: khams phyogs gnas chen drug gi gtso gyur pa'i: dhe wa ko tra'i gnas lag khyad par 'phags rgyam rgyal rdo thi gangs dkar zhes bya ba'i: shar ngos gtan 'khyil 'o ma'i mtsho dkar du: mtsho sman rdo rje g.yu 'od mtsho la gtod: ma 'ongs nam snying yon tan sprul pa yi: gter ston zhig gis 'don par gyur nas ni skye 'gro lan gcig bde skabs sprin bar gyi: nyi zhur tsam gcig lan gcig 'char bar 'gyur: de yang legs pa'i rten 'brel legs 'grigs na: chos bdag skyes bu rnams dang chos 'phrad nas kun gyis dmag bzlog las la 'bad srid na: mi rabs gsum la mtha' dmag nges par bzlog: 'on kyang dam sri'i sprul pa 'ga' zhig gis bskur 'debs gshe bskur 'bar sha 'debs nas su:lan gcig 'gro don 'gogasapar 'gyur yang srid: ma 'ongs sems 116

don gsal sgron me/can dmu rgod dbang che bas: skyes bu de la 'dud mkhan mi nyung ngo :gal srid lasacan skyesabu 'ga' de yis zab chosanyamasalen bsgrub pa brtson srid na: bstan dang 'gro la phan thogs rgya cher 'byung :ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs : zhes gsungs so:dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i las mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i le'u rbecu gsum las ma 'ongs lung bstan mtha' dmag 'byung ba'i dus rtags dang sa rtags dmag 'khrug dang dus kyi 'pho 'chug sogs bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po3(:7〉ka — sa mā ya: rgya rgya rgya:gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya:3|: : rgya:/ khams phyogs kyi gnas chen drug gi gtso bor gyur pa rgyam rgyal rdo thi gangs dkar gyi shar ngos sri'i 'o ma'i mtsho dkar nas: dge byed zhes bya chu pho stag gi lor zab chos 'di nyid gter nas spyan drangs shing khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug gi lor: go gzhung zhes pa'i lga lde khyung tshang phug tu shog ser las zhal bshus so: sarba maṅga lo:dge'o: bkra shis/117

dus kyi lung rim/(nya)a: rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje'i ming can la: ye shes dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki dzña na rak+ṣi ta'i dus kyi lung rim bzhugs so:gu ru yab yum zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: lho rdza rgyud kyi mi nag 'jigs med rdo rje'i ming thob de: tshad med bsam gtan gling du mtshamasasgrub 'dug pa'i ming 'dogasakyir+sālkog nyal byasanasabasdad tshe: me pho rta'i lo zla ba pa'i tshes bcu la: nyon mongs rang rgyud ma dul pa'i rnam shesasgron me rlung nang bzhag 'dra de zhabrul pa'i dbang du song tshe nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul nas ma gcig ye shes mtsho 119

dus kyi lung rim/rgyal de nyid byon nas mjal ba'i snang ba la cha lugs mi yi bu mo gzugasamadzes pa'i tshul can: gos su ras sngon gyi e ga ra'i nang du rgya tshos kyis bsgyur ba'i phrug gos dmar po phu dung can zhig rgyan:skra lan bu'i brgyud du gser dngul gyi me tog mang pos brgyan nas:dngul gyi rna long byu ru'i brgyan pa dang : byu ru dang spos shel gyi phreng ba dung dang rus pa'i ska rag dang shar mo can du sprul nas mjal ba'i bar: bdag gis rang re'i 'dod don dang : bstan pa spyi yi dusarim sogs kyi bya ba gang legasakyi dri ba nan du zhus shing de'i lan du spyi don dus rim 'di gsungs so: gnas dben par 'dug pa'i rigs kyi bu dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba'i 'phral yun don cung zhu ba ma brjed gtam tshig 'di: sang snga mor yig ris ngos su thobs:da phan gyi dus kyi lung rim rnams: sngon yol bas da tshun lung bstan ni: sa nyil nyil gnyis kyis bang rim mthar: khyi nag po dug gi mche sen can: khosasu mthong za ba'i kha mo che: lcagasathag pasabaskor nasaphur par btags: khyi'i rdzi'ur bskosapa'i mi chung rnams snyam le los ma khyer la 'ur du rdo gang che'i phur mgo brdung na 'thad:120

dus kyi lung rim/sor sleb pa 'dom gyis mi slob 'gyang : dug nag posaspyo ba'i gcan gzan 'di shor srid na yul 'ga' brlag par 'dug: yul der gnas ri dwagasakhyu mang rnams phyogs gzhan du brosan thar mi srid:lho nags ljongs pad+mas brgyan pa'i tshal gser spre'u byon pa'i rjesasu 'brang: de i 'brang nub kyi bu mo'i shes lar bstan don dus kyi rim gro 'di: sngon lan mang yang yang bstan 'a lasakyang g.yeng dbang song brtson dbang cher ma 'grub snyan grags pas khyab pa'i lo ngos der: bod 'gro ba bde ba'i bya ba gcig: dgos gnad du che'ang ma 'grub 'gyod: phyir 'phrogs nas lhung ba'i sa phyogs su: rang 'gro ba'i rten 'brel 'grig dgos yang : dbang gzhan gyis bsgyur nas rten 'brel 'chug: de rang gzhan rtsol ba zhan pasalen: de thamasacad sngon song thabs bral te: da dgos ched che ba'i bstan rim la:sngon shing sbrul lo yi spyi rim ltar: yul mtshamasa'agar de ltar 'grub gyur na: gnad che bar 'dug pas nan tan mdzod: mi gzugs can gzugs med lha srin la: skyabasargyal ba kun 'dusagu ru dang :dpal rdo rje phur pa drag nag skor: dregs 'dul ba'i gshed po gro 121

dus kyi lung rim/lod kyi: dbang bskur shing rdo rje'i tha tshig bsgrags: dus gco bo tshes bcu nam byung la: tshogasa'akhor lo'i mchod pa gnad du che: bod mtho dman yul sde thams cad kyis: shing dri bzang dud pas bsang mchod gyis: 'dzab badz+ra gu ru'i dbyangs len dang : rje gu ru'i gsol 'debs rgyang 'bod thong : bod dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag la: bsang brngan dang rten mkhar bum gter 'jog: khrus dpang bstod rdo rje'i tha tshig bsgrags: sngon dam bca' sbran pa'i gtor ma sbyin: kha che bar gdang ba'i 'dre srin la: ngaraglud chen rang rang mdosakyisabaskang : chagasum po chugator mchod sbyin bya: sman ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo la: zhabrugs nyams pa gso ba'i bskang bshags bya: nad gdug pa'i kha rlang btangagyur na: masridabata/ma ma bgatu brdzongaba'iyul rang 'dra 'khor gzugs rdzongs su thob: sman tshe ring mgo lnga dpon g.yog dang : sring brtan ma bcu gnyis bskang zhing mchod:yul sde srid 'dzin pa'i rgyal dpon gyis: srog bslu ba'i ri rgya klung rgya tshugs bka' gsar rnying ban bon thams cad kyis rang skal gyi yi dam chos skyong la: rgyun gsol mchod bskang bshags bzlog 122

dus kyi lung rim/pa brtson: ston thub pa'i dbang po'i gsungs rab dang : mgon pad+ma'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus sgrogs: yul mi sde che phra thams cad kyis:ngag rgyun 'don badz+ra gu ru bsgrangs: dus nang nub srod dang tho rangs la: yid ma g.yengs o rgyan chen po sgoms: gang bsam pa 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs gyis: gnas khang khyim ri bo'i phyogs mtshams su:las gzhi mthun gang 'dzom gzhi ngos la: mgon rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs snying dang : dpal pad+ma'i yang snying bris 'bur bkram: dus sum cu kha ral 'dul ba'i gnyen: tshad ldan 'byon gter gyi bsrung bzlog zab rten gsar rnying zhig ral nyams pa gso: rab gnas pa gsol nas mchod gsol brtson: dge bshes gnyen che phra bsod snyoms par: thugs dgyes pa'i yon 'bul bkur sti gyis: sprang nyam thag nad pa bya khyi dang: nya grog ma srog chags dud 'gro la: zas sman rim bza' btung sbyin pa thongs: gnod 'tshe ba spangs la bde ldan mdzod: sa 'phrang dang la chu che chung la lam 'phrang bsal zam dang dge gru tshugs: gzhan dkar po dge bcu'i chos 'dzugs dang :nag mi dge bcu spang khrim 'dzugasasogs: dge bskul gyi khas len 123

'phrin bskur gyi lung bstan/(ta)i: gter ston 'jigs med rdo rje'i nyams snang du:lha chen rdo rje 'bar bas 'phrin bskur gyi lung bstan bzhugs so:skyabs rnga yab gling pa'i zhabs la 'dud phyogs mtha' med du rgyu ba'i sprang po 'jigs med rdo rje rang nyid shing sbrul zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshesanyer lnga 'khrul pa'i nyams su: yang zab bka'i gter srung rdo rje rgyal mtshan de: lha srin dkar phyogs can rnams 'tshogasapar mdun gros la song nas yar 'gro ba dang 'phrad pas bdag gis dus dang bstan pa'i las don gyi dri ba bgyis par bdag gisadus125

'phrin bskur gyi lung bstan/dang bstan pa'i tshod 'dzin pa'i go cher mi chod lags: 'on te da lam gnyan chen thang lha'i g.yas kyi mda' 'dzin pa: phyogs mthar kun tu dus kyi nyul ma btang ba'i: ma rungs gdug pa'i lha 'dres gleng ba'i gtam tshig 'di rnams lha rdo rje 'bar ba'i drung du zhus nas da res yul lha thams cad 'tshogs par: lha chen rdo rje 'bar bas glu dbyangs 'di ltar len pa lags: phyogs mtha' yas rgyal ba'i phrin las pa: 'gro'i skyabs mgon pad+ma 'byung gnas lags:spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'gro ba la: g.yel med par thugs rje'i gzigs lags sam: ngas g.yas kyi pho nya mda' ra ba: mtha' phyogs kun nyul ma btang ba las: bdud nag po'i mdun gros gleng mo go: dus deng sang snyigs ma'i yang mtha' la: bzang legs pa'i yon tan 'ja' ltar yal: ngan mi rung sna tshogasachar bzhin 'bebs:spyir bod khams stod smad thams cad la: bdud nag mo phyogs mtha'i 'dre srin 'gas: nad rkyal pa kha phye'i gleng mo byed: phyogs ris med phan pa'i bstan 'dzin 'ga' thabs gang mkhas du ma'i blo thabs kyis: dug sna dgu drangs ba'i gleng mo byed byang mtha' bzhi'i 126

'phrin bskur gyi lung bstan/gzhi bdag bog chod dos: rang bcasapasagazhan gyi dpung chen bsgul:mtshon rtse mo nam bslong pra mo 'debs: shar ri bo dhe shan rtse mo nas: 'od phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i zer ma 'di: dug sprin gyi nam sgrib dus tshod btags: nor rin thang che ba bod khams kyi: mchog gser gyis grub pa'i mchod rten la: thog drag po'i mkhar ba bzhu bar gros bod skye 'gro bstan pa'i srog gi shing : mtho dgung du bsgreng ba'i dar nag la: mthas log rlung 'tshub ma bsdu bar shom: mdo bod kyi bar snang nam mkha' la:'od mdangasadagur shar ba'i 'ja' tshon la:mdangs nam yal blta ba'i bya ra byed: shar rin chen mdzod kyi sgo 'gram du: khyi dom bu dung gi mche bzhi can: skad nam chad nyan pa'i nyul ma btang : sman gzugs mdzes gser g.yu'i rgyan ldan 'di:dga' 'dzum pa'i ngang tshul g.yo thabs kyis grogs sus thob zer skad rin nor bskyal: gtan 'khyil pa'i g.yu mtsho mdangs ldan 'di:mthar i grangs yur ba brko bar gros: dkor nor mchog skyong ba'i bdag byed 'gar: rdzasangan dgulisbyor ba nag po yis: mgo bskor ba'i gtad 'khor 'dzugs par gleng : shing tsher ma can gyi nagasatshal 127

'phrin bskur gyi lung bstan/la me tsha zer 'bar ba'i sol ba bzo: sa sra mkhregs ti tsha 'gram ngosasu: mgar mkhasapa'i mi nag mang po yis dpung pha rola'ajomasapa'i mtshon cha brdungs: lcagasarnon po ngar ba'i sbu gri brdar: snying brnag pa'i lusal brdeg par gros donade rnams go ba yid la thog: gtam de skad rdo rje 'bar ba'i glu: rgyam rdo rje rgyan mtshan dbang phyug gis:'phrin de skad lho rdza'i sngags chung shod: gnad de la phan pa'i bya ba rnams thabs gang drag sgo nas bsgrub gyur na: 'phral bde bar 'grub na kun la phan tshig de skad kun la bsgrags par mdzod:ces gsungs so: lar dus 'dir rim gro bsang brngan bum gter sogs gang dgos mdzad par lo me rta'i nang du phyogs med kun phebs thub na sems can gyi don rgya chen red pas thugs dgongs mdzod: lo sasprel tshun du bdag gisarang gnasasu cig 'byon dgos:bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gi gnad che ba'i don gcig yod: ces zer nas dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyan mtshan de nyid rang gnas su gshegs par mthong ngo : nang par de ma thag tu yi ger btab pa'o: sarba mad+male bha wan+tu: / nyi grags rta mgrin lung bstan las/ bsam yas dbu rtse mo la 'chor yang srid/ /'di yi phur pa'i zhusangalen las/than gyi me yisabastan pa'igasgoma'ajigs/bsam yabasku yin snyam/128

kha byang shel gyi me long /(tha)a: thugs kyi klong sde man ngag kun gzhi'i mtsho gter las:bla ma drag po ki la ya hūm̐ gi kha byang shel gyi me long bzhugs so:dus mtha'i zog po zer yang zhe blo bde:i:bhalhalhabagagazhin tsho o rgyan che mchog thod phreng rtsal la 'dud shamasgorme e ma ho: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gi: zab lam dgongs brda'i mkha' gsang dbang po'i gter: mi 'gyur g.yung drung bcu gsum thig le 'dzin zab dgu'i mdzod 'chang skar 'dzin bde klong 'chang : brda' rgya rig 'dzin ṅgāk+ki'i gsang rgya dam:129

kha byang shel gyi me long /gamamanyade yang me pho stag gi lo zla ba dang po'i yar tshesadage bar dpal bsam yas kyi dbu rtse'i khar par: rin po che'i khri za 'og kyi 'bol dgu brtsegs steng du gu ru rin po che bzhugs shing : rgyal po dang rje 'bangs jo mo lnga bcas 'tshogs shing : tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshamasashing :rin po che'i maṇ+ḍaladang lha mi'i longasaspyodadapagatu med pa rang rang gisaphul zhing bzhugasapa'i dus su: gu ru yi spyan nam mkhar gzigs shing : a saṃ aḥ ma 'ongasaḥ gang zhig gi dus su gtsug 'gyur yang mtha'i 'gyur ldog dang : dus rtags rim bzhin gtsug lag khang 'di rnamasakyang mi rtag 'jig pa'i rgyu can yin pas: 'khor 'das thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyis shig gsungs pas mnga' bdag rgyal po mu khri btsan pos gser gyi maṇ+ḍal g.yu yis phra btab pa phul zhing 'di skad ces zhus so: kyi ma gu ru bka' drin khyad 'phags kyi ma 'ongs dus 'gyur dbus 'gyur lung bstan dang : dus rtags so nams sems can dar rgud dang :mtha' bzhi'i ru sgo sbas gnas bco brgyad sogs: gtsug lag khang dang bstan pa'i chags 'jigs sogs: ma 'ongs lung bstan 130

kha byangashel gyi me long /bka' gsal bdud rtsi'i bcud dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gu rus stsal du gsol: zhes zhus gu ru'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs kyi ma mnga' bdag lha sras rje 'bangs grogs bcas gson: ma 'ongs dus su mtha' yi spyod pa rnams: sa rtags dus 'gyur lung bstan 'di bzhin 'byung : nam mkha' khrag mdog sardul mkha' ru 'khrigs:skar ma mjug 'char char chu mi snyom zhing : sa g.yo sa 'gul ri rab stong zhabrugs mang : lcags pho rta ru so namasamar la 'gribs:mi rje rka tshang bcu gsum 'dul bya'i zhing : sham bha la ru chos kyi dpal kha rgyas: zhu pad ra gas pi dan 'dul zhing btsugs shāka kya'i gtsug tor me lha'i phyogs su 'phyo: gtsang la rwa can mtshon rno zangs se 'beb: bdud sri mi mo khrag ral nam mkhar bsig kha nas me 'bar nad sprin sngo dmar 'khrigs: rgya nad tshad pa gnyen gzer khong lhog dang : srin glang ltar ba dug mda' hag gzer sogs:nad kyi bskal pa mi thod bud pa 'byung : rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang na len+d+ra/ /mu stegs phra mkhan zhwa lo khra lcog sogs: tse( rgyan yul min gzhan dag khyab par yod: khrus mtsho 'ga' re yod kyang 131

kha byang shel gyi me long /byin rlabasayal: mu stegasaphal pasami gtsang bstabs nas yod:o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho de yang : de dus yul gling zhig tu gyur nas kyang snye mtsho de'i dbus shul chu mig 'dom skor tsam: de dus khrus mtsho kun las grags pa 'byung : chu gnas sems can grub thob pho mor gyur gtsug lag khang dang rten rigs mang po bzhugs bal yul e ru mi rigs mi 'dra slebs: kha ches yul khams chu ltar 'khrugs shing g.yo: hi ling mtshon thogs zi khyim gying nag 'phro:rkyen byed dmag skad 'ur chem re zhig sgrogs mnga' ris yul dbus blon 'bangs sde tshogs slebs: gung thang la khar sgra gcan sngo dmar 'thab: gri mtshon mi 'dra'i so nams bod la dar: 'bras ser dmar po'i dpung tshogs gyen la drangs: ngan song zer yang de 'dra'i sdug bsngal med: rkyen de bzlog mkhan pad+ma'i rnam par 'phrul:sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gang shar gzhom med 'byung : rten 'brel legs 'grigs bstan pa'i sonamasagaso: sbasargya:9ri bye dbus ljongs stod smad yosaltar zhabrugasashing g.yo rtswa'abru char chu sgang gzhong khod mi snyoms:sad ser lo dgra bcud mchog nyamasapa'i dus: ru bzhi'i 132

kha byang shel gyi me long /gtsug lag mi rtag khol bur 'dzin ti se gangasadakar gzi 'dra'i cho lo bkrag dpal gyi bsam yas me dmar byang 'tshubasakyi tsha tsha 'thul dbang chu shel dbang po yal: rkyen byed de yis me yi 'jigasapa 'byung : rten gso dri med sku sha 'byin nas su: rab gnas gdong dmar yul dbus lho nub nas zil 'bru'i char bsnyil bstan pa'i dpal kha bstan re zhig lho phyogs mi nag stag ris can: kha nas sa nag phug shul 'debs byed cing : sa stag ri mo rgya sgo gnam la ldang : srin rdzong me tog nyi grags/bdud kyi dbang du yal: shul du khrag mtsho bud med rtsod gzhi g.yo: dbus ljongs rdzong mkhar g.yu bya m+mu mdo/ sngon mo yang : re zhigabastan pa'i rtsa lag legasapar bstan:nags kyi glang chen rol rtsal/ rgya stag rtsal shugs che ldan yang : gsang sngags theg pa'i ri mo mngon par bkra: dpa' rtsal bdud la ngoms pa'i ngar sol: dwags rgyud dgra gcan dug gi sa mda' ldang : bslu zhing g.yeng na rtsal shugasadabyingasasu bsdus: g.yu bya sngon mo'i brten tshal zur du 'phros gser gyi sa gzhi 'od mchog grub pa'i bcud:theg pa mi brtan mi rtag char ltos 'dra: mtha' bzhi'i mi nor mi 133

kha byang shel gyi me long /'dra sna mang 'byung : stag la rdo ring yo zhing ri mo 'byung : lcags pho ri snar khol bur zhig ral 'byung : gangs than yo log ri lung khod snyom zhing : zhu khra rgya dmag bya 'dra'i khengs log cher bsnyil zhing : klu dbang lag gi nor bu 'phrog pa 'byung : byang phyogs rgyal po la yag sna khrid nas:rdo rje'i ri brag bstan pa'i rtsal la ldang : sa mkhar rming gzhi gyang ral mngon par byed: de 'dul la lung phyogs nasasngags spyod 'byung : sbas tshul grub spyod nges med tshul du 'byung :rtsa 'i/lhadabu ris rgyal khams gyang gi snying sa bzhin: gang desarkyen byed chu chen gnam du 'khrugs: klu dbang rgyal po mgo bo stong pa: sa gzhi rdul bzhin nā ga rab 'khrugs zhing : ma gro'i rkyen byas gtsang po'i dar thags7shākya'i rgyal po'i 'dul zhing 'og tu rgyas: ra sa'aphrul ldan mdangs yal nyams par gyur po ti rming la rtsig pa'i gzhi 'ding zhing :nyi zla min kyang skad cig gsal bar 'byung : de dus zhig ral gso ba'i ka cha rnams bum thang ri mo can nas nor mdzod rdol: ham/rme de dus bod kyi mi rnams blo ma ring : khra 'brug bstan gasdu'i sgrol mar gsol ba thob: mchod pa'i gnas phul bsod nams rgya chen rdzogs:134

kha byang shel gyi me long /rten gsum mjal zhing gnas gsum bskor bar 'bad byang chub chen po'i mchod bstod skal mer brtson: pe dkar dkor mdzod re zhig yal ba'i dus gling bzhi gling phran sa yi rdul gyis sgrib mchod rten nag po'i ming tsam shul du lus: mtha' dmag ru sna bzlog pa'i rbad byang yod: yang mthar skyobasapa'i gter rgya yod pas tham shu ca de bzhin gtsug lag sagand yul gru rnams: rim par dgongasamo'i nyi grib ji bzhin du: rim par rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur 'jig: skyabs med 'gro rnams nyon mongasatshogasasdang nas: sangasargyasadangosasu byon yang skyobs par dka': 'on kyang nga yi smon lam bden 'brasakyis:gsang sngags zab mo gter gyi 'dul zhing ni: thengs skabs nyi zhur tsam las skyobs par 'byung : de skabs semasacan blo rmugs ngang rgyud thung : sa rtags rten 'brel 'byung ba dka' slas kyang : nga nyid 'gro la snying rje'i cher gzigs pas: sprul pa dpyid rka'i chab ltar rdol nasayong : yang zab gter 'dul bdag dang gnyisasu med: de bzhin stod smad rong chen sbas gnas sogs: ma 'ongasalung bstan bdag la gsal mod kyang : smra chol mang na zhe khrel 'byung ba'i rgyu: de bas rang 135

kha byang shel gyi me long /gsal dgongasapa'i mdzod du rgya: zhesagasungasazhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum pa'i skabs: yang cig rgyal po rje 'bangs tshogs kun gyis:mgrin gcig ngag gi gdangs la bcug nas kyang : mig nas mchi 'byin lha phyag gyang ltar 'tshal: 'jig rten dngosapo'i maṇ+ḍal ri ltar spungs skye bar dus gsum kun mkhyen ma hā gu ru rje: de ltar ma 'ongasarongs chen sbasalung sogs bka' gsal zer ma'i 'bru char rdo rje'i gsung : bdag cag gdul bya'i tshal du rtsi chen phobs: zhes zhus gu ru'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs: e ma rgyal po rje 'bangs tshogasakun nyen: nga nyid semasacanadon lasacher med kyang : mthongasalung bstan smra bar cher bsgom kyang : ka dag rdo rje'i tshig 'di nor che bas gsang sgo 'char bar dogs nas bzhag snyam kyang : 'on kyang rje'i dgongs bzhed tshim pa'i phyir: zur tsam smra bas mi brjed gzungs du thob: ma 'ongs brjed tho ri mo shul du shog: byang khams mdo khams rong rgyud ru bzhi 'di: sa rtags dus 'gyur lung bstan 'di bzhi 'ong : gangs ljongs stod smad dug gi nyo tshong g.yo: 'bri stag dkar 'brug bstan 'gro'i dpal yon la: bar skabasasad ser 136

kha byang shel gyi me long /nang zhabrug lce mgayo: rdzogasakho don rgyud me ro sil bur 'thor bar skabs las can 'khrul med byon srid kyang : gdul bya'i dbang gis 'gro phan 'byung ba dka' thang lha gangs dkar g.ya' ri gangs la gshegs: sbas yul ru ljongs bya ra cher mdzad zhing : rkyen des lha srin nag phyogs khengs cher mtho: chos zab tsa na bdud kyi bar chad ldang : bar rlung thal tshan khol mor g.yengasaba'i dus me mo rag dpon ri mo cher mngon zhing : na mtsho phyug mor bstan pa'i rtsal cig 'byung :skru kong dwagasasogasa'akhrug skad cher bsnyil cing :yulalugs mi 'dra'i skad 'gyur zhwa gos 'gyur: gos snyigasagong med rgya masabod du bzo: zas snyigs tha ma du ru ka yi bun: pho mos 'chol zas spyod cing sdig la brtson: bla ma dam med phyi ma'i rgyags phye med: khe tshong zhen 'dod dam tshig rtswa bzhin dor: dge slong dam 'chal nag chang mi gtsang spyod: mched la khrel ba'i brtse sems 'tshol nyol spyod:semasanyid sol phung ji bzhin zhe semasanag: sngagasapa dam med lusaspyod rgya chas bsgyur mtshon gyi dpon bgyis sgom sgrub rgyab tu bor lasagayengasadam mi srung zhing mnan gtad mos: mi skyasachosaskad 137

kha byang shel gyi me long /nya masagrub mtha' rtsod nalaphug lkog gsod bud med lusami thub:'jig rten bya spyod 'gyur ldog sprin ltar logs: sa bcud mi thub lo dgra sad ser mang : de dusadusaskabasame chu'i 'jigs pa dar: nad du sna min gtam skad sna tshogs sgrogs sum cu kha ral nyi shu la nye'i skabs pad+ma nga nyid thugs rje'i 'od zer las: gnam lcags rdo rje kun bzang bde chen gling : drag po nyi zla'i ming sogs mang byon kyang : rang rang 'dul zhing dag pa'i dpal ka rgyas: yang zab mtha' 'dul bdag dang gnyisasu med: khyad par nga nyid thugasarje'i skya rengs zer: da lta'i 'brog ban lo tsā khye'u chung : sprul pa gangs can khyab par 'gyed nas su: ma 'ongs mdo khams sgang stod sa yi char: lcags sdig gan rkyal sa phyogs pad 'dab 'dra'i: rgyal rigs gsang sngagasatshul 'dzin zab gsang 'chang : lha gi ming 'dzin byang chub semasadapa' 'byung : de dus chos 'dis bar chad lam grol nas: dus 'byung lung bstan mtha' gnyis spel bar 'byung : dbus ljongs ru gsum gong bzhin 'byung srid kyapa mdo khamasaganasadang sayi gnasabazhi mchog: gze rgyal tsā ri pad+ma gangs khrod ni yon tan phag gdong 138

kha byang shel gyi me long /ser mo'i gnas bzhi ste: zab mo gter gyi mdzod rgya nyer lnga gdams skyi 'byams dag pa gnasakyi gter mdzod de gsang sngagasazab mo'i rgya stag mchog tu rgyas: ru nga phrag dog bdud kyi gnyer kha 'dzin glang chen go rong ra tsha rdzong mgo dang : 'bum rdzong na bun mchod rten sku rgyal dang : ju brag gnas dpon rdzogs chen sbas gnas sogs:dpag par dka' ba gter gyisargyasabatab yod khyad par sngon chad ma grags gnas bzhi mchog: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bsti gnas 'od 'bar gling : gro lod hūṃ brag bde chen gsang ba phug gter kha bco brgyad sbas pa mkha' spyod gling : ma bsgom ting 'dzin skye ba'i mkha' spyod pa: zam bu'i cha lag shel brag bde chen gling : kha rong bcad mtshamasarnga rgyang tsā ri brag: 'bum rdzong 'bri byed zla phyogasasbasaganasapa: khyad par sbasalung yul skyong mchog 'od rtsal: samado chu gsum gnam sa 'khor lo'i rtsibs: pha wang rgya stag lam yig rtags ris gsal shar lam chu rjes brag sgo phyes pa'i mtshams: rdo dkar stag risagayung drungabaskosapa'i dkyil: gter srung mchod thabasabarda' rgyasasagand kyi ma yig gsal byed lam khrid tshul du yod yul gru 139

kha byang shel gyi me long /rgya tho dpag rgo brgya phrag tsam ma rmos lo tog rtsi me shing 'bras 'bru:mtha' dmag zing skad 'ur sgra cher ldir yang :ya nga bag tsha ba spu'i char mi sbrid lasacan ma 'ongasaru bzhi bye ba'i tshe mtshamasabazhi lo pa yengs med sbas tshul 'byung :las kyi mkha' 'gro bya'am khyi'i lo:phyag rgya nor med thabasashesarten 'grig na:sbasalung de yi lam sna khrid par 'gyur:sa skorimagya de yang dusa'abyung 'gyur dog 'di bzhin bstan:a ta rong dge stodabus rgyal rigs mi gsum 'dus:kha mang stong co cher bsgrags rang tshugs kyis:mi brten rang mang byang du 'thor bar 'byung :lho 'brug thig pa sa chen rgyal po 'bangs su'abebasamatha'anasarang byung rang khrag lco mgayo:mila'aphru 'bularang la dogs spyod dar snyu ོ sto ser nang rtsod tshog pa g.yo:mtha' ru ra ba'i them pa'i 'og tu rgya:gser ser tsa ming tsam ma bor tsam du gnas:de shul drag chen sde zhesaru dar 'dzugs mdo khams sgang stod yos ltar dkrug pa 'byung :sa chen nang wo rgyal po'i la yog blon la 'bebasabya la rgyal saphagagi rdzing bu 'gying :mi dkar glang snasanor bu snang la khyer:sachen rgyal po'i g.yo 'khrug la yog 'byung :40

kha byang shel gyi me long /mtho samarū nor dbang khi sa'i gser dan sngon sne rgyud salagosabu ljon par legasanyesache:sgang gzhong mang por thal phywa khol ma g.yo ge sar gling rjes khral 'jog khas dbang bsgyur:de dag ma nor wī yang rdo rje'i tshig:72/tho sa sdes phyogs su cho phrul cher g.yo zhing :bstan rkang gnyis kyi lo la 'phru zhig 'byung :mkhar nag nyi zer 'tsher yang bar bdud thul:rig shug rtsal shugasacher ngoms rnam smin gyi bdud kyi rgyal po brdzu nas 'tshe ba yod bar skabasadabang phyug me chen ra mdasagazhom:rkyen des sde'i rgyal po'i longs spyod dbul:mdo ru sri'u thal skyas dmag r+sā g.yo:chab drang sa mdo 'khor lo'i gnasamal du:pha tshul bu yisami tshugasatsam zhig 'byung :tshangasasrasazhe kha ma log rang tshugasazung :chosal phyogasarisamed par sdod tshugs na:bstan rkang ma zhig tsam du gnasasrid kyang :nga rgyal sbom po'i khri dar stong la nye:mgo 'phru dar bor stag 'phru 'dzugs nyes che:thub bstan thugs rje mgon dar ngag phun sogs:legs nyes shan mdzad rdo yul sbasatshul du kun bzang dgongasapa gzhan rdo bla phan bstan 'gro'i dpal: mchog gyur de dang dus 'byung 4

kha byang shel gyi me long /gnas 'byed gsal: le lo yid dbang zhu skabs ma mchis na:bar rlung phye ster mi 'tshal ngal dub mang snye dpal dbang skar bstan 'bras dkar phye ma la: mi dmar byang 'tshubs bar rlung ldang che yang :re zhig ma mngon dgra grogs nor ba gda': rdo rje'i rwa can bum de bcag srid na me tog lo ma bsdus skam nang 'khrugs dar:skabs yor cho lo ri mo mngon par bkra: sbas rgya: bar skabs bstan rtsal gso ba'i thabs bstan kyang : ma rig tshul 'chos le los bdud dbang song : bstan rtsal dgon gzhi nang 'khrug cher g.yo 'byung :gaḥthog smin grol bum bzang chen po'i bcud: nged yal tsam las mi stong mi srid kyang : bstan dgra kha nag stong skad sgrogs pa'i dbang :rdo rje'i gdan sar 'khrug gzhi 'byung nyen che: spel yul rdor bstan ri mo mchog rgyas yang : sa 'tshubs yo lang ser chem dar bar gyur:de dus mdo 'dzin 'dul ba'i sde snod dar: ri ser sa gzhi ser po 'gyur nyen che: de dusardo rje theg pa'i dam tshig lung : rang tshugs zin na gnas mal tsam du gnas: mdo gsum ri la sa 'gul sa 'phyo dus:mtha' dmag dpung tshogs ru dam lung par 'bebs: dmag 142

kha byang shel gyi me long /skad sil dbusadamag grangasayo lang 'byung : pad+ma'i 'dab stong dbusakyi phyogs su rgyas: zhabs ldan ma dkrugs rang tshol dog spyod zhing :bstan pa rdo rje'i ri la skar ma rgyal: phun tshogasadapal kun de yi phyogasasu khyer gnas mal ru bzhi yo lang stong rgyug g.yo: rkyen de bzlog pa lci mo rdo rje'i brag: g.yon zur chu 'gags chu srin gre sbug 'dra'i bzlog pa zab don mtha' dmaga.ar gtad gyi dug gi me sogasachu dar dril nas yod: gnam lcags phur bu smon lam dus bab dus:thog chen lta bus bsgral byed phyag 'dzin yod las can rdo rje'i ming dang dus 'phrad cing : rten 'brel ma 'phyug nor med 'grigs gyur na:mtha' dmag dpung bcasare zhig bzlog nasasu: rdzogasachen don rgyud rtsal smin bstan par 'byung : rgyun/ zhabs chen bon gter g.yung drung snying po'i spyod: zhabs chung gsang sngags bstan smin gter kha bdun sku rten phyag mtshan bsgral byed gter kha lnga: ma 'ongs dus rtags lung bstan kha byang gsum: snying po'i gter kha sbas pa'i pha waṃ yang : dus stabs sa yi bying zhing g.yo 'gul 'byung : rgya stag sa yi 'og tu ma brten na: gter rgya 'don pa'i (spyis bu )mang po 'byon:143

kha byang shel gyi me long /rten 'brel 'grigs na rdzogs chen don rgyud kyi bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan pa 'byung : bar skabs stong stong kha gling me chen ldang : rkyen byed ngan pa bar chad sdang nyes che: zhe chen theg dgon cher brtan rgyal srid kyang : dmag skad ldang zhing gter spyod skyes bu la rten 'brel ma 'grigs gshe ba'i le log 'byung : gnad 'phyug zab lam brgyud pa'i dal bsdus srid: de dbang ma gtogs rang tshod rang gis zung : dhe a 'khrugs shing kha rlangs ru dam 'gengs: gling rje'i mi sprul rtsal shugs cher g.yos nas: sa sde'i gzhud lugs chu ltar 'khrugs pa 'byung : mdo gsum chus 'jigs brag dkar phung shul thal: gser ser dbang chen 'khrugs nas med pa 'byung : go brag rung gsum bdud yul khro 'khrug g.yo: nyag shis gsang sngags phyi dar rung du rgyas: gsang sngags bon gyer zer kyang bstan rtsal smin: sku gnas ri rab pad+ma can zhes bya gsung gnas 'bru drug thugs gnas lcang shes brag 'o bran pad+ma snying phug gro lod gnas yon tan ri bkra kong rje trang dkar gnas:phrin las ngom yul skyi ring kha ba dkar: sngon tshe ye ngoms gnyis 144

kha byang shel gyi me long /po rtsod zhabrug cing : bya rog nag po'i rngamasasgra sgrog pa'i yul dbang chen rngams pa sha ba ru ring bsgral: sgro brag sad 'od dung seng gnam 'phyo 'dra'i g.yu drung rdo rje dril dkar bcu gsum gter gur khyim dar 'byams rnam snang zim pa dang : gsang sngags sbas gter dpag med rim par byon las 'phro sad pa'i las rkyen mang po phebs: sgrogats+tsha— yul rgya dmag gi 'khrug shing bar skabs 'jigs: phar cher sgrub thabs ri logs gsal bar yod: de ru mon mi bya nag mgo can des yul gter sa gnad rgya sgo gnam la ldang : kha lag 'brel 'jog ngan song sa bon g.yo: de 'dul da lta'i hūm̐ gi yang gsang chos: smon lam 'dzin skyong spel na bdud de thul: a ti'i bshad sgrub khol bur rgyas par gyur ri bkra'i sa phyogs g.yugs shes sa yi cha gru gu lha brag brag dkar dung rmog 'gri grags pa'i mtsho chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i nang : mdo khams sgang drug sa gnad kha byang yod go bo phug tu rdzong chung gsal bar brtsegs tshwa tshwa byang 'tshub byang 'brug kha dmar des: kha nas khrag skyo sems la dug nag 'chang : lag nas dug mda'i gtar ba ar 145

kha byang shel gyi me 'thong /gtad g.yo: rkyen des cha 'phros zab lam chos la dgra 'phral rkyen ma yin sngon gyi rgyu 'bras yin: re pho brag dkyil ka dag klong sde'i skor: brag dbyangs dkar po'i rgya sgo stong rtse'i gter: sa snying 'od mchog bre gang yang phyed sbas: ma 'ong bshad sgrub sngags gsum bstan la phan las can sbas pa'i rig 'dzin gsang sngags spyod: thabs shes ma bral gter de legs par thon: nga sprul la sprad smon lam yod srid kyang : dus spyod ngan las khas dbang 'gyur srid nas las can ma mthong tha mal tshul du go: bslu brid bdud zhugs nga5rdol thabs smra nyen 'byung : rten 'brel 'grigs na bstan pa rgyas yang srid: bstan 'gro'i dpal du nga nyid thugs bskyed kyi grub pa'i skyes bu ā nan+ta yi mtshan: bdag nyid dngos su mi lus snang tshul du: nges par byon pa dag pa'i dpal kha rgyas:smin cing grol ba'i slob ma dpag med 'byung : de mjal 'gro kun bsod nams mchog tu thob: sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gting dpag dka' bar ston: de 'dra'i gang zag nges par 'byon re rkan: bshad sgrub sngags bstan ya ma zung du rgyas bstan pa yun ring rdo rje'i 146

kha byang shel gyi me long /gdan 'god kyang : rkyen byed rgya 'dre dam sri'i smod pa yi: nang 'brug skyo ma rtsod gzhi zug rngur ston: mi rigs mi gsum khas drag gdong sme nag: mi dmag ban btsun sha ris me ri gzugs: rgya 'dre'i snying dkrug gzhog g.yon sme ba can: rkyen byed la yog g.yo 'khrug ldang srid kyang : rkyen de 'dul bar byang shar pha wang log bum gter sa snying rdzas ldan sbas pa dang : dgon srang mdo ru dbyin zlum mchod rten brtsigs: rgya 'dre dam sri mnan pa rdzu bzhir sba: sbyin pa rnam bzhi glud kha grangs med bcar: las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rab gnas yang du bya: thams cad khro 'khrug khengs sems cher mtho yang : bzod pa'i go chas rang sems rgyud btul zhing : rang rgyud rang gis dul na rkyen de zhi: bstan rtsal lam bzang dge ba'i 'bras bu ldan: ru bzhi dmag skad sil bur 'thor gyur na: bstan cha rtsal lag can der lan zhig rgyob: smyo1mo gang des ring lugs rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed mchog: gsang sngags smin rgyas pad bkod brda gsal bar: 'dul zhing dpal kha smin 1snal mtha' dbus brdal:bstan rtsal dkyil 'khor ji bzhin mdangs ston te: stag ri bo che 147

kha byang shel gyi me long /mchan/lung gser tshal me ri'i ma ldang na: kha ches ban btsun bdud kyi la yog gi rtsod 'khrug khrag mtsho ma rdol bstan cha rgyas: klu dbang rgyal po'i mtha' nas mchod rten gyer: sbas rgya: /mamo yol mo lhosteng wo/mas/ gangs 'gul khrag mtsho dmar chen g.yo nag po bdud sprul stong rgyug tshag rag gtong : dwags kong ngan byed thag snas rgya ltar 'brel: sbu lung lkog mar gri mdzo'i rang rtsal skams:skam na gsang sngags chos lding pho brang dar nyer lnga'i rje 'bangs rjes shul de ru mngon pad 'byung bdag gi snying thig de ru rgyas:dpag par dka' ba'i la lung chu brag shing : zab dgongs mdzod sgo dpag med de ru rdol: khyung tho la btsas bkra shis dar gyi brgyan:spu yul kun tu spos kyi dri zhim 'khyil: sbra ma lung du gdams pa'i gsang rgya dar mdung chu zab don snying po'i bstan cha rgyas: de skabs phyogs bzhi'i yul sgo bzhi 'byed cing : shar nas gying nag lho nas mun pa khrig nub nas sa hor nam thabs bod la 'khrid:byang nas sog dmag ba chus gser sgo ser po 'thor: sngo dkar chu dmag yis bod khams ru bzhi bsdigs: de dus rung chen sgo bzhi 148

kha byang shel gyi me long /brten par bya: shar gyi rgyal mo sbas rung bde skyid gling : lho yi tsha rung gab pa'i dga' ba lung : nub kyi kong po bres tshal smon lam zhing : byang gi a ta sbas lung 'dul zhing gling : de dag las can so so'i lam khrid nas: smon lam thebs pa'i skye 'gro der slebs tshe:bdud dmag sil bur khol yang bag tsha bral: yang gcig bsnyen pa gnas shing bde bar 'gyur: bar skabs dgra sna grogs kyi snal ma thag: bdud kyi sprul pas lam shad 'byung gyur kyang : bsrung dang bzlog pa'i man ngag gnad byang yod tsa'i 15〈 de 'das dus 'byung nyi shu la smad dus: me bdun chu gcig bskal pa gangs la rdza zhwa mo khra lcog mtha' dar chos log 'byung : ri log g.yo 'gul gangs thang ri mo can: pha wang gsal rdor gnam skas brag gi skas: bya ser 'ug pa'i gnas mal tshang zhing 'byung : de dus bsam yas shar lung dag ljongs zhes: shar lam bh+yo g.yib lcags sdig gan rkyal 'dra lam bsnyags las can mdo smad phyogs nas 'byung : sbas tshul nges med pad+ma'i bya ba skyong : rdzu 'phrul lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul bar yod shes rab 'brug lo glang chos ma gos pa:149

kha byang shel gyi me long /rten 'brel cher 'grigs snang stong tha tshig bzhag: sa lha bstan mas brda sgo legs gtad nas: bkod chen gling bzhi phran brgyad dkyil 'khor mngon: lasacan nyer lnga 'tshogasazhing dpal kha rgyas: dgongs brda snyan brgyud zab lam mngon par bkra: ma rmos lo tog 'tsho ba zas kyi bcud: dro grang gang 'dod gos bzang sman gyi gter:thams cad dag pa 'ja' lus 'od skur grol 'bras bu bzhir log chen po'i sa non te: bod gter bar skabs bstan gsal chen po'i lung : o rgyan bdag gis phran tsam brjod pa yin: mang bar zhib gsal yang tig so sor 'byung : dgos lung mi 'dra'i yang byang so sor sbas: halha lto snying bcud bcud gdams mun sel sgron me ste: dus bstan bstan gsal yang snying gcig tu dril:ma 'ongs 'ong ba'i gang zag blo ru gdams: brgyan gyur gyur pa'i brda yi rgya 'dzin dam: shekhrirtsonathazana'i zhu ho — ye ma de ltar dus bstan me long 'di: gsang rgya dam la dus bab spel ba'i skabs nub kyi phyogs nas bstan ral gsar du gso: shar phyogs tshangs sras rā dza'i mnga' 'bang byer la la zhabrug dang gso skabs 150

kha byang shel gyi me long /dus 'byung tshe: gdams pa brda 'gyur zab rgya legs par khrol:dus skabs spyod pa spel tshod ren par gyis:log lta can gyisathosapa srid mi bya: gang zag las ldan 'di bzhin bka' bsgrub na pad 'byung bdag gis bslu ba cang mi srid:de nas 'gro la zab pa'i chos bstan to: rang sems yan 'gal ma btang rang rgyud thul:mi rtag 'chi ba nan cher snying nas lha: ser/sa can pha mar ma gyur gang zhig med:byams pa tshad med snying rje'i sbyin pa thong :srog la bab kyang chos la blo ma log: rang rang ji ltar nus pa'i dge la 'bung :bzod pa'i go cha brtson 'grus rta la zhon bsam gtan 'tsho ba shes rab ldan par gyis:tshul khrims bslab gsum dwangs ba'i sa ru gnas:lus sems bral nas gnod 'gyod med par ::rdo la te spyor ra tshor tsho sa tsho 95 shāni sa tshomad: chas nyad rang nga 'phrad nas 'ag man nga : 'ad skur 'grub pa'i sa ru 'phos nas kyang :phyir mi ldog pa'i lam bzang chen por rgya:de bas bka' 'di snying du 'chang bar mdzod:ces gsungs pas gu ru'i bka' la yid rang zhing mngon par bstod nas:phyag dang maṇ+ḍal dgu phrug tu phul zhing 'di skad ces zhus so:e

kha byang shel gyi me long /ma kun mkhyen ma hā gu ru rje bka' gsang de nyid brjed tho shul bzhag thabs las can gang 'phrad 'gro don gang du skyong :sa gnam 〈snang sde gang sbas bka' stsal zhu:zhes zhus gu 〈co'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung :kyi ma nyon cig rgyal 'bangs grogs kun gson:ma 'ongs 'di nyid spel ba'i skal ldan ni:da lta'i 'brog ban lo tsā bya ba ni:ma 'ongs skye ba mang brgyud byang chub sems: lha ming rig 'dzin pad+ma bya ba skyong :klong sde'i sems smad bco brgyad tsit+tar bstims dus bab chos bdag mchog lnga snying 11gas cig:gter lung nas byung las ldan nyer lnga sogs: kun la zab lam 'di 'phrad skal ba bzang :klong sde brda 'god gter rgya bkrol ba'i bu:thugs sras hūṃ gi snying gi gong bur rgya: sgru157ska4 7ci— tharmam rgya rgya rgya:e waṃ gu h+ya maṇ+ḍal rgya rgya:zhes pa'i kha byang yang tig brda mdzod 'di: rig 'dzin pad+ma mkha' spyod rdo rje ngas dben pa'i gnas mchog saṃ ta bya skyibs su bde chen de waṃ shrī'i rten 'brel mthus dag par phab shing brda'i ri mor bkod:bka' 'bangs thugs kyi klong rgya btab pa'i mthus: spel nas 'gro phan rgya cher 52

gegyime4kha byang la lang /ci sa mo zhe saristing gyur ga chab mahreg4 rgya rgya sa pa' ga riris zhe dzi 44rjes 'i 'i'age'an mkha' spyad rda nyad kyas brda' ra mar bskur nas gnang rjede'iskabs 'a' mjug ma sgo mas/

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/(da)lha: yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag las: snying thig tshe yang phur gsum gyi: lung bstan gsal byed nyi zla'i dkyil 'bor bzhugs so:lha: dzesapo/na'i 'jigs med rdo rje'i sku brnyes ma hā gu rur 'dud mchog gi sgrub gnas ni ring sing ha'i rdzong gsum du: sngar ma grags pa'i zab gsang thugs kyi snying po'i chos:snying thig tshe yang phur gsum dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: sprul pa'i mnga' bdag rje 'bangs grogs bcas smin grol mdzad: de tshe 'jam dbyangs sprul pa mnga' bdag rgyal po dang : dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : 'brog ban lo tsā nam snying be+e ro tsa na dang : gnyag lo ye shes gzhon nu shud bu dpal seng dang : dran pa nam snying dpal rdor glang chen dpal seng 155

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/dang : klu yi rgyal mtshan sangs ye rma thog rin chen dang : rdo rje bdud 'joms dpal brtsegs ldan ma rtse mang dang : klu yi dbang po dpal dbyangs legs sbyin snying po dang : klu yi byang chub g.yu sgra rgyal ba blo gros dang : 'o bran dbang phyug rdo rje sprel chung la sogs dang : khram pa rgyan dang rdor mtsho nus sbyin gsal sgron dang : pad+ma gsal sgron mgon skyid gang 'bum la sogs pa: sprul pa'i rje 'bangs rnal 'byor mched lcam thams cad kyis: gser gyi maṇ+ḍal rat+na sna bdun tshom bkod nas: mgrin gcig sgo gsum gus pas zhu ba 'di skad phul: kye: kun mkhyen rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru chen po lags: zab gsal bla med snying thig tshe g.yang phur gsum 'di: gter nas bton pa'i dus tshod snga phyi nam tsam 'byung : gter ston las can gyi skyes bu phyogs gang nas 'byung : mgrin gcig zhus nas phyag bskor dgu phrug tu phul lo: kun mkhyen rig 'dzin ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa pad 'byung bdag ni srin po 'dul du gshegs shul du:sangs rgyas bstan bsnub sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bshigs:drug cu rtsa bzhir chos kyi 'chad nyan chad: bslu med mchog gsum bden pas ma dag rgyal po de: 153 badz+ra bya bas dpal gyi lha sar

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/bsgral bdud rgyal de 'byung bod khams res bde res mi bde:bod khams thams cad sdug pa'i mgo bo de nas 'jug: de nas bod khams bde skyid 'byung phyir chos rgyal khyod: rim bzhin mnga' bdag myang ston 3ce byed dbe ba 'bum: sa skya pa zhes dge slong dkar po dam lnga ra 3byung : per yul bder bkod sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi 'od brngar : na rgyan ge sprul 'phags pa'i yul na dha ra yi gsung ngag lam 'bras bstan pa rgya cher snang bar mdzad: : ti zhes byas gsang sngags bstan pa rgya cher spel: pad 'byung bdag sprul dhi paṃ ka ra zhes bya ni: bod yul 'dir byon bka' gdams bstan pa rgya cher spel: lto brag phyogs nas blo gros ming can 'phags yul du:phyin nas gdams ngag cung zad lon kyang bod yul 'dir brgyud phug gcig kyang grub mtha' 'dra min so sor dar : bla ma chos dang gdams ngag rgyun chad ring du 'gro mthar ni gcig la gnyis rtsod bstan pa'i phung khrol 'byung : gtsang stod phyogs nas bdud sprul stobs ldan ma rungs pa: badz+ra ming gis gtsang dbus sde dgon brlag par byed: skyi shod chos rgyal nyi ma thang du lhung ba dang : dkar 'brug 157

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/ le mo mdo ru ro khrag 'khyil 'bog byed: nga yi sgrub gnas pad+ma shel phug nye ba nas: byang sems tshul bzung bdud sprul phrin las ming can gyis: yar thang dkyil du dam sri gnan pa des ston nas:de yi kha rlangs bod du mi thogs bsdud par byed: rang thil phyogs nas byang sems tshul bzung ngag ming gis: lho mon skye 'gro sdug gi gnya' non byed pa 'byung : pad+ma bdag gi bsgrub gnas rnams su dam nyams byed: lho mon yul dgon gtan brlag bod yul 'di ru 'tshe:mthar ni gnas bsrung khros pas srog dbugs bsdud par byed:phung thabs nang 'byed de yi rigs chos gtan brlag 'gro: de dus zab gter 'di ston las can skyes bu ni: 'brog mi lo tswa'i skye ba mdo khams shar phyogs su bdud 'dul rdo rje zhes grags brtul zhugs ldan pa 'byung : sngar med gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag dngas ma 'di mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod phyes nas 'jig rten khams 'dir bkrol: bdud dbang ma song 'gro 'dren rgyal ba'i grogs su 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: mnga' bdag rgyal po mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la sogs pa sprul pa'i rgyal blon grogs 158

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'bor/dang bcas pa thams cad kyis: gtsug g.yu nor bu 'od 'bar rat+na sna bdun phul: gha na'i longs spyod la sogs tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor gser skyogs rat+na'i phra can rgyan chang gis bkang nas: rdo rje gzhog rgod rtsal la drangs shing 'di skad zhus: bdud 'dul dpal gyi rdo rjes zab mo'i gter la longs spyod tshe: mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po'i skye ba gang du bzhes: gangs can bod 'dir sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa': thugs rje nus stobs ldan pa ji lta bu 'byon lags: bod khams la dbang bsgyur chos rgyal ji lta bu 'byon: byang sems chose rgyal rnams kyi ming la ji mtshan lags:kun mkhyen rig 'dzin chen pos bka' stsal mdzad du gsol: zhes zhus pas: ma hā gu ru dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bka' stsal pa: e ma sprul pa'i rje 'bangs grogs bcas zhus pa shin tu legs: 'jam dbyangs sprul pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan khyod gangs can bod kyi rgyal khams yul dbus chen po 'dir da: za hor gdung mtha' 'dzam gling lha mi'i rgyan gyur pa rgyal gyi mtshan 'dzin 'dzam gling sum gnyis dbang bsgyur 'byung : bod yul bde thabs rmad byung 159

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/rlabs chen spyod pas skyongs: de tshe o rgyan nga yi zhal mjal lung bstan mdzad: mthong thos dran reg byang chub lam la 'god par nges: ma 'ongs tshe na sems can bsod nams dman na yang : lha mi'i mchod sdong sar gnas byang sems de ltar 'byon: de tshe bod khams bde bkod chos kyi rgyal po ni pad 'byung nga sprul mu khri btsan po sogs pa yi: rgyal po badz+ra ming can sprul nas gangs can 'dir: bod yul bde thabs bya las sna tshogs phan pa bsgrub: de tshe bod yul 'di ru bde ba'i nyi ma brdal: zhes gsungs pas: sprul pa'i rje 'bangs grogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis dar zab rat+na'i tshogs kyis maṇ+ḍal phul nas ni: lus ngag yid gsum mal lnga sar phab phyag 'tshal nas: rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal la mgrin gcig 'di skad zhus: kun mkhyen rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru chen po lags: de tshe nga yi bstan la 'tshe bar byed pa yi: dam nyams bdud kyi sprul pa 'byung mi 'byung : 'byung na bdud sprul de rnams gang gi phyogs nas 'ong : rig 'dzin chen po ma hā gu rus bka' stsole cig: kun mkhyen rig 'dzin ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa: e 160
