lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/ma sprul pa'i rje 'bangs grogs bcas gsan mdzod dang : ma 'ongs mnga' bdag skye ba 'dzam gling rgyan gyur gyis: bod khams sems can bde la bkod pa'i dus bstan la gnod pa'i sgo bzhi'i mtha' dmag bod 'dire lhud: spyir ni mdo khams bstan 'gro mtha' yi dmag gis bsdus: de dus sgo bzhi'i mtha' dmag 'ong ba'i snga ltas su dpal gyi bsam yas 'di yi gser 'phru yo ba dang : stod mnga' rir ru gdong la sngar med lha khang brtsegs: rgya gar yul kun rgyal po du ru ka yi byed: b.lapo'i yul du nang zhabrug chu ltar khol ba 'ong :rkang po'i mthil du dug gi chu mig rdol ba dang : brag gsum mthil du 'dre rgod kyi dngos gzugs ston pa dang : tsha ba'i phyogs su yul grong chu yis 'jigs pa dang : dpag gro'i phyogs su brag chad ri nyil 'ong ba dang : ma lung nang du sngar med mtsho mang rdol ba dang :rgya nag rgyal po'i gdan sa hor gyis bzung ba dang : mdo khams smad kyi gar mtsho sngon po chad pa dang : myang stod ri la sngar med brag chad ri nyil 'byung : yi thang phyogs su g.yu mtsho sngon po skem pa dang : 'bras 59rdong dpal ri'i rtse la bdud kyis lha khang bzhengs: 161

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/mdo khams phyogs nas bdud mo zung gis rdzu 'phrul ston mdo smad med yul phyogs nas dam nyams bdud sprul ni: gling rje ge sar rgyal la kha g.yar ba'i ma rungs bdud kyi sprul pa zung gsum 'byung ba'i dus: phre ta sar pa ta hor 'byum pa nag po dang : gnyan 〈snag me dbal bdun drug nad yams sna tshogs bslang : mi phyugs nor nad mi spyon khyi spyon lung pa khengs tshogs ma bsags rnams thams cad bdud sprul de la dad: de rkyen mi rung rnam pa sna tshogs de dus 'byung : kong po'i mthil nas lus kyi dbang po ma tshang ba'i:dam nyams bdud sprul gcig gis rdzun gter 'don pa 'byung :mkha' nas mi snyan 'ur lding than sprin 'khrigs: sa gzhir rlung nag 'tshubs ma lang nas khang pa sgyel: gnam nas mi sdug sngar med skar ma phod can ni: du ba dang ni ral can yang yang shar ba dang : gzhan yang yul khams kun tu than rigs sna tshogs mthong :mkha' nas mi rung nyi ma zung du shar ba'i dus: sgo bzhi'i bdud kyi mtha' dmag 'phyo ba'i ltas yin pas: de dus bdud dbang ma song bstan pa'i spyi rim dang : bod khams kun tu sa yi gnad gzer 162

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/gdams la 'bad bar chad dbang song shing sprul lo la mtha' dmag 'ur: mtha' yi dmag dpung 'phyo ba'i mtha' yi sgo bzhi ni mnga' ri'i byang stod zi rong mdo steng sa dam bzhi mnga' ris stod nas bdud kyi dmag sde bco brgyad 'phyur: dmag dpon rgyal dang seng ge a 'tshogs sogs pa la bdud rgyal de yi dmag gi grangs la bsam mi khyab re re la yang yungs dkar bre gsum bre do dang :tha ma bre gang tshad sogs bdud kyi dmag dpung des dam pa chos ni ngo mi shes pas mkhan slob dang : dge 'dun sde gsod gtsug lag khang rnams thams cad bshigs: pho mthong gsod cing mo mthong spyod la bran du bkol zi rong phyogs nas bdud kyi dmag sde bcu gsum lhag: rat+na rgyal dang skyed sogs tshe 'jings gras pa yi: dam nyams bdud sprul ma rungs stobs chen bcu gsum 'ong :grangs ni re rer bre do bre gang phul gang tshad: de 'byung byang gi yul 'brog sna gtad gtan nas brlag: mdo steng phyogs nas bdud sde zung gsum kha lhag nas: dga' dang mi dge a dang rgyal: sogs pa yi: rang 'gu a la sna gtad skye 'gro thal bar brlag sa sgo'i 163

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/phyogs nas bdud kyi dmag sde lnga lhag nas: 'jang rong bu 'bor sgang la sna gtad thams cad gsod: mtha' 'khob lho mon rnams nas bdud dmag chu rdol 'dra: dbang dang garma seng ge a gsol ming rnams 'ong : bar chad dbang song bstan pa'i spyi rim ma 'grub na: kha ba can 'dir che chung med pa thams cad gsod bod khams thams cad shwa 'ud khyer 'dra kha phung 'gro: de dus bod khams skyes tshad sems can snying re rje: zhes gsungs pa'i tshe: sprul pa'i rje 'bangs grogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas mgrin gcig 'di skad gsol: kye kun mkhyen rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru chen po lags: mnga' bdag rgyal po'i skye ba 'dzam gling rgyan cig dang : mu khri btsan sprul chos rgyal dpung dmar gdong rgyan sogs bod khams phung byed bdud dmag bzlog thabs ji lta bu bstan pa'i spyi rim la bsngags rig 'dzin byang sems ni:las can gyi skyes bu dam pa ji tsam 'byon lags bzlog thabs dang spyi rim la 'bung na bzlog thub bam kun mkhyen ma hā gu rus bka' stsol cig ces zhus pas kun mkhyen rig 'dzin ma hā gu 164

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/rus bka' stsal pa: e ma sprul pa'i rje 'bangs thams cad gsan mdzod dang : bod rnams phung byed bdud dmag de rnams bzlog thabs dang : de la bsngags pa'i las can skyes bu dam pa ni: phyogs dbus kun tu skyes chen dam pa mang 'byon yang : de la yon tan mi mthong log lta sna tshogs skye bstan pa'i spyi rim bzlog thabs sna tshogs yod mod kyang : bar chad dbang btsan mi rnams blo sna bdud bsgyur nas: sprul pa'i rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje la: yon tan mi mthong 'bar sha sgro bskur sna tshogs btab: la las 'di 'dra rdzun yin mi 'ong zer nas lus la las phan pa de tsam gar yod zer nasalus: resa'agasa'adi 'draphrob yin mi bden zer nasalus:re 'gas phyogasa'adzin 'di 'dra bcos ma yin zer lus pad 'byung bdag ni khyab brdal nyi zla dang mtshungs la bdag dang gzhan zhes phyogs 'dzin dri ma ga la mchis ma 'ongs chos rgyal skye ba byang sems snying stobs can: byang chub sems dpa'i rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor thams cad kun: nga yi lung byang sprul sku'i bka' la tshad mar 'dzin: bod yul bde thabs bstan pa'i spyi rim bya las 'bod 165

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/lha sa bsam yas ru bzhi'i gtsug lag thams cad dang : mchims phu spa gro stag tshang khon mthing shel brag dang : g.yer pa gong 'og zab lung phyug ri g.yas ru dang : dbu ru khra 'brug bu chu lung sgrol 'dong chu dang : khamasakyi gtsang khro ban ri bod mo ru thog dang : g.yon po lung phug pad+ma shel phug o rgyan phug bod kyi stag tshang la sogs bsgrub gnas thams cad du: rig 'dzin 'dus pa tshe dpag mi 'khrugs gtsug tor dang : sgrol ma bla ma'i bskang bshags brgya dang rtsa brgyad sogs: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor ji snyed mchod rgya 'dzug pa dang : gtsug lag zhig gsos sa yi gnad gzer thams cad gdams rang rang yul gyi sa yi gnad gzer thams cad du:skugasung lha bzhengs rab gnas bzlog 'khor mnan bsregs 'bung : bka' brgyad mtshan brgyad phur pa tshe bdag gzi ldan dang : stobs 'khor rgyal chen sde bzhi bstan ma'i lha khang bzhengs:bder 'dus tshe bdag phur pa rgyas 'debs bsgrub bzlog 'bung :'di bsgrub sgo bzhi'i mtha' dmag rang gshed rdul brlag 'gro:bstan pa'i spyi rim bsngags pa'i las can skyes bu ni: 'khon gyi 166

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/gdung rigs kun dga' 'am ni snying po'i mtshan: thugasarten mthil nas ngag dang rgyal gyi mtshan can dang : sa skya'i mthil nas kun dga' dpal dang srad nyi'i mtshan rtse thang zhal ngo bde ba dbang gi mtshan can dang : lug pa'i lung nas skal ldan rgyal gyi mtshan can dang : zab bu'i lung na rnal 'byor pad+ma'i mtshan can dang : gsang sngags gling nas skal ldan dbang gi ming can dang : lhun po'i phyogs nas byang sems rgya mtsho'i ming can dang : skyed tshal mthil nas ngag gam shes rab ming can dang : myong stod phyogs nas sngags pa rgyal gyi ming can dang : zur gyi phyogs nas pad+ma o rgyan ming can dang : gzhan yang lung 'dzin las can skyes bu dam pa 'gas:sa yi gnad gzer kun gdams mnan bsregs bsgrub bzlog 'bad grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin kun bral gnyis med las can ni:bshes gnyen las can dpon sras rgyal gyi mtshan can dang :grub las bsod blo'i ming can dam ldan skyes bu dang : zhu las rigs ldan dam ldan khrims kyi ming can dang : gzhan yang sman ri dar lding ri zhing rdzogs sogs nas dam ldan khrims dang rgyal mtshan nyi rme 167

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/g.yung drung shes rab sogs ban bon lung 'dzin las can skyes bu thams cad kyis: sa yi gzer gdams mnan bsreg bsgrub bzlog dag la brtson: phung byed sgo bzhi'i mtha' dmag bzlog par the tshom med dbus phyogs bde thabs bsngags pa'i las can skyes bu ni:chos gling mthil nas rig 'dzin mtshan 'dzin skyes bu 'byung :'bras sprung mthil nas bzang po tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang : dar dang rgyal mtshan grags pa shes rab ngag dbang dang : mchims phu'i mthil nas rgyal dang khrims kyi mtshan can 'byung : se ral dpal dang bzang po'i mtshan can byang sems 'byung : shel brag ngos nas gnyan na pad+ma'i sga gragasabla ma mtshan can dang : las can skyes bu zung 'byung bstan pa'i spyi rim bcol: lho brag phyogs nas rig 'dzin gling pa'i mtshan can dang : sto yi phyogs nas dom klong sprul pa zung gcig 'byung : zur mkhar gang nas rtse mang sprul pa'i khye'u chung :pad+ma rdo rje dbang gi mtshan can rigs gsum 'byung : rdo rje'i brag nas dbang gi mtshan can skal ldan dang : lho nas gling pa sprul zhes las can skyes bu 'byung : dpa' gro'i phyogs nas pad+ma dang ni rgyal 168

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/gyi ming :mnga' ris phyogs nas dpal dang bud+dha'i ming can 'byung :bsam yas mthil nas dbang dang bde ba'i ming can dang :dra yi phyogs nas dbang gi ming can gdung shugs ldan:yar stod sgang nas rgyal gyi ming can spyi rim brtson bsam yas mthil nas rgyal gyi ming can stobs ldan 'byung :bstan pa'i spyi rim phan bde'i bya las sna tshogs bsgrubs: dra yi phyogs nas pur+bhe dar gyi ming can zung :de rnams rgyud bskul bod yul bde thabs sna tshogs 'bod:gzhan yang las can lung 'dzin skyes bu dam pa 'gas:sa gnad gso zhing rab gnas mnan bsreg bsgrub bzlog 'bad:de rnams 'gro 'dren rgyal bas rab tu gnas pa dang : bod khams bde ba'i bkra shis smon lam yang yang gdab:bstan pa'i spyi rim kun 'grub bod khams bde nyi brdal: kong yul bu chu'i gzer gdams rab gnas mchog shis pa:thogs med dbyings sprul bde ba'i mtshan gyis rab tu gnas:myang kha'i phyogs nas klu'i byang chub sprul pa ni:legs sam bde ba'i mtshan can las can skyes bu 'byung : sa yi gnad gzer gdams shing rab gnas brtan bzhugs bgyis:69

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/kong stod sa dkar phyogs mthil las can skyes bu mchog: rig 'dzin yang na pad+ma'i mtshan can skal ldan 'byung : kong stod mthil nas dbang gi ming can dam ldan dang : shā khang gnas sgor dri med gdung rigs skyes bu ni: rigs sam pad+ma'i dbang gi mtshan can dam ldan dang : kong stod phyogs nas g.yu sgra'i sprul pa 'khrul zhig ni ngag gi ming can spyod pa chal chol spyod pa 'byung : myang kha ba ru nye bar rin chen gling pa yi: gdung 'dzin pad+ma'i ming can dam ldan sngags pa 'byung : jo mo lung nas ngag gam dbang gi mtshan can 'byung : 'o shod phyogs nas pad+ma'i ming can dam ldan sogs lung 'dzin las can skyes bu de rnams kun 'dus nas: bstan pa'i spyi rim sa yi gnad gzer thams cad gdams: rab tu gnas shing bsgrub bzlog mnan bsreg dag la 'bad bod khams bde ba'i bkra shis smon lam rgya chen gdabs: 'di 'grub bal yul kong po'i 'gro la bde skyid 'byung : khams kyi byang dbus shar nub phyogs nas 'gro phan gyi skal ldan las can bstan pa'i rim gror brtson pa yi: rdo rje pad+ma'i ming cam 'gro la phan sems ldan rong 170

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/yul phyogs nas bstan 'dzin ming can dang : kaḥthog mthil nas mo ga'i ming can zhi dul ldan: sga stod mthil nas srad lha'i ming can byang chub sems stag bu'i yul nas skal ldan rta yi ming can dang : ku rong yul nas las can shes rab ming can dang : ka ༷thog phyogs nas bla ma'i ming can zhi dul ldan: rgya yul phyogs nas dam ldan tra ya'i ming can dang : gnas mchog rtse ra nye bar ma ti'i ming can dang : gnas mchog seng lung gnas nyer dga' ba'i ming can 'byung : ma 'ongasar yi yul nasadage ba'i ming can dang : 'u yi yul nas dam ldan purkye'i ming can dang : 'dan stod mthil nas dam ldan rgyal gyi ming can dang : khams ra'i phyogs nas pad+ma'i ming can brtul zhugs ldan ngam gyi phyogs nas badz+ra mi 'gyur rdo rje ming can kha byang 'dzin: dga' rje'i phyogs nas dam ldan 'dun pa'i ming can 'byung : tshu ba'i phyogs nas rgyal gyi ming can blo ldan 'byung :'bri chu'i rgyud nas rgyal gyi ming can gus ldan dang : rdo gnas mdun nas tshe yi ming can chos spyod can: btsan ri'i gnas nyer ra yi ming can gus ldan 'byung : steng can phyogs nas dran nam thugs 171

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/sprul rgyal gyi ming : mdo rag phyogs nas tshe dbang sprul pa rgyal gyi mtshan: rig 'dzin 'brug mgo'i thugs sprul tsha sgang phyogs nas 'byung : li tsa'i thugs sprul kha rag gnas nyer sur+ya'i mtshan:rngu chu'i rgyud nas tshe dbang gsung sprul khrims kyi mtshan: khyung po'i mthil nas dpal bon sprul pa dam ldan 'byung : mu khe'i sprul pa dga' rje'i phyogs nas rgyal ming 'byung : 'dan gyi phyogs nas rgyal gyi ming can skyes bu 'byung : lung 'dzin las can skal ldan skyes bu thams cad kun: ma 'ong nga sprul bdud 'dul rdo rje'i 'khor brdzus la: sa gnad gzer gdams sku gsung thugs rten lha khang bzhengs: bon chos rang rang rab gnas bsgrub bzlog thabs la 'bad pad 'byung nga nyid bka' dang sprul sku'i gsungs bzhin du bod khams kun gyi sa yi gnad gzer mtha' dag tu sa bcos rab gnas bsgrub bzlog mnan bsreg thabs 'bung na bod khams lho byang mtha' dbus yul kun thams cad du 'gro 'dren rgyal bstan 'phel zhing mi lo brgya lhag bar bod bde nyi ma bdar bar pad 'byung bdag gisabaka' bar chad dbang song bstan pa'i spyi 172

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/rim ma 'grub na shing sprul lo la stod kyi dmag lhag bod yul 'dir: mkhas btsun bzang dgu bkrongs shing gtsug lag khang rnams bshig: pho mthong gsod cing mo mthong chags spyod bran du bskor: dam pa'i chos bsgrubs ban bon ser chags thams cad bsad: bon chos 'chad mkhan mgo bo gcod cing dbang po bsnubs mdang skyes a nyog thams cad gri ru 'chi bar 'gyur: gnam la char med rtsi shing thams cad skam pa dang : chu bran thams cad skam shing gram thang skya bor 'gro: g.yung dwags ri dwags thams cad mu shes 'chi bar 'gyur: de tshe yams nad rigs la mi 'ong bya ba med mi rus thams cad gram thang skya bo 'dra ba 'byung : a re 'gyod na gsung : de tshe sprul pa'i rje 'bangs grogs bcas thams cad kyis rat+na sna bdun maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di skad zhus: kye kun mkhyen rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru lags bdud dmag de rnams mthar rang yul du log gam bdud kyi dmag dpung de rnams bod 'dir ji tsam 'dug: de yi rjes la bod 'dir bde skyid ji 'dra 'byung : slar yang bod 'dir bdud kyi dmag dpung ji 'dra 'ong : kun mkhyen rig 173

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/'dzin ma hā gu rus bka' ྅65 cig: ces zhus pas: kun mkhyen rig 'dzin ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa: e ma mnga' bdag rgyal po rje 'bangs grogs bcas gsan mdzod cig byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rgyal po de rnams kyis bar chad dbang song bstan pa'i spyi rim ma 'grub na bod khams brlag byed sgo bzhi'i mtha' dmag de lhag nas: 'dzam gling rgyan gyur jo bo klu yis gdan 'dren byed bdud dmag de yi bstan pa drug cu rtsa bzhir gnas: mthar ni nad yams mu ge nang tshan 'khrug pa yis: rang rang nyal thag gcod cing bod 'dir brlag par 'gyur: de ltar lcags khyi'i lo la bhi ta zhes: dmag dpon nyi shu 'khor gyi grangs ka ni: nyung dkar bre ni nyi shu'i grangs ka 'byung : ba glang dmar po zhon nas lcags kyu mdung thung thogs: de 'dra'i dmag tshogs lhag nas lo bdun 'joms zas su mi khyi'i sha za rdo dri 'jibs de nas sgo bzhi byang lung thams cad nas: byi ba rta yi lo la rim bzhin du mi ma yin 'dra sbal mgo khyi mgo can: 'bu srin gzugs can rnam pa sna tshogs lhud gi ta'i dmag tshogs de yis hab khyer btang : de yi bstan 174

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/pa lo lnga'i bar du gnas: de nas byang khams lung pa thams cad nas ji li nag po zhes bya bdud kyi sde mgo gsum lag drug yod pa'i bdud dmag lhag: de la grangs med nam mkha' bar snang dang : sa gzhi nas phyo sa rdul rlung bskyod 'dra: bar snang nas phyo bu yug 'tshubs pa 'dra nam mkha' nas phyo kha ba bab pa 'dra: lo bcu'i bar du skye 'gro'i srog dbugs bsdud: rgya gar tshun chad de yisa'ajomasapar byed: de tshe pad 'byung bdag gi sku sprul ni: mkhar chu'i phyogs nas grub thob chen po gcig gcan gzan lpags pa bco brgyad lus la gnas: lcags kyi mda' gzhu thogs nas bhi li bsgral dmag dpon thams cad dmyal thag de yis gcod:phrin las sprul pa gtsang gi phyogs nas 'ong : thugs kyi klong nas gnam lcags sbrang bu ni: bye ba 'bum tsho 'bum tsho dpag med 'gyed:lcags kyi sbrang mas bdud dmag thams cad kyi lus kyi phyi nang dra tshag lta bur mdzur gsung sprul dge sbyong dharma pha la zhes rdo rje gdan 'byung ngag gi bden pa 'grub bod khams phung byed mtha' dmag thams cad kyi lus ngag thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par 175

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/byed: bden pa'i stobs brjod thal mo brdabs pa'i tshe: bdud dmag thams cad brgyal rengs 'bog par 'gyur bod 'dir mi yi sa bon lus mi 'gyur pad 'byung bdag ni rig pa'i ye shes las ma 'ongs legs nyes 'byung ba mngon shes kyis: de tshe bod 'dir mi yi sa bon ni: spel phyir rdzong dkar gnas sogs phyogs bzhi nas mi yi sa bon yul bzhi sbas pa yod: sbas pa'i yul bzhi de ru dus kun tu pad 'byung bdag gi sprul pa rgyun mi chad: dam pa'i chos ni 'dus pa skor bzhi dang : rig 'dzin 'dus pa bka' 'dus rgya mtsho dang : de tshe pad 'byung bdag gi sprul pa yis sbas pa'i sgo bzhi phyes nas 'byed pa dang : bod kong 'di ru mi yi sa bon spel: slar yang bstan pa rgya cher 'phel zhing rgyas: chos rgyal skye ba byang chub sems dpa' yi bstan pa'i spyi rim la 'bung bdud dmag kun: gzhig gisagacig brlag thal ba rlung khyer 'dra: lha sa'i jo bo rgyun du gnas pa dang : bstan pa 'phel rgyas skye 'gro bde nyi brdal: gangs can bod 'dir kho bo bka' drin che: de dus skal ldan mos gus blo yod na mos gus gdung bas gsol ba phur 176

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/tshugs thob rten 'brel dag pa'i smon lam stobs shugs kyis sangs rgyas kun las bdag nyid thugs rje myur: sprul pa glog stong 'byug cing zhal ston zhing : chos gsungs lung bstan mngon sum byin rlabasa'ajug: skal ldan tshogasachen bsagasapa mgatogs pa pad 'byung bdag la dad pa'i mi re dkon: de dus 'gro rnams longs spyod mkhan la dad bod khams bde 'gro pho mo snying re rje:yul la bdag med sgyu ma'i grong khyer 'dra nor la bdag med kun gyis hab khyer byed de dus bod yul skye 'gros ci sems ang :zhes gsungs pa'i tshe: mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po dran med brgyal:mtsho rgyal la sogs skal ldan thams cad kun: dbugs 'thums sar 'gyel mchi ma klung chur 'bab rig 'dzin pad+mas ljags chab ngo la 'thor brgyal du song ba sos nas 'di skad zhus: kye ma rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru lags dusangan snyigs ma'i mtha' la nye ba'i dus:mnga' bdag skye ba 'dzam gling rgyan gyur pa byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs chen po yis bstan 'gro'i don du rlabs chen spyod pa yis bod yul thams cad bde la bkod pa dang : rig 'dzin 177

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/chen po bdud 'dul gling pa yis bod yul bde thabs gnas gter sgo 'byed dus: sangasargyasarnams las thugs rje gang gi myur:yi dam lha las byin rlabs gang gi che: sgo bzhi'i dam sri mtha' dmag 'dul ba yi: khro rgyal rnams las mthu stobs gang gi che:dgra bgegs 'byung po ma lus bsgral ba yi: chos skyong rnams las mthu rtsal gang gi che: dpal gyi lha sa bsam yas 'di nyid la zhig gsos bkur sti rim gro ji tsam 'ong : rig 'dzin ma hā gu rus bka' stsol cig: zhes gsol pas: rdo rje gzhog rgod rtsal gyis bka' stsal pa: e ma sprul pa'i rje 'bangs thams cad gsan mdzod cig dus gsum rgyal bas dbang bskur smon lam gyis: sangs rgyas kun las bdag nyid thugs rje myur bod kyi lha skal nam mkha'i rgyal po yin: yi dam thugs rje chen po byin rlabs che: mkha' 'gro'i rigs ni bye ba bsam 'das kyang : dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje phag mo yin khro bo'i rigs ni brjod kyis mi langs kyang : snyigs dus dam sri mtha' dmag 'dul ba yi: khro mchog rdo rje gzhon nu 'gran zla bral: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrungs ba'i lha: chos 178

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/skyongs rigs la shin tu grangs mang yang : dgra bgegs 'byung po dam sri kun bsgral lha bstan srung legs grub rdo rje 'gran zla bral:spyir ni rma chog gsum lha kun dbyer med kyang : snyigs dus gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs: thams cad kun 'dul gnyen po lha lnga yin: 'di min dam sri bdud dmag bzlog mi nus de dus gnyen po lha lnga yod dam zhes ba chad kun zhi dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: de dus dpal gyi bsam yas 'di nyid la: klong chen sprul pa bzang po'i ming can gyis: 'jigs skyobs zhig gsos rab gnas nan tu bskyar: mu tri mu tig mched gnyis rnam par sprul:shar gyi phyogs nas rdo rje'i ming can ni: las can skyes bu dam pa mched gnyis 'byung : 'gran bral dpal gyi bsam yas 'di nyid la zhig gsos bskur sti rim gro rlabs chen spyod chos rgyal khyod kyi skye bas 'gro ba 'dren: sar gnas byang sems snying stobs chen po yi: lha sa chos 'khor 'di yi 'jigs skyobs sogs mchod bstod bkur sti rim gro phun tshogs bsgrub: bod yul bde ba phal cher de las 'byung : de sngon sar gnas byang sems mang byon kyang :179

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin rang rang gnas dgon du: gtsug lag ming 'dogs sa skyog re skyol nas: nga bdag ma thul gzhan las rang cher brjod: lha sa bsam yas 'di la zhabs tog med ru bzhi'i gtsug lag thams cad g.yem par 'gro: dpal gyi lha sa bsam yas khra 'brug sogs: ru bzhi rang byung gtsug lag 'di 'jigs na gtsug lag gzhan rnams ro la mi 'dzin 'dra: bod yul bde ba ster bar ga la nus bod khams bde thabs ru bzhi'i gtsug lag dang : bod khams sa yi gnad gzer rnams la rag:de phyir rten 'brel gnad 'gags zhib tu rtsis: bod yul bde thabs bstan pa'i spyi rim du: sa bcos gnad kyi gdams pa shin tu gces: sngon byon sa gnas byang sems bla mchod rnams skal ldan yin kyang glo bur bdud bslus nas: ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang la zhabs tog med pad 'byung bdag dang gsang sngags chos la smad: de 'bras bsod nams mnga' thang nyi zhur 'dra dpal gyi lha sa bsam yas 'di rnams la: 'jigs skyobs rlabs chen bkur sti de 'dra ni: sngon med ma 'ongs tshe nas 'byung mi 'gyur: zhes 180

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/gsungs pas: chos rgyal mtsho rgyal sprul pa'i rje 'bangs kyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas mgrin gcig tu:tse( rgyan rje la zhu ba 'di skad phul:kye ma:kun mkhyen ma hā gu ru rin po che:de dus gangs can bod kyi yul 'di stsa sgo bzhi'i mtha' dmag de rnams 'ong ba'i rkyen:gang zag rab 'bring ji lta bus byed lags: kun mkhyen ma hā gu rus bka' stsol cig:zhes zhus bas rig 'dzin ma has bka' stsal pa: e ma sprul pa'i rje 'bangs thams cad snyan gson dang :ma 'ongs sems can bsod nams dman pa yi bstan pa'i spyi rim sa gnad ma gdams na bstan pa gcig la grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin gyis:gcig la gnyis rtsod bod khams sdug la gtad:garma'i ming can stod hor nyi grags dang : mchod yon bsgrig nas mtha' yi dmag sna 'dren: dbu ru phyogs nas dbang gi ming can gyis: bka' gdams rgyal ba'i bstan la shin tu 'tshe:mdo smad phyogs nas shākya'i ming can gyis: sa smad phyogs nas mtha' yi dmag sna 'dren dbang gi ming can lho nas mtshan khang ldong :mdo byang phyogs nas dga' ba'i ming can gyis: mtha' dmag bod du 8

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/phyur ba'i sna 'dren byed: seng ge'i ming can stod kyi phyogs nas 'phyo: mdo khams phyogs nas rje dga' 'tshogs pa'i ming :mtha' da ga g.yab pa'i rkyen kha nges par byed sgom nang mthim nas a yi ming can gyis: mtha' dmag smar khams 'phyo ba'i 'ben du 'dzugs: smar 'argya'i phyogs nas purkye'i ming can gyis:mtha' yi dmag dpung 'bod pa'i g.yab dar byed: khrom gyi phyogs nas klags kyi ming can gyis: mtha' dmag smar du 'phyo ba'i sna thag byed: gzhan yang dam nyams bdud kyi sprul pa ni: ban+de'i tshul bzung phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyu bsam pa dkar la sbyor ba nag po yi: bla ma'i chas bzung med dam dud 'gro'i ming : skye bo mi nag pho mo mnga' dbang bsdus: khams byang phyogs 'byung pad 'byung bdag nyid kyi sa gnad mchod rten bshigs dang sna tshogs byed:sga yi phyogs nas 'dzin gyi ming can gyis: khams kyi pu rang sa gnad de yis gtor: phrin gyi ming can mdo khams mchod rten gso:zla rgyud phyogs nas bzang po'i ming can gyis: sdil thang sa 'dul mchod rten de yis bshig ngag gi ming can khams kyi glang thang gi 182

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/dam sri 'byung po sbas pa gnam du gtong : de rnams rkyen byas sa gnad 'thor ba yi: mi bde mi rungs nad yams mtshon kha sdong :btsa' sad ser gsum lo thog bsdud pa 'byung : mdo khams phyogs nas bla ma'i tshul bzung 'gas: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po ra skyon rtogs nas grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin yig drug dgag pa dang :nga yi bla ma sangs rgyas kun lhag pas: 'di mtshan sgrong dang yi ge drug pa 'dus: 'di mtshan sgrongs dang nad mug mtshon 'khrug dang :mtha' dmag dpung bzlog smra rgyun 'dzugs par byed: de rkyen rang rang mi bde'i mun pa 'thib skyong gi phyogs nas pad+ma'i ming can dang : khams kyi phyogs nas dharma rat+na'i ming : rdzun gter 'don cing pad 'byung bdag nyid kyi: sgrub gnas rnams su dam nyams byed cing rgyu: rnam snang phyogs nas dam nyams bdud sprul cig:mgo yi ming can bdag gi sgrub gnas su: dam nyams byed cing chad pa'i lta ba ston: kaḥthog phyogs nas lta log sde lnga 'byung : 'od gsal rdo rje snying po than du blta log pa'i lam khrid ston pa khyu cig 'ong : lha kong smar tshe'i phyogs rnams thams cad du: dam chos 183

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/phyag rgya can la ming 'dogs nas:chad lta ston cing dud 'gro'i sa bon 'debs:'brel tshad thams cad log pa'i lam la khrid spo rang phyogs nas grags pa'i ming can gyis:lho yi mtshon kha de yis nges par klong :zur sde'i rgyud nas bdud sprul 'das log pa klu yi ming can 'brel tshad mnar med khrid:mdo smad 'bri rgyud bdud mo stong gi ming :kha lag 'brel tshad rdo rje dmyal bar bde kaḥthog phyogs nas bdud mo skyid kyi ming :skyes chen bzang dgu mang po dug gis bkrongs:'gog za'i yul nas ban+de bdud kyi sprul:dud 'gro'i ming can 'brel tshad dmyal bar khrid:rmo rong yul nas bon po khrims kyi ming :bdud sprul bla ma'i tshul bzung 'brel phung 'ong :bar gling yul nas bdud sprul dge slong zung : 'grub tshe'i ming can dug gi sa bon 'debs:zil khrom dkar yag zhol nas bdud sprul ni:khro gtum zhe sdang 'grub kyi ming can 'ong :sa sgo'i mtha' dmag 'bod pa'i g.yab mo byed: khams kyi byang 'brog garma'i ming can gyis mdo sgo'i mtha' dmag yang yang g.yab mo byed: ma 'ongs gaḥthog nye ba'i dpal 'bar du:bdud sprul thar 84

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/gyi ming can dug 'gyed byed: lho yi phyogs nas 'brug ces dhe ba'i ming: khams dpung mdun nas bdud kyi g.yab mo yis: sa sgo'i dmag dpung phyur ba'i rkyen bskul byed ma 'ongs tshe na rgyal bstan la gnod pa'i bdud kyi sprul pa dbyar chu rgyas pa 'dra: de yi gnya' non spyi rim sa gnad bcos: o rgyan nga sprul bdud 'dul gling pa yis: phur pa gzi ldan bsgrub bzlog nan 'bad cing : sa gnad gso dang mnan bsreg la brtson pas: bdud dpung de rnams brlag par the tshom med: ces gsungs so: de tshe sprul pa'i rje 'bangs thams cad kyis: gha na'i 'bor lo bskor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: mgrin gcig o rgyan rje la 'di skad zhus: las can lung 'dzin skyes bu dam pa yis: bstan pa'i spyi rim rlabs chen spyod pa'i dus: bod khams yongs nas de yi mthun grogs su: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag skal ldan pho mo ni: gang 'byung de yi phyogs dang ming gnang zhu: de 'grub phyi nang dgra dpung 'dul ba dang : bstan pa ring thung ji tsam gnas pa dang : gzhan yang las can skyes bu ji tsam 'byung : rig 'dzin gshog rgod rtsal gyisabaka' stsol cig ces zhus pas: kun 185

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/mkhyen ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa: ma 'ongs lung 'dzin skyes bu dam pa yis: bod yul bde thabs sa gnad bcos pa'i tshe: mthun grogs bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'di ltar 'byung : sngon tshe zas gtsang sras kyi spyan sngar nas: smon lam rten 'brel bzang po'i gnad 'gags kyis: tshogs bsags las can skal ldan pho mo ni: khri bzang sprul pa gtsang stod phyogs nas 'byung : a yi ming can rgyud bskul phan bde bsgrub: nyi ma a tshe shākya bsam 'grub skyid rgyal dang badz+ra dga' ba bde ba'i ming : myang stod phyogs 'byung bstan pa'i mthun grogs byed: khri mgon khyims sde rog dpal skye ba ni:tshe dang rgyal dang rin chen bde ba'i ming : 'o yug shing gi phyogs 'byung bkur sti byed: ru bzang zhang rgyal bla sman skyo bzang skye: mgon dang dpal dang lha dbang rgyal gyi ming : lha sa zur mkhar g.yab pa'i phyogs nas 'byung : tsa mi rgya bzang 'grogs dge dpal skyid rnams legs dang rgyal rigs ngag gi ming can ni: stod lung bsam yas lho brag ya mdo nas nges 'byung mthun grogs bkur sti phun tshogs byed: dkon dpal mgo bzang ya sde khri dpal ni: a 186

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/tshe rgyal dang bzang po dga' ba'i ming : kong po'i yul 'byung phan bde sgrub gnas byed: gzhan yang las can tshogs bsags mthun grogs ni: pho mo mang 'byung bod yul bde thabs brtson: g.ya' dpal brtse bzang shang drag dbang 'byor ni: tshe rgya khro lha mgon dbang srad nya'i ming : khams dga' phyogs 'byung bskul ba'i rogs phan bsgrub: mgo yag mgo rje lha rje dbang lha ldan ni: mo gha gha ga rat+na sgrub rje'i ming : yul gshis su rong lab lung phyogs nas 'byung :'gos pa khri sde drag 'khor dbang ldan skyes: drag dang rgya mtsho ma ni garma'i ming : mdo khams tsha smar ke yi phyogs nas 'byung : bstan pa'i spyi rim grogs dang bskur sti byed khri sde dpal skye sga yi shar phyogs na: e yi ming can rgyud bskul grogs mgon byed: lha bzang skye ba 'dan gyi phyogs ngos nas skya yi ming can 'byor ldan mthun grogs byed: blon po dbang rgyal skye ba gling yul nas:nā tha'i ming can gus dan mthun grogs byed: nus sbyin skye ba ma 'ongs chung 'bum du bud med skyid kyi ming can bskur sti byed: bla sman me ru'i skye ba ri bar du: 'tsho byed kame'i ming gis mchod bstod 187

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/byed: shel dkar skye ba ma 'ongs gling yul du: bud med byams pa'i ming can phan sems ldan: bstan pa'i spyi rim grogs dang mchod bstod byed: gzhan yang gtsang dbus lto kong khams dag nas: smon ldan bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa yi: skal ldan las can pho mo kun 'dus nas: bstan pa'i spyi rim grogs dang bya las byed: de tshe bstan pa'i spyi rim gegs byed pa'i: bla chen ston pa mi nag pho mo ni: dharma bzang po rgyal dang garma las: dpal 'grub 'tshogs dang grags pa dga' ba'i ming : bstan dang bsod nams dbang gi ming can 'gas: spyi rim gegs byed sgro bskur sna tshogs gdab: de rnams lha sbyin gcung dga'i skye ba yin: tshe rabs gtan du bde 'gro'i sgra mi thos gegs byed bstan pa'i spyi rim sgrub 'bung na: rgyal bstan nub med 'gro la bde skyid 'byung : phyi nang 'khrug pa sgo bzhi'i mtha' dmag sogs: dgra dpung rang gshed dbab cing nang 'byed nas: gcig gis gcig brlag thal ba rlung khyer 'dra: bstan pa'i spyi rim sayi gzer gdams pas: bod khams thams cad bskal pa bzang por gnas: de dus las can skyes bu 188

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/dam pa ni: 'khon ston chen po klu yi dbang po khyod: sa skya'i mthil nas purkye'i mtshan can 'byung : sgom po'i mthil nas nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul: badz+ra mtshan 'dzin las can skyes bu 'byung : bha gor skye ba lto brag sna bo nas pad+ma'i ming can dam ldan skyes bu 'byung :lo tsā bo dhi ma ti'i sprul pa ni: dpa' 'gro'i phyogs nas rgyal mtshan ming can 'byung : lo tsā rin chen dpal gyi sprul pa ni: lho brag phyogs nas rat+na'i ming can 'byung : lo tsā ye shes dbang gi sprul pa ni: gro shul phyogs nas bsod nams ming can 'byung : lo tsā srad nya ra smi'i sprul pa ni: dpal ri'i phyogs nas dzñā na'i ming can 'byung : lo tsā grags pa dbyangs kyi skye ba ni: ri ldan phyogs nas bzang po'i ming can 'byung : kho bo tshul khrims 'od kyi skye ba ni: 'bras spung mthil nas ngag gi ming can 'byung : lo ci dkon mchog 'od kyi sprul pa ni:mchims phu'i mthil nas pad+ma'i ming can 'byung : 'gos pa bzang po drag gi sprul pa ni: spa gro'i phyogs nas pad+ma'i ming can 'byung :gnubs ban bzhi girti'i sprul pa ni: lho yi phyogs nas dbang gi ming can 'byung : rdzog ro bsod nams dpal gyi sprul pa ni: spa 189

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/gro'i phyogs nas gsang sngags ming can 'byung : lhag ston dar ma dpal gyi sprul pa ni: sa skya'i mkhan po bsod nams ming can 'byung :rong pa blo gros 'byung gi sprul pa ni: gtsang gi phyogs nas ngag gi ming can 'byung : dar pa rin chen dbyings kyi sprul pa ni: bod yul mthil nas rgyal mtshan ming can 'byung : rma ban ye shes 'byung gi sprul pa ni: mnga' ri'i phyogs nas bzang po'i ming can 'byung: snyag lo rat+na dpal gyi sprul pa ni: glo bo'i phyogs nas rgyal gyi ming can 'byung : tsa yi dharmā kirti'i sprul pa ni: yar 'brog phyogs nas rig 'dzin ming can 'byung : mchims lo bzod pa dpal gyi sprul pa ni:mdo khams shar nas shes rab ming can 'byung : zangs pa tshul khrims 'od kyi skye ba ni: sga yi phyogs nas dharma'i ming can 'byung :sras pa dar ma dbang gi sprul pa ni gling yul phyogs nas dbang gi ming can 'byung : rong pa tshul khrims dpal gyi sprul pa ni: gling stod thil nas shud+dha'i ming can 'byung : stong ba drag pa 'bum gyi sprul pa ni: mdo khams shar nas rgyal gyi ming can 'byung : mtshur pa kirti klag kya'i sprul pa ni: mdo byang phyogs nas rgya mtsho'i ming can 190

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyila'akhor/'byung : gtsang pa dharma kirti'i sprul pa ni: khams kyi phyogs nas bho dhi'i ming can 'byung : gyed pa dharma dpal gyi sprul pa ni: mdo khams smad nas shes rab ming can 'byung : dran nam thugs sprul rig 'dzin ming can ni: tsha sgong g.yu yi sgrol ma'i mdun nas 'byung :bar chad ma byung bstan pa gso thabs 'bad: sba lo na tha shrī ri'i sprul pa ni: khams kyi phyogs nas byams pa'i ming can 'byung : sba lo ye shes sde yi sprul pa ni: mdo khams phyogs nas me gha'i ming can 'byung : thang pa rat+na'i girti'i sprul pa ni: bzod pa'i ming can kong po'i mthil nas 'byung : lo tsā ke ru klog ci sprul pa ni kong po'i phyogs nas rig pa'i ming can 'byung : mthu ldan grags pa gying gi sprul pa ni: kong po'i yul nas pad+ma'i ming can 'byung : bzod ldan nyi ma dbang gi sprul pa ni: gtsang gi phyogs nas ngag gi ming can 'byung : gcung po don 'grub dpal gyi sprul pa ni: shes rab ming can gtsang gshis phyogs nas 'byung : lo ci 'od chung sprul pa rong yul nas: o rgyan ming can zhi dul ldan pa 'byung : gzhan yang nag phyogs bdud rigs 'dul gnyen du: sa gnas rig 'dzin 191

lung bstan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/byang sems dpag med 'byung : ngo mtshar lung bstan sbas don kun gsal 'di: mtsho rgyal khyod kyis yi ge'i ris thob la: ma 'ongs rgyal sras don du gter la sbos: rig 'dzin rdo rje gzhog rgod bka' bzhin du: mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ge'i ris su bkod bka' 'di rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas 'gro 'dren rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel bar sna ga: bka' 'di dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo khyod la bcol: dam chos thub par bsrungs shig badz+ra sa mā ya: sku yi rgya: gsung gi rgya: thugs kyi rgya: zab rgya:gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: gnyer rgya: gnyen rgya:man+t+ra ghu h+ya dha thim: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin 'dud 'dul gling pa yis:spo ri shel gyi yang sgrom gter gnas nas: shing bya lo la gter nas spyan drangs nas mi 'e1 bcu bdun bar du gsang gdams nas:nyams su blang zhing lcags glang la: 'gro 'dren rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub med phyir shog ser rnam dkar la bsgyur yi ge'i ris: kho bo rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal bas bgyis: sarba mad+male:192

'khrul bral me long /༄༅/ /rje drung sku phreng bzhi pa rkarma nges don snying pos ma 'ongs dus kyi 'gyur ldog gi lung bstan 'khrul bral me long dwangs ma bzhugs/ /lo dgu la ha shang dmag gis dgab/ /sa mdo gsum phyogs su rgya grong chags/ /sman bud med rnams kyis bka' bkod byed/ /sbra ya log mgo la dmag dar 'dzugs/ /dbu nag mi de grangs la 'debs/ /bsogs pa'i rgyu de rtsisal len/ /spang dkar yul rgyan dong la sbas/ /mi skya ser med pas grong sdig byed/ /khyi 'dab chags bcas pa bshas la phab/ /phyug po yin kyang re sa med/ /btsan po yin kyang bcar sa med/ /phag rgod tshes kyi lo stod nas/ /dbus byang phyogs nas rlung dmar 'tshubs/ /sprin nag 'khrigs pa gtor yang srid/ /de rgyab bde skyid nyi ma shar/ / zhes gsungs so/ /193
kyi k+ṣe rnye sa bsha ci 0lha ༄༄/ sna spya sh+lau 73 1snaho 744༄dzi

bla ma'i rnal 'byor/༄༅/ /zab gsang bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs rber+sha/ /ho/ rang snang ka nas dag pa 'od gsal gyi mkha' la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun sras bcas 'dus gzugs kyi ngo bo/ /drin chen bla ma rje btsun byams mgon gyi thugs sras/ /so thar khrims ldan sgrub brgyud nges don gyi snying po/ /gzhan phan byang sems blo gros ye shes kyi mtha' yas/ /sngags kyi rig 'dzin dzñā na badz+ra yi mtshan can/ /rab byung chas mdzes ngur smig rgyal mtshan gyis 'byud cing / /byang sems g.yo sgyu bral ba'i 'dzum dkar yang rgod pa/ /zab don chos sku'i lta stangs mthon po yi tshul can/ /rigs bdag 'bral med pad zhwa dmar po yis mdzes pa/ /phyag g.yas stong nyid rdo rje thugs 195

bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ka ru gsor nas/ /g.yon pas shes rab dril bu sku skad la brten zhing / /'gro 'dul sems dpa'i rol stabs rin chen gyi khri la/ /gnyug ma gshis las ma g.yos gzi byin gyi dpal 'bar/ /spyi bor pad+ma thod phreng 'bral med du bzhugs shing / /snying gar rje btsun byams mgon tshon gang gi 'od sku/ /gsal la ma 'dres gzi brjid lhun rdzogs kyi dgongs pa/ /don gnyis mchog thun phrin las rtsol med du 'char bas/ /gdan gsum gdod nas tshang pa sgyu 'phrul gyi rol gar/ /rtsa gsum mchog gsum kun 'dus drin chen gyi bla ma/ /gsal la ma 'dres chu zla me 61nga gi gzugs bzhin/ /mos ldan bu la byin rlabs da lta nas stsol cig /ces brjod la dbyangs rta snyan pos/ kye ma/ pha rje btsun bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ /mgon sangasargyasastong las lhag pa yi/ /nged skal ldan 'dren pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rje res 'ga' zab zhi spros bral ngang / /'od gsal sgyu ma'i snang ba 'byongs/ /rje res 'ga' rdzogs chen la zlos ngang / /nyams nga med pa'i brtul zhugs bskyangs/ /rje res 'ga' re med dog bral ngang / /snang ba rig pa'i rgyan du shar/ /rig pa blo 'das tshad la pheb/ /blo 'das 196

bla ma'i rnal 'byor/kyi chos kun dbyings su zad/ /mkhyen gnyis kyi rtsal kha phyogs med rgyas/ /'khor ba kha yan gyi thang chen la/ /nyams snang gang shar gyi bro gcig brdung / /lhun grub bum sku yi rtsal gcig rdzogs/ /kun rdzogs 'khrul snang gi rdzun phug brdibs/ /spang blang bral thob kyi re dogs chod/ /'pho med 'od sku ru smin par shog /cesadang / mthar bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim/ /don rang semasango bo dbyer med 'dres/ /gzhi gdod nas 'khrul med grol med kyi/ /kun bzang gi klong du sangs rgyas 3|ga /ces pa'ang dad dam rmad byung shesabazang nas nan tan chen pos 'di ltar bri rog zer bas/ /rang 'dra ba la gsol ba 'debasapa'i yul ma lagasakyang / /bskul ba po'i ngo ma ldog tsam/ /ma ṇi rgan mo khyi sos sangs rgyas zer ba ltar 'dug pa'i rtsa ba chos kun gnasapas/ /dad dam yid ches mnga' ba la dngosagrub 'byung ba gsang sngags kyi khyad chos yin phyir bzhin/ /rje drung pas spyo gtam 'di thal lo/ /༄༅/ /a ho/ rje bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod/ /nga snang ba dag pa'i rnal 'byol pas/ /lam khyer spyod pa'i glu ru len/ /thabs g.yo ba med pa'i bsam gtan dang / /me tsha drag 'bar ba'i shes rab kyi/ /bzang ngan kun theg pa'i bzod pa mchog /snod bzang 197

bla ma'i rnal 'byor/dang chu gtsang tshul khrims dri/ /sbud pa yis bskul ba'i brtson 'grus myur/ /ja kun la ster ba'i sbyin pa de/ /phar phyin drug po 'di la tshang /snang ba thabs kyi mkha' klong nas/ /snang med stong pa'i me chen 'bar/ /ma rtogs dug lnga'i bud shing sreg /dag pa'i bdud rtsi ro bcud ldan/ /mchog dman mchod yul ma lus brngan/ /sbyin sogs pha rol phyin pa drug /a lho dmar nag me phreng dam tshig rdo rje 'dzin/ /ra skyes seṅge la zhon sbud pa thogs/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor grogs mdzad pa/ /thabs 'di srungs la dngos grub char ltar phobs/ /rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ /a ho/ rang rig chos sku'i bla ma rang gsal gyi klong nas/ /rang byung ma 'gags snying rje'i rang shugasasu gzigs dang / /'khor ba bden du med pa ltar snang gi chu ris/ /rang rig klong du rang zhi rang thim 'di mthong ngam/ /srid gsum dgra ru ldang yang rang rig la ci bya/ /'on kyang gsang sngags dam tshig rdo rje yi phreng bar/ /dam med sgribs sam bcad na ci bya ni mi 'dug /rang rig klong du rang shugs gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro'i/ /dngos brgyud dri bral o rgyan mkha' 'gro yi tshogs gral/ /bu gcig 'gro'o 198

bla ma'i rnal 'byor/zhes pa'i gzugs med kyi sgra skad/ /mngon sum ḍā ki tshogs kyi brtse grogs su chas pas/ /da ni bzod med 'gro snang dus kun tu shar bas/ /'dir snang zhen pa'i 'khri ba rtsa ba nas chod song / /rtsod 'khon re dogs med pa dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro/ /'khrul snang ma yin mngon sum lag brkyangs su gyur 'dis/ /rtag brtan rten 'byung ḍā zhi'i brda' khrol 'ga' yod kyang / /thog tu phyin dka' log lta'i kha snon las mi yong / /da ni bslu med yin pa'i dngosartagasade mthong tshun/ /'jig brten bya bzhag 'di la phyi phyag zhig 'tshal nas/ /mdza' ba'i gnyen kyang 'dus pa'i tha ma de yin skad/ /bcangs ba'i 'khor slob kun kyang rang gzhan ni tha dad/ /bsags pa'i nor rdzas kun kyang sbrang ma yi sbrang rtsi/ /rang gi bsags kyang gzhan la longs spyod du btang ran/ /rang rig ka dag ngang la 'pho 'gyur zhig bral bas/ /pha rgan nga ni kun gzhi rdor 'chang zhig yin snang / /mkha' spyod zhing gi ston pa ye gdod nas grub snyam/ /a la rtag 'dzin can gyi 'di bden du ma 'dzin/ /rtag med rtag kyi rgyal po kun bzang gi dgongs pa/ /skye rga na 'chi bral ba 'od gsal gyi sbubs 199

bla ma'i rnal wor/she la' nga sa 'isu/ /ka dag gdad ma' gtan srad zan pa zhag gyur nas/ /rang ri sa ted ngabyen 66gzhan gtan bad grub ba rjas bzung ga gas kun/ /a ma ra tsu ge me 'i 4 4 nge 4bka' brgyud ban ba na zal da kya rnal stir/ /smyan pa sa dan dhe ge tsho ra ma zhe 4 4 'tshe khri 'isnyeng pas gang shar du thal la/ / sa yas la zla 9pa' sa 25la sa shang / /la sna lhan//re/ pha tsho /sdu/ ra tshothig la zla ba 3pa sa 15la gzugs sku chas da ngas su bsdus sa/ /200

༄༅/ /gsol 'debs byin rlabs char rgyun zhes bya ba baṭa/gas pa dge :skugs 'phe95/e ma ho: sku gsum bdag nyid dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos:rtsa gsum 'dus gzugs o rgyan rdo rje 'chang : gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab du gsol phyi ru char chu mi snyoms 'byung bzhi rgud: nang du mi mthun dal yams nad mug mtshon: gsang ba'i rtog 'brul byed phur bar chad kun: dbyings su sol la mtha' dmag mtshon kha zlog: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas der 'dzin gyi:sku tshe mdzad phrin brtan zhing 'dus sde 'phel: mdo sngags bshad sgrub lung rtogs nyam med 'dzin: thugs mthun khrims ldan tshe chos 201

gsol 'debs/'byor bas phyug: yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde skyid dge bcu dar:bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: a āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi lha: ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha dal yams dus 'khrugs nad mtshon mu ge mtha' dmag thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:cesastag lo gsar tshesa'abum 'gyur zla ba'i yar tshesagacig gi nub mor nyams dang 'od gsal gyi snang bar gu ru rin po che la skal ldan las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga dang bcas pa mjal ba'i snang ba dang / /rjes mthun brtse ba'i zhal gdams mang po thos pa lhag don gsal 'debs don 'bras shar ba ltar la sbas par rang gzhan spyi don du dmigs nas dus mtha'i gter ming sngags rig 'dzin pa pad+ma'i 'bangs pad+ma dri med klong yang zil gnon bshad pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge gu ru pad+ma'i bka' lung la mi bslu nges pa'i tha tshig yod ban rgan kha yi nor gtam la don chen 'grub pa'i ltad mo yod shes pa kun gyis dang du longs mi shes kun gyis rna nyan mdzod ha ha dge legs 'phel// 202

gsol 'debs/ ci༄༅/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal ngan rgud pa zhi ba'i gsol 'debs rdo rje'i tre/ cha bzhugs/ /e ma ho: ston mchog bdud 'dul rgyal po zas gtsang sras:gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs: gang 'dul phrin las rol pa rje btsun ma: gdong dmar skyobs pa'i pha gcig o rgyan rje: gdung bas 'bod do thugs rjes da lta gzigs: skal med sems can las ngan nyam thag pa: dug gsum rgyu dang 'bras bur las byung zhing: smon log dam sri 'byung po'i bsam sbyor las:sngar med nad yams gnyan lhog sa steng khyab gu ru sman bla rig 'dzin thugs ma g.yel kla klos dus 'khrug dam chos snubs la nye gu ru lha sren sde brgyad mthu ma chung : glo bur tshe srog bar du gcod gyur na: gu ru rdo rje'i gur khang rgya ma chung : dam sri'i kha rlang mug 203

gsol 'debs/yams byung gyur na: gu ru mkha' 'gro nor lha rgyang ma ring : mdor na snyigs dus ngan pa'i g.yo zhabrugs las skyobs par zhal gyis bzhes pa o rgyan rje gdung bas 'bod do re sa gzhan las med:thugs rjes gzigs shig tse( rgyan pad+ma 'byung : brtse bas gzigs shig ma gcig mtsho rgyal ma: nus pas dgongs shig nus ldan nyer lnga'i tshogs mtha' dmag zlog cig gter chen gter phran tshogs:dus la bab bo skal ngan mtha' dmag bzlog: cesapa rje drung dzña na badz+ra nas nyams la gang shar du brisapas skye rgu thamasacad skal ngan las thar bar shog /maṅga le/༄༅/ /skyabs bslu med gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /ma 'gro ba'i mgon gyur mtsho rgyal yum/ /dpal dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal po la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dus phyi nang gsang ba'i g.yul 'khrug dang / /rkyen mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i dgra gdon zlog /dpal bde skyid dge bcu dar zhing rgyas/ /pha gu ru'i zhing der bgrod gyur cig /ces pa 'di rje drung pas so//204

gsol 'debs/༄7/ /gangs ljongs mkhas pa'i rgyan bzhi la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /o rgyan ma hā gu ru'i dgongs pa'i bcud/ /zab don yo ga gsum gyi gter mdzod che/ /rin chen rnam pa bdun gyi sgo 'phar 'byed/ /klong chen rab 'byams zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen rab rgyal ba rnams dang ro gcig pas/ /phyir mi ldog pa gzhan stong seṅge'i sgras/ /ngal gsos dbugs 'byin sgrub bstan nyi 'og khyab/ /rang byung rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen rab legs bshad bye ba'i seṅge'i sgra/ /sa gsum 'gengs pas log smra'i klad pa 'gems/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'jam dbyangs mi yi zol sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi bstan pa'i mchog /sa chen 'gengs pasathugasabaskyed rgyal ba ltar/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pas rnam mang grol/ /blo bzang grags pa'i zhakhas la garbedul ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i shwa lo ka bzhi po 'di tshul khrims ldan 205

gsol 'debs/pa'am ming gzhan shi la me nas bskul ngor rje drung skye phreng bzhi pa rkarma nges don snying po nasaso//na mo gu ru gnas ka dag spros bral chos kyi dbyings/ /don 'gags med longasaspyod rdzogasapa'i sku/ /rtsal sna tshogs sprul bsgyur rol gar las/ /rje bka' drin zla bral 'gro ba'i mgon/ /pha bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /don dbyer med dpal ldan garma pa/ /sku mtshan dang dpe byed 'od stong 'bar/ /rgyan chos gos rnam gsum gser mdog 'tsher/ /dbu zhwa nag mthong grol cod paṇa gsol/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs/ /mthong tsam gyis rnam grol lam la bkod/ /thos tsam gyis bzod med mos gus skye/ /dran tsam gyis ting 'dzin sgo brgya 'byed/ /phyag reg pa tsam gyis ye shes brnyes/ /rje grol ba bzhi ldan garma pa/ /'bral med snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /byin rlabs kyis char rgyun myur tu phobs/ /sdug bsngal gyis 'dam du bying ba bdag /thar lam gyi 'bras bzang bzhad par mdzod/ /bdag dal 'byor rten bzang don yod par/ /'chi mi rtag drag po'i rgyud bskul nas/ /las rgyu 'bras blang dor mi 'chor bar/ /chos zab mo'i don kun rgyud la 206

gsol 'debs/'byor/ /spros bcas kyi chos rnams dbyings su dag /lam smin grol zab mo'i kha bsgyur nas/ /dran shes bzhin gyi dam bca' mi brjed pa/ /yid spros bral chos sku phyag rgya che/ /rnam rtog la ched rtsol mi dgos par/ /ngo bo yi thog tu lam mer gnas/ /gnas bzhin du 'gyu ba rang sar grol/ /rig pa yi ngo bo gsal la stong / /dus rgyun chad med pa'i rang rtsal nyid/ /do yi na la yin bzhin rang gis shes/ /sems phyag rgya chen po zhes pa de/ /tha mal gyi shes pa kho na ste/ /de rang ngo rang gis shes pa dang / /dran shes kyi bya ras yang bskyang therdzog /tshe 'di yang bsam don chos bzhin 'grub/ /sdig mi dge bcu po gtan spang nas/ /las bya ba chos dang mthun par shog /phyi ma yang mkha' spyod tshogs gral du/ /dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros mdun bsus te/ /'ja' 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i dbyings rum du/ /tshogs 'khor gyi 'du ba son par shog /cesapa'ang /byisartsal bsangasamachod mdzad chos la dga' ba a yu ta thas bskul ngor rje drung pas gang shar bris pas phyag rgya chen po'i don rang rgyud la rtogs par gyur cig /sarba dwa maṅga lo//207
